verses.en: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful.
verses.am: Blessed {is} the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful. {ungodly: or, wicked}

verses.en: But his delight is in the law of YAHUAH; and in his law doth he meditate day and night.
verses.am: But his delight {is} in the law of the LORD; and in his law doth he meditate day and night.

verses.en: And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.
verses.am: And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper. {wither: Heb. fade}

verses.en: The ungodly are not so: but are like the chaff which the wind driveth away.
verses.am: The ungodly {are} not so: but {are} like the chaff which the wind driveth away.

verses.en: Therefore the ungodly shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.
verses.am: Therefore the ungodly shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.

verses.en: For YAHUAH knoweth the way of the righteous: but the way of the ungodly shall perish.
verses.am: For the LORD knoweth the way of the righteous: but the way of the ungodly shall perish.

verses.en: Why do the heathen rage, and the people imagine a vain thing?
verses.am: Why do the heathen rage, and the people imagine a vain thing? {rage: or, tumultuously assemble} {imagine: Heb. meditate}

verses.en: The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against YAHUAH, and against his anointed, saying,
verses.am: The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against the LORD, and against his anointed, {saying},

verses.en: Let us break their bands asunder, and cast away their cords from us.
verses.am: Let us break their bands asunder, and cast away their cords from us.

verses.en: He that sitteth in the heavens shall laugh: YAHUAH shall have them in derision.
verses.am: He that sitteth in the heavens shall laugh: the Lord shall have them in derision.

verses.en: Then shall he speak unto them in his wrath, and vex them in his sore displeasure.
verses.am: Then shall he speak unto them in his wrath, and vex them in his sore displeasure. {vex: or, trouble}

verses.en: Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion.
verses.am: Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion. {set: Heb. anointed} {upon...: Heb. upon Zion, the hill of my holiness}

verses.en: I will declare the decree: YAHUAH hath said unto me, Thou art my Son; this day have I begotten thee.
verses.am: I will declare the decree: the LORD hath said unto me, Thou {art} my Son; this day have I begotten thee. {the decree: or, for a decree}

verses.en: Ask of me, and I shall give thee the heathen for thine inheritance, and the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession.
verses.am: Ask of me, and I shall give {thee} the heathen {for} thine inheritance, and the uttermost parts of the earth {for} thy possession.

verses.en: Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter's vessel.
verses.am: Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter's vessel.

verses.en: Be wise now therefore, O ye kings: be instructed, ye judges of the earth.
verses.am: Be wise now therefore, O ye kings: be instructed, ye judges of the earth.

verses.en: Serve YAHUAH with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
verses.am: Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.

verses.en: Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and ye perish from the way, when his wrath is kindled but a little. Blessed are all they that put their trust in him.
verses.am: Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and ye perish {from} the way, when his wrath is kindled but a little. Blessed {are} all they that put their trust in him.

verses.en: [A Psalm of Dawid, when he fled from Absalom his son.] YAHUAH, how are they increased that trouble me! many are they that rise up against me.
verses.am: [A Psalm of David, when he fled from Absalom his son.] LORD, how are they increased that trouble me! many {are} they that rise up against me.

verses.en: Many there be which say of my soul, There is no help for him in YAHUAH. Selah.
verses.am: Many {there be} which say of my soul, {There is} no help for him in God. Selah.

verses.en: But thou, O YAHUAH, art a shield for me; my glory, and the lifter up of mine head.
verses.am: But thou, O LORD, {art} a shield for me; my glory, and the lifter up of mine head. {for: or, about}

verses.en: I cried unto YAHUAH with my voice, and he heard me out of his holy hill. Selah.
verses.am: I cried unto the LORD with my voice, and he heard me out of his holy hill. Selah.

verses.en: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for YAHUAH sustained me.
verses.am: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for the LORD sustained me.

verses.en: I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people, that have set themselves against me round about.
verses.am: I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people, that have set {themselves} against me round about.

verses.en: Arise, O YAHUAH; save me, O my YAHUAH: for thou hast smitten all mine enemies upon the cheek bone; thou hast broken the teeth of the ungodly.
verses.am: Arise, O LORD; save me, O my God: for thou hast smitten all mine enemies {upon} the cheek bone; thou hast broken the teeth of the ungodly.

verses.en: Salvation belongeth unto YAHUAH: thy blessing is upon thy people. Selah.
verses.am: Salvation {belongeth} unto the LORD: thy blessing {is} upon thy people. Selah.

verses.en: [To the chief Musician on Neginoth, A Psalm of Dawid.] Hear me when I call, O YAHUAH of my righteousness: thou hast enlarged me when I was in distress; have mercy upon me, and hear my prayer.
verses.am: [To the chief Musician on Neginoth, A Psalm of David.] Hear me when I call, O God of my righteousness: thou hast enlarged me {when I was} in distress; have mercy upon me, and hear my prayer. {chief...: or, overseer} {have...: or, be gracious unto me}

verses.en: O ye sons of men, how long will ye turn my glory into shame? how long will ye love vanity, and seek after leasing? Selah.
verses.am: O ye sons of men, how long {will ye turn} my glory into shame? {how long} will ye love vanity, {and} seek after leasing? Selah.

verses.en: But know that YAHUAH hath set apart him that is godly for himself: YAHUAH will hear when I call unto him.
verses.am: But know that the LORD hath set apart him that is godly for himself: the LORD will hear when I call unto him.

verses.en: Stand in awe, and sin not: commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. Selah.
verses.am: Stand in awe, and sin not: commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. Selah.

verses.en: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, and put your trust in YAHUAH.
verses.am: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, and put your trust in the LORD.

verses.en: There be many that say, Who will shew us any good? YAHUAH, lift thou up the light of thy countenance upon us.
verses.am: {There be} many that say, Who will shew us {any} good? LORD, lift thou up the light of thy countenance upon us.

verses.en: Thou hast put gladness in my heart, more than in the time that their corn and their wine increased.
verses.am: Thou hast put gladness in my heart, more than in the time {that} their corn and their wine increased.

verses.en: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, YAHUAH, only makest me dwell in safety.
verses.am: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety.

verses.en: [To the chief Musician upon Nehiloth, A Psalm of Dawid.] Give ear to my words, O YAHUAH, consider my meditation.
verses.am: [To the chief Musician upon Nehiloth, A Psalm of David.] Give ear to my words, O LORD, consider my meditation.

verses.en: Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my YAHUAH: for unto thee will I pray.
verses.am: Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my God: for unto thee will I pray.

verses.en: My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O YAHUAH; in the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up.
verses.am: My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O LORD; in the morning will I direct {my prayer} unto thee, and will look up.

verses.en: For thou art not a YAHUAH that hath pleasure in wickedness: neither shall evil dwell with thee.
verses.am: For thou {art} not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness: neither shall evil dwell with thee.

verses.en: The foolish shall not stand in thy sight: thou hatest all workers of iniquity.
verses.am: The foolish shall not stand in thy sight: thou hatest all workers of iniquity. {in...: Heb. before thine eyes}

verses.en: Thou shalt destroy them that speak leasing: YAHUAH will abhor the bloody and deceitful man.
verses.am: Thou shalt destroy them that speak leasing: the LORD will abhor the bloody and deceitful man. {bloody...: Heb. man of bloods and deceit}

verses.en: But as for me, I will come into thy house in the multitude of thy mercy: and in thy fear will I worship toward thy holy temple.
verses.am: But as for me, I will come {into} thy house in the multitude of thy mercy: {and} in thy fear will I worship toward thy holy temple. {thy holy...: Heb. the temple of thy holiness}

verses.en: Lead me, O YAHUAH, in thy righteousness because of mine enemies; make thy way straight before my face.
verses.am: Lead me, O LORD, in thy righteousness because of mine enemies; make thy way straight before my face. {mine...: Heb. those which observe me}

verses.en: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth; their inward part is very wickedness; their throat is an open sepulchre; they flatter with their tongue.
verses.am: For {there is} no faithfulness in their mouth; their inward part {is} very wickedness; their throat {is} an open sepulchre; they flatter with their tongue. {faithfulness: or, stedfastness} {their mouth: Heb. his mouth, that is, the mouth of any of them} {very...: Heb. wickednesses}

verses.en: Destroy thou them, O YAHUAH; let them fall by their own counsels; cast them out in the multitude of their transgressions; for they have rebelled against thee.
verses.am: Destroy thou them, O God; let them fall by their own counsels; cast them out in the multitude of their transgressions; for they have rebelled against thee. {Destroy...: or, Make them guilty} {by...: or, from their counsels}

verses.en: But let all those that put their trust in thee rejoice: let them ever shout for joy, because thou defendest them: let them also that love thy name be joyful in thee.
verses.am: But let all those that put their trust in thee rejoice: let them ever shout for joy, because thou defendest them: let them also that love thy name be joyful in thee. {defendest...: Heb. coverest over, or, protectest them}

verses.en: For thou, YAHUAH, wilt bless the righteous; with favour wilt thou compass him as with a shield.
verses.am: For thou, LORD, wilt bless the righteous; with favour wilt thou compass him as {with} a shield. {compass: Heb. crown}

verses.en: [To the chief Musician on Neginoth upon Sheminith, A Psalm of Dawid.] O YAHUAH, rebuke me not in thine anger, neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
verses.am: [To the chief Musician on Neginoth upon Sheminith, A Psalm of David.] O LORD, rebuke me not in thine anger, neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure. {chief...: or, overseer} {Sheminith: or, the eighth}

verses.en: Have mercy upon me, O YAHUAH; for I am weak: O YAHUAH, heal me; for my bones are vexed.
verses.am: Have mercy upon me, O LORD; for I {am} weak: O LORD, heal me; for my bones are vexed.

verses.en: My soul is also sore vexed: but thou, O YAHUAH, how long?
verses.am: My soul is also sore vexed: but thou, O LORD, how long?

verses.en: Return, O YAHUAH, deliver my soul: oh save me for thy mercies' sake.
verses.am: Return, O LORD, deliver my soul: oh save me for thy mercies' sake.

verses.en: For in death there is no remembrance of thee: in the grave who shall give thee thanks?
verses.am: For in death {there is} no remembrance of thee: in the grave who shall give thee thanks?

verses.en: I am weary with my groaning; all the night make I my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.
verses.am: I am weary with my groaning; all the night make I my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears. {all...: or, every night}

verses.en: Mine eye is consumed because of grief; it waxeth old because of all mine enemies.
verses.am: Mine eye is consumed because of grief; it waxeth old because of all mine enemies.

verses.en: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; for YAHUAH hath heard the voice of my weeping.
verses.am: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; for the LORD hath heard the voice of my weeping.

verses.en: YAHUAH hath heard my supplication; YAHUAH will receive my prayer.
verses.am: The LORD hath heard my supplication; the LORD will receive my prayer.

verses.en: Let all mine enemies be ashamed and sore vexed: let them return and be ashamed suddenly.
verses.am: Let all mine enemies be ashamed and sore vexed: let them return {and} be ashamed suddenly.

verses.en: [Shiggaion of Dawid, which he sang unto YAHUAH, concerning the words of Cush the Benjamite.] O YAHUAH my YAHUAH, in thee do I put my trust: save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me:
verses.am: [Shiggaion of David, which he sang unto the LORD, concerning the words of Cush the Benjamite.] O LORD my God, in thee do I put my trust: save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me: {words: or, business}

verses.en: Lest he tear my soul like a lion, rending it in pieces, while there is none to deliver.
verses.am: Lest he tear my soul like a lion, rending {it} in pieces, while {there is} none to deliver. {none...: Heb. not a deliverer}

verses.en: O YAHUAH my YAHUAH, if I have done this; if there be iniquity in my hands;
verses.am: O LORD my God, if I have done this; if there be iniquity in my hands;

verses.en: If I have rewarded evil unto him that was at peace with me; (yea, I have delivered him that without cause is mine enemy:)
verses.am: If I have rewarded evil unto him that was at peace with me; (yea, I have delivered him that without cause is mine enemy:)

verses.en: Let the enemy persecute my soul, and take it; yea, let him tread down my life upon the earth, and lay mine honour in the dust. Selah.
verses.am: Let the enemy persecute my soul, and take {it}; yea, let him tread down my life upon the earth, and lay mine honour in the dust. Selah.

verses.en: Arise, O YAHUAH, in thine anger, lift up thyself because of the rage of mine enemies: and awake for me to the judgment that thou hast commanded.
verses.am: Arise, O LORD, in thine anger, lift up thyself because of the rage of mine enemies: and awake for me {to} the judgment {that} thou hast commanded.

verses.en: So shall the congregation of the people compass thee about: for their sakes therefore return thou on high.
verses.am: So shall the congregation of the people compass thee about: for their sakes therefore return thou on high.

verses.en: YAHUAH shall judge the people: judge me, O YAHUAH, according to my righteousness, and according to mine integrity that is in me.
verses.am: The LORD shall judge the people: judge me, O LORD, according to my righteousness, and according to mine integrity {that is} in me.

verses.en: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end; but establish the just: for the righteous YAHUAH trieth the hearts and reins.
verses.am: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end; but establish the just: for the righteous God trieth the hearts and reins.

verses.en: My defence is of YAHUAH, which saveth the upright in heart.
verses.am: My defence {is} of God, which saveth the upright in heart. {My...: Heb. My buckler is upon God}

verses.en: YAHUAH judgeth the righteous, and YAHUAH is angry with the wicked every day.
verses.am: God judgeth the righteous, and God is angry {with the wicked} every day. {judgeth...: or, is a righteous judge}

verses.en: If he turn not, he will whet his sword; he hath bent his bow, and made it ready.
verses.am: If he turn not, he will whet his sword; he hath bent his bow, and made it ready.

verses.en: He hath also prepared for him the instruments of death; he ordaineth his arrows against the persecutors.
verses.am: He hath also prepared for him the instruments of death; he ordaineth his arrows against the persecutors.

verses.en: Behold, he travaileth with iniquity, and hath conceived mischief, and brought forth falsehood.
verses.am: Behold, he travaileth with iniquity, and hath conceived mischief, and brought forth falsehood.

verses.en: He made a pit, and digged it, and is fallen into the ditch which he made.
verses.am: He made a pit, and digged it, and is fallen into the ditch {which} he made. {He made a pit: Heb. He hath digged a pit}

verses.en: His mischief shall return upon his own head, and his violent dealing shall come down upon his own pate.
verses.am: His mischief shall return upon his own head, and his violent dealing shall come down upon his own pate.

verses.en: I will praise YAHUAH according to his righteousness: and will sing praise to the name of YAHUAH most high.
verses.am: I will praise the LORD according to his righteousness: and will sing praise to the name of the LORD most high.

verses.en: [To the chief Musician upon Gittith, A Psalm of Dawid.] O YAHUAH our YAHUAH, how excellent is thy name in all the earth! who hast set thy glory above the heavens.
verses.am: [To the chief Musician upon Gittith, A Psalm of David.] O LORD our Lord, how excellent {is} thy name in all the earth! who hast set thy glory above the heavens.

verses.en: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou ordained strength because of thine enemies, that thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.
verses.am: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou ordained strength because of thine enemies, that thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger. {ordained: Heb. founded}

verses.en: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained;
verses.am: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained;

verses.en: What is man, that thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him?
verses.am: What is man, that thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him?

verses.en: For thou hast made him a little lower than the angels, and hast crowned him with glory and honour.
verses.am: For thou hast made him a little lower than the angels, and hast crowned him with glory and honour.

verses.en: Thou madest him to have dominion over the works of thy hands; thou hast put all things under his feet:
verses.am: Thou madest him to have dominion over the works of thy hands; thou hast put all {things} under his feet:

verses.en: All sheep and oxen, yea, and the beasts of the field;
verses.am: All sheep and oxen, yea, and the beasts of the field; {All...: Heb. Flocks and oxen all of them}

verses.en: The fowl of the air, and the fish of the sea, and whatsoever passeth through the paths of the seas.
verses.am: The fowl of the air, and the fish of the sea, {and whatsoever} passeth through the paths of the seas.

verses.en: O YAHUAH our YAHUAH, how excellent is thy name in all the earth!
verses.am: O LORD our Lord, how excellent {is} thy name in all the earth!

verses.en: [To the chief Musician upon Muthlabben, A Psalm of Dawid.] I will praise thee, O YAHUAH, with my whole heart; I will shew forth all thy marvellous works.
verses.am: [To the chief Musician upon Muthlabben, A Psalm of David.] I will praise {thee}, O LORD, with my whole heart; I will shew forth all thy marvellous works.

verses.en: I will be glad and rejoice in thee: I will sing praise to thy name, O thou most High.
verses.am: I will be glad and rejoice in thee: I will sing praise to thy name, O thou most High.

verses.en: When mine enemies are turned back, they shall fall and perish at thy presence.
verses.am: When mine enemies are turned back, they shall fall and perish at thy presence.

verses.en: For thou hast maintained my right and my cause; thou satest in the throne judging right.
verses.am: For thou hast maintained my right and my cause; thou satest in the throne judging right. {maintained...: Heb. made my judgment} {judging right: Heb. judging in righteousness}

verses.en: Thou hast rebuked the heathen, thou hast destroyed the wicked, thou hast put out their name for ever and ever.
verses.am: Thou hast rebuked the heathen, thou hast destroyed the wicked, thou hast put out their name for ever and ever.

verses.en: O thou enemy, destructions are come to a perpetual end: and thou hast destroyed cities; their memorial is perished with them.
verses.am: O thou enemy, destructions are come to a perpetual end: and thou hast destroyed cities; their memorial is perished with them. {O thou...: or, The destructions of the enemy are come to a perpetual end: and their cities hast thou destroyed, etc}

verses.en: But YAHUAH shall endure for ever: he hath prepared his throne for judgment.
verses.am: But the LORD shall endure for ever: he hath prepared his throne for judgment.

verses.en: And he shall judge the world in righteousness, he shall minister judgment to the people in uprightness.
verses.am: And he shall judge the world in righteousness, he shall minister judgment to the people in uprightness.

verses.en: YAHUAH also will be a refuge for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble.
verses.am: The LORD also will be a refuge for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble. {a refuge: Heb. an high place}

verses.en: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee: for thou, YAHUAH, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.
verses.am: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee: for thou, LORD, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.

verses.en: Sing praises to YAHUAH, which dwelleth in Zion: declare among the people his doings.
verses.am: Sing praises to the LORD, which dwelleth in Zion: declare among the people his doings.

verses.en: When he maketh inquisition for blood, he remembereth them: he forgetteth not the cry of the humble.
verses.am: When he maketh inquisition for blood, he remembereth them: he forgetteth not the cry of the humble. {humble: or, afflicted}

verses.en: Have mercy upon me, O YAHUAH; consider my trouble which I suffer of them that hate me, thou that liftest me up from the gates of death:
verses.am: Have mercy upon me, O LORD; consider my trouble {which I suffer} of them that hate me, thou that liftest me up from the gates of death:

verses.en: That I may shew forth all thy praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion: I will rejoice in thy salvation.
verses.am: That I may shew forth all thy praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion: I will rejoice in thy salvation.

verses.en: The heathen are sunk down in the pit that they made: in the net which they hid is their own foot taken.
verses.am: The heathen are sunk down in the pit {that} they made: in the net which they hid is their own foot taken.

verses.en: YAHUAH is known by the judgment which he executeth: the wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah.
verses.am: The LORD is known {by} the judgment {which} he executeth: the wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah. {Higgaion: that is, Meditation}

verses.en: The wicked shall be turned into hell, and all the nations that forget YAHUAH.
verses.am: The wicked shall be turned into hell, {and} all the nations that forget God.

verses.en: For the needy shall not alway be forgotten: the expectation of the poor shall not perish for ever.
verses.am: For the needy shall not alway be forgotten: the expectation of the poor shall {not} perish for ever.

verses.en: Arise, O YAHUAH; let not man prevail: let the heathen be judged in thy sight.
verses.am: Arise, O LORD; let not man prevail: let the heathen be judged in thy sight.

verses.en: Put them in fear, O YAHUAH: that the nations may know themselves to be but men. Selah.
verses.am: Put them in fear, O LORD: {that} the nations may know themselves {to be but} men. Selah.

verses.en: Why standest thou afar off, O YAHUAH? why hidest thou thyself in times of trouble?
verses.am: Why standest thou afar off, O LORD? {why} hidest thou {thyself} in times of trouble?

verses.en: The wicked in his pride doth persecute the poor: let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined.
verses.am: The wicked in {his} pride doth persecute the poor: let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined. {The wicked...: Heb. In the pride of the wicked he doth persecute}

verses.en: For the wicked boasteth of his heart's desire, and blesseth the covetous, whom YAHUAH abhorreth.
verses.am: For the wicked boasteth of his heart's desire, and blesseth the covetous, {whom} the LORD abhorreth. {heart's: Heb. soul's} {blesseth...: or, the covetous blesseth himself, he abhorreth the LORD}

verses.en: The wicked, through the pride of his countenance, will not seek after YAHUAH: YAHUAH is not in all his thoughts.
verses.am: The wicked, through the pride of his countenance, will not seek {after God}: God {is} not in all his thoughts. {God is...: or, all his thoughts are, There is no God}

verses.en: His ways are always grievous; thy judgments are far above out of his sight: as for all his enemies, he puffeth at them.
verses.am: His ways are always grievous; thy judgments {are} far above out of his sight: {as for} all his enemies, he puffeth at them.

verses.en: He hath said in his heart, I shall not be moved: for I shall never be in adversity.
verses.am: He hath said in his heart, I shall not be moved: for {I shall} never {be} in adversity. {never: Heb. unto generation and generation}

verses.en: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud: under his tongue is mischief and vanity.
verses.am: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud: under his tongue {is} mischief and vanity. {deceit: Heb. deceits} {vanity: or, iniquity}

verses.en: He sitteth in the lurking places of the villages: in the secret places doth he murder the innocent: his eyes are privily set against the poor.
verses.am: He sitteth in the lurking places of the villages: in the secret places doth he murder the innocent: his eyes are privily set against the poor. {are...: Heb. hide themselves}

verses.en: He lieth in wait secretly as a lion in his den: he lieth in wait to catch the poor: he doth catch the poor, when he draweth him into his net.
verses.am: He lieth in wait secretly as a lion in his den: he lieth in wait to catch the poor: he doth catch the poor, when he draweth him into his net. {secretly: Heb. in the secret places}

verses.en: He croucheth, and humbleth himself, that the poor may fall by his strong ones.
verses.am: He croucheth, {and} humbleth himself, that the poor may fall by his strong ones. {He...: Heb. He breaketh himself} {by...: or, into his strong parts}

verses.en: He hath said in his heart, YAHUAH hath forgotten: he hideth his face; he will never see it.
verses.am: He hath said in his heart, God hath forgotten: he hideth his face; he will never see {it}.

verses.en: Arise, O YAHUAH; O YAHUAH, lift up thine hand: forget not the humble.
verses.am: Arise, O LORD; O God, lift up thine hand: forget not the humble. {humble: or, afflicted}

verses.en: Wherefore doth the wicked contemn YAHUAH? he hath said in his heart, Thou wilt not require it.
verses.am: Wherefore doth the wicked contemn God? he hath said in his heart, Thou wilt not require {it}.

verses.en: Thou hast seen it; for thou beholdest mischief and spite, to requite it with thy hand: the poor committeth himself unto thee; thou art the helper of the fatherless.
verses.am: Thou hast seen {it}; for thou beholdest mischief and spite, to requite {it} with thy hand: the poor committeth himself unto thee; thou art the helper of the fatherless. {committeth: Heb. leaveth}

verses.en: Break thou the arm of the wicked and the evil man: seek out his wickedness till thou find none.
verses.am: Break thou the arm of the wicked and the evil {man}: seek out his wickedness {till} thou find none.

verses.en: YAHUAH is King for ever and ever: the heathen are perished out of his land.
verses.am: The LORD {is} King for ever and ever: the heathen are perished out of his land.

verses.en: YAHUAH, thou hast heard the desire of the humble: thou wilt prepare their heart, thou wilt cause thine ear to hear:
verses.am: LORD, thou hast heard the desire of the humble: thou wilt prepare their heart, thou wilt cause thine ear to hear: {prepare: or, establish}

verses.en: To judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that the man of the earth may no more oppress.
verses.am: To judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that the man of the earth may no more oppress. {oppress: or, terrify}

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of Dawid.] In YAHUAH put I my trust: how say ye to my soul, Flee as a bird to your mountain?
verses.am: [To the chief Musician, {A Psalm} of David.] In the LORD put I my trust: how say ye to my soul, Flee {as} a bird to your mountain?

verses.en: For, lo, the wicked bend their bow, they make ready their arrow upon the string, that they may privily shoot at the upright in heart.
verses.am: For, lo, the wicked bend {their} bow, they make ready their arrow upon the string, that they may privily shoot at the upright in heart. {privily: Heb. in darkness}

verses.en: If the foundations be destroyed, what can the righteous do?
verses.am: If the foundations be destroyed, what can the righteous do?

verses.en: YAHUAH is in his holy temple, YAHUAH's throne is in heaven: his eyes behold, his eyelids try, the children of men.
verses.am: The LORD {is} in his holy temple, the LORD'S throne {is} in heaven: his eyes behold, his eyelids try, the children of men.

verses.en: YAHUAH trieth the righteous: but the wicked and him that loveth violence his soul hateth.
verses.am: The LORD trieth the righteous: but the wicked and him that loveth violence his soul hateth.

verses.en: Upon the wicked he shall rain snares, fire and brimstone, and an horrible tempest: this shall be the portion of their cup.
verses.am: Upon the wicked he shall rain snares, fire and brimstone, and an horrible tempest: {this shall be} the portion of their cup. {an horrible...: or, a burning tempest}

verses.en: For the righteous YAHUAH loveth righteousness; his countenance doth behold the upright.
verses.am: For the righteous LORD loveth righteousness; his countenance doth behold the upright.

verses.en: [To the chief Musician upon Sheminith, A Psalm of Dawid.] Help, YAHUAH; for the godly man ceaseth; for the faithful fail from among the children of men.
verses.am: [To the chief Musician upon Sheminith, A Psalm of David.] Help, LORD; for the godly man ceaseth; for the faithful fail from among the children of men. {upon...: or, upon the eighth} {Help: or, Save}

verses.en: They speak vanity every one with his neighbour: with flattering lips and with a double heart do they speak.
verses.am: They speak vanity every one with his neighbour: {with} flattering lips {and} with a double heart do they speak. {a double...: Heb. an heart and an heart}

verses.en: YAHUAH shall cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that speaketh proud things:
verses.am: The LORD shall cut off all flattering lips, {and} the tongue that speaketh proud things: {proud: Heb. great}

verses.en: Who have said, With our tongue will we prevail; our lips are our own: who is lord over us?
verses.am: Who have said, With our tongue will we prevail; our lips {are} our own: who {is} lord over us? {are...: Heb. are with us}

verses.en: For the oppression of the poor, for the sighing of the needy, now will I arise, saith YAHUAH; I will set him in safety from him that puffeth at him.
verses.am: For the oppression of the poor, for the sighing of the needy, now will I arise, saith the LORD; I will set {him} in safety {from him that} puffeth at him. {puffeth...: or, would ensnare him}

verses.en: The words of YAHUAH are pure words: as silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.
verses.am: The words of the LORD {are} pure words: {as} silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.

verses.en: Thou shalt keep them, O YAHUAH, thou shalt preserve them from this generation for ever.
verses.am: Thou shalt keep them, O LORD, thou shalt preserve them from this generation for ever. {them from: Heb. him, etc: that is, every one of them, etc}

verses.en: The wicked walk on every side, when the vilest men are exalted.
verses.am: The wicked walk on every side, when the vilest men are exalted. {men: Heb. of the sons of the men}

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of Dawid.] How long wilt thou forget me, O YAHUAH? for ever? how long wilt thou hide thy face from me?
verses.am: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.] How long wilt thou forget me, O LORD? for ever? how long wilt thou hide thy face from me? {chief...: or, overseer}

verses.en: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart daily? how long shall mine enemy be exalted over me?
verses.am: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, {having} sorrow in my heart daily? how long shall mine enemy be exalted over me?

verses.en: Consider and hear me, O YAHUAH my YAHUAH: lighten mine eyes, lest I sleep the sleep of death;
verses.am: Consider {and} hear me, O LORD my God: lighten mine eyes, lest I sleep the {sleep of} death;

verses.en: Lest mine enemy say, I have prevailed against him; and those that trouble me rejoice when I am moved.
verses.am: Lest mine enemy say, I have prevailed against him; {and} those that trouble me rejoice when I am moved.

verses.en: But I have trusted in thy mercy; my heart shall rejoice in thy salvation.
verses.am: But I have trusted in thy mercy; my heart shall rejoice in thy salvation.

verses.en: I will sing unto YAHUAH, because he hath dealt bountifully with me.
verses.am: I will sing unto the LORD, because he hath dealt bountifully with me.

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of Dawid.] The fool hath said in his heart, There is no YAHUAH. They are corrupt, they have done abominable works, there is none that doeth good.
verses.am: [To the chief Musician, {A Psalm} of David.] The fool hath said in his heart, {There is} no God. They are corrupt, they have done abominable works, {there is} none that doeth good.

verses.en: YAHUAH looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, and seek YAHUAH.
verses.am: The LORD looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, {and} seek God.

verses.en: They are all gone aside, they are all together become filthy: there is none that doeth good, no, not one.
verses.am: They are all gone aside, they are {all} together become filthy: {there is} none that doeth good, no, not one. {filthy: Heb. stinking}

verses.en: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread, and call not upon YAHUAH.
verses.am: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people {as} they eat bread, and call not upon the LORD.

verses.en: There were they in great fear: for YAHUAH is in the generation of the righteous.
verses.am: There were they in great fear: for God {is} in the generation of the righteous. {were...: Heb. they feared a fear}

verses.en: Ye have shamed the counsel of the poor, because YAHUAH is his refuge.
verses.am: Ye have shamed the counsel of the poor, because the LORD {is} his refuge.

verses.en: Oh that the salvation of Yisra'el were come out of Zion! when YAHUAH bringeth back the captivity of his people, Ya'aqob shall rejoice, and Yisra'el shall be glad.
verses.am: Oh that the salvation of Israel {were come} out of Zion! when the LORD bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, {and} Israel shall be glad. {Oh...: Heb. Who will give}

verses.en: [A Psalm of Dawid.] YAHUAH, who shall abide in thy tabernacle? who shall dwell in thy holy hill?
verses.am: [A Psalm of David.] LORD, who shall abide in thy tabernacle? who shall dwell in thy holy hill? {abide: Heb. sojourn}

verses.en: He that walketh uprightly, and worketh righteousness, and speaketh the truth in his heart.
verses.am: He that walketh uprightly, and worketh righteousness, and speaketh the truth in his heart.

verses.en: He that backbiteth not with his tongue, nor doeth evil to his neighbour, nor taketh up a reproach against his neighbour.
verses.am: {He that} backbiteth not with his tongue, nor doeth evil to his neighbour, nor taketh up a reproach against his neighbour. {taketh...: or, receiveth, or, endureth}

verses.en: In whose eyes a vile person is contemned; but he honoureth them that fear YAHUAH. He that sweareth to his own hurt, and changeth not.
verses.am: In whose eyes a vile person is contemned; but he honoureth them that fear the LORD. {He that} sweareth to {his own} hurt, and changeth not.

verses.en: He that putteth not out his money to usury, nor taketh reward against the innocent. He that doeth these things shall never be moved.
verses.am: {He that} putteth not out his money to usury, nor taketh reward against the innocent. He that doeth these {things} shall never be moved.

verses.en: [Michtam of Dawid.] Preserve me, O YAHUAH: for in thee do I put my trust.
verses.am: [Michtam of David.] Preserve me, O God: for in thee do I put my trust. {Michtam: or, A golden Psalm}

verses.en: O my soul, thou hast said unto YAHUAH, Thou art my Master: my goodness extendeth not to thee;
verses.am: {O my soul}, thou hast said unto the LORD, Thou {art} my Lord: my goodness {extendeth} not to thee;

verses.en: But to the saints that are in the earth, and to the excellent, in whom is all my delight.
verses.am: {But} to the saints that {are} in the earth, and {to} the excellent, in whom {is} all my delight.

verses.en: Their sorrows shall be multiplied that hasten after another god: their drink offerings of blood will I not offer, nor take up their names into my lips.
verses.am: Their sorrows shall be multiplied {that} hasten {after} another {god}: their drink offerings of blood will I not offer, nor take up their names into my lips. {hasten...: or, give gifts to another}

verses.en: YAHUAH is the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup: thou maintainest my lot.
verses.am: The LORD {is} the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup: thou maintainest my lot. {of mine...: Heb. of my part}

verses.en: The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; yea, I have a goodly heritage.
verses.am: The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant {places}; yea, I have a goodly heritage.

verses.en: I will bless YAHUAH, who hath given me counsel: my reins also instruct me in the night seasons.
verses.am: I will bless the LORD, who hath given me counsel: my reins also instruct me in the night seasons.

verses.en: I have set YAHUAH always before me: because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
verses.am: I have set the LORD always before me: because {he is} at my right hand, I shall not be moved.

verses.en: Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth: my flesh also shall rest in hope.
verses.am: Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth: my flesh also shall rest in hope. {rest...: Heb. dwell confidently}

verses.en: For thou wilt not leave my soul in hell; neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.
verses.am: For thou wilt not leave my soul in hell; neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.

verses.en: Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence is fulness of joy; at thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.
verses.am: Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence {is} fulness of joy; at thy right hand {there are} pleasures for evermore.

verses.en: [A Prayer of Dawid.] Hear the right, O YAHUAH, attend unto my cry, give ear unto my prayer, that goeth not out of feigned lips.
verses.am: [A Prayer of David.] Hear the right, O LORD, attend unto my cry, give ear unto my prayer, {that goeth} not out of feigned lips. {the right: Heb. justice} {not...: Heb. without lips of deceit}

verses.en: Let my sentence come forth from thy presence; let thine eyes behold the things that are equal.
verses.am: Let my sentence come forth from thy presence; let thine eyes behold the things that are equal.

verses.en: Thou hast proved mine heart; thou hast visited me in the night; thou hast tried me, and shalt find nothing; I am purposed that my mouth shall not transgress.
verses.am: Thou hast proved mine heart; thou hast visited {me} in the night; thou hast tried me, {and} shalt find nothing; I am purposed {that} my mouth shall not transgress.

verses.en: Concerning the works of men, by the word of thy lips I have kept me from the paths of the destroyer.
verses.am: Concerning the works of men, by the word of thy lips I have kept {me from} the paths of the destroyer.

verses.en: Hold up my goings in thy paths, that my footsteps slip not.
verses.am: Hold up my goings in thy paths, {that} my footsteps slip not. {slip...: Heb. be not moved}

verses.en: I have called upon thee, for thou wilt hear me, O YAHUAH: incline thine ear unto me, and hear my speech.
verses.am: I have called upon thee, for thou wilt hear me, O God: incline thine ear unto me, {and hear} my speech.

verses.en: Shew thy marvellous lovingkindness, O thou that savest by thy right hand them which put their trust in thee from those that rise up against them.
verses.am: Shew thy marvellous lovingkindness, O thou that savest by thy right hand them which put their trust {in thee} from those that rise up {against them}. {by thy...: or, them which trust in thee from those that rise up against thy right hand}

verses.en: Keep me as the apple of the eye, hide me under the shadow of thy wings,
verses.am: Keep me as the apple of the eye, hide me under the shadow of thy wings,

verses.en: From the wicked that oppress me, from my deadly enemies, who compass me about.
verses.am: From the wicked that oppress me, {from} my deadly enemies, {who} compass me about. {oppress: Heb. waste} {my...: Heb. my enemies against the soul}

verses.en: They are inclosed in their own fat: with their mouth they speak proudly.
verses.am: They are inclosed in their own fat: with their mouth they speak proudly.

verses.en: They have now compassed us in our steps: they have set their eyes bowing down to the earth;
verses.am: They have now compassed us in our steps: they have set their eyes bowing down to the earth;

verses.en: Like as a lion that is greedy of his prey, and as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.
verses.am: Like as a lion {that} is greedy of his prey, and as it were a young lion lurking in secret places. {Like...: Heb. The likeness of him (that is, of every one of them) is as a lion that desireth to ravin} {lurking: Heb. sitting}

verses.en: Arise, O YAHUAH, disappoint him, cast him down: deliver my soul from the wicked, which is thy sword:
verses.am: Arise, O LORD, disappoint him, cast him down: deliver my soul from the wicked, {which is} thy sword: {disappoint...: Heb. prevent his face} {which is: or, by}

verses.en: From men which are thy hand, O YAHUAH, from men of the world, which have their portion in this life, and whose belly thou fillest with thy hid treasure: they are full of children, and leave the rest of their substance to their babes.
verses.am: From men {which are} thy hand, O LORD, from men of the world, {which have} their portion in {this} life, and whose belly thou fillest with thy hid {treasure}: they are full of children, and leave the rest of their {substance} to their babes. {which are: or, by} {they...: or, their children are full}

verses.en: As for me, I will behold thy face in righteousness: I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with thy likeness.
verses.am: As for me, I will behold thy face in righteousness: I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with thy likeness.

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of Dawid, the servant of YAHUAH, who spake unto YAHUAH the words of this song in the day that YAHUAH delivered him from the hand of all his enemies, and from the hand of Sha'ul: And he said,] I will love thee, O YAHUAH, my strength.
verses.am: [To the chief Musician, {A Psalm} of David, the servant of the LORD, who spake unto the LORD the words of this song in the day {that} the LORD delivered him from the hand of all his enemies, and from the hand of Saul: And he said,] I will love thee, O LORD, my strength.

verses.en: YAHUAH is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my YAHUAH, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.
verses.am: The LORD {is} my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, {and} my high tower. {my strength: Heb. my rock}

verses.en: I will call upon YAHUAH, who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.
verses.am: I will call upon the LORD, {who is worthy} to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.

verses.en: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the floods of ungodly men made me afraid.
verses.am: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the floods of ungodly men made me afraid. {ungodly men: Heb. Belial}

verses.en: The sorrows of hell compassed me about: the snares of death prevented me.
verses.am: The sorrows of hell compassed me about: the snares of death prevented me. {sorrows: or, cords}

verses.en: In my distress I called upon YAHUAH, and cried unto my YAHUAH: he heard my voice out of his temple, and my cry came before him, even into his ears.
verses.am: In my distress I called upon the LORD, and cried unto my God: he heard my voice out of his temple, and my cry came before him, {even} into his ears.

verses.en: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations also of the hills moved and were shaken, because he was wroth.
verses.am: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations also of the hills moved and were shaken, because he was wroth.

verses.en: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.
verses.am: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it. {out of his nostrils: Heb. by his, etc}

verses.en: He bowed the heavens also, and came down: and darkness was under his feet.
verses.am: He bowed the heavens also, and came down: and darkness {was} under his feet.

verses.en: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: yea, he did fly upon the wings of the wind.
verses.am: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: yea, he did fly upon the wings of the wind.

verses.en: He made darkness his secret place; his pavilion round about him were dark waters and thick clouds of the skies.
verses.am: He made darkness his secret place; his pavilion round about him {were} dark waters {and} thick clouds of the skies.

verses.en: At the brightness that was before him his thick clouds passed, hail stones and coals of fire.
verses.am: At the brightness {that was} before him his thick clouds passed, hail {stones} and coals of fire.

verses.en: YAHUAH also thundered in the heavens, and the Highest gave his voice; hail stones and coals of fire.
verses.am: The LORD also thundered in the heavens, and the Highest gave his voice; hail {stones} and coals of fire.

verses.en: Yea, he sent out his arrows, and scattered them; and he shot out lightnings, and discomfited them.
verses.am: Yea, he sent out his arrows, and scattered them; and he shot out lightnings, and discomfited them.

verses.en: Then the channels of waters were seen, and the foundations of the world were discovered at thy rebuke, O YAHUAH, at the blast of the breath of thy nostrils.
verses.am: Then the channels of waters were seen, and the foundations of the world were discovered at thy rebuke, O LORD, at the blast of the breath of thy nostrils.

verses.en: He sent from above, he took me, he drew me out of many waters.
verses.am: He sent from above, he took me, he drew me out of many waters. {many: or, great}

verses.en: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them which hated me: for they were too strong for me.
verses.am: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them which hated me: for they were too strong for me.

verses.en: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but YAHUAH was my stay.
verses.am: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the LORD was my stay.

verses.en: He brought me forth also into a large place; he delivered me, because he delighted in me.
verses.am: He brought me forth also into a large place; he delivered me, because he delighted in me.

verses.en: YAHUAH rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.
verses.am: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.

verses.en: For I have kept the ways of YAHUAH, and have not wickedly departed from my YAHUAH.
verses.am: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

verses.en: For all his judgments were before me, and I did not put away his statutes from me.
verses.am: For all his judgments {were} before me, and I did not put away his statutes from me.

verses.en: I was also upright before him, and I kept myself from mine iniquity.
verses.am: I was also upright before him, and I kept myself from mine iniquity. {before: Heb. with}

verses.en: Therefore hath YAHUAH recompensed me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.
verses.am: Therefore hath the LORD recompensed me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight. {in...: Heb. before his eyes}

verses.en: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful; with an upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright;
verses.am: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful; with an upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright;

verses.en: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself froward.
verses.am: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself froward. {shew thyself froward: or, wrestle}

verses.en: For thou wilt save the afflicted people; but wilt bring down high looks.
verses.am: For thou wilt save the afflicted people; but wilt bring down high looks.

verses.en: For thou wilt light my candle: YAHUAH my YAHUAH will enlighten my darkness.
verses.am: For thou wilt light my candle: the LORD my God will enlighten my darkness. {candle: or, lamp}

verses.en: For by thee I have run through a troop; and by my YAHUAH have I leaped over a wall.
verses.am: For by thee I have run through a troop; and by my God have I leaped over a wall. {run...: or, broken}

verses.en: As for YAHUAH, his way is perfect: the word of YAHUAH is tried: he is a buckler to all those that trust in him.
verses.am: {As for} God, his way {is} perfect: the word of the LORD is tried: he {is} a buckler to all those that trust in him. {tried: or, refined}

verses.en: For who is YAHUAH save YAHUAH? or who is a rock save our YAHUAH?
verses.am: For who {is} God save the LORD? or who {is} a rock save our God?

verses.en: It is YAHUAH that girdeth me with strength, and maketh my way perfect.
verses.am: {It is} God that girdeth me with strength, and maketh my way perfect.

verses.en: He maketh my feet like hinds' feet, and setteth me upon my high places.
verses.am: He maketh my feet like hinds' {feet}, and setteth me upon my high places.

verses.en: He teacheth my hands to war, so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.
verses.am: He teacheth my hands to war, so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.

verses.en: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy right hand hath holden me up, and thy gentleness hath made me great.
verses.am: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy right hand hath holden me up, and thy gentleness hath made me great. {thy gentleness...: or, with thy meekness thou hast multiplied me}

verses.en: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me, that my feet did not slip.
verses.am: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me, that my feet did not slip. {my feet: Heb. mine ankles}

verses.en: I have pursued mine enemies, and overtaken them: neither did I turn again till they were consumed.
verses.am: I have pursued mine enemies, and overtaken them: neither did I turn again till they were consumed.

verses.en: I have wounded them that they were not able to rise: they are fallen under my feet.
verses.am: I have wounded them that they were not able to rise: they are fallen under my feet.

verses.en: For thou hast girded me with strength unto the battle: thou hast subdued under me those that rose up against me.
verses.am: For thou hast girded me with strength unto the battle: thou hast subdued under me those that rose up against me. {subdued: Heb. caused to bow}

verses.en: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies; that I might destroy them that hate me.
verses.am: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies; that I might destroy them that hate me.

verses.en: They cried, but there was none to save unto YAHUAH, but he answered them not.
verses.am: They cried, but {there was} none to save {them: even} unto the LORD, but he answered them not.

verses.en: Then did I beat them small as the dust before the wind: I did cast them out as the dirt in the streets.
verses.am: Then did I beat them small as the dust before the wind: I did cast them out as the dirt in the streets.

verses.en: Thou hast delivered me from the strivings of the people; and thou hast made me the head of the heathen: a people whom I have not known shall serve me.
verses.am: Thou hast delivered me from the strivings of the people; {and} thou hast made me the head of the heathen: a people {whom} I have not known shall serve me.

verses.en: As soon as they hear of me, they shall obey me: the strangers shall submit themselves unto me.
verses.am: As soon as they hear of me, they shall obey me: the strangers shall submit themselves unto me. {As soon...: Heb. At the hearing of the ear} {submit...: or, yield feigned obedience} {strangers: Heb. sons of the stranger}

verses.en: The strangers shall fade away, and be afraid out of their close places.
verses.am: The strangers shall fade away, and be afraid out of their close places. {strangers: Heb. sons of the stranger}

verses.en: YAHUAH liveth; and blessed be my rock; and let YAHUAH of my salvation be exalted.
verses.am: The LORD liveth; and blessed {be} my rock; and let the God of my salvation be exalted.

verses.en: It is YAHUAH that avengeth me, and subdueth the people under me.
verses.am: {It is} God that avengeth me, and subdueth the people under me. {avengeth: Heb. giveth avengements for} {subdueth: or, destroyeth}

verses.en: He delivereth me from mine enemies: yea, thou liftest me up above those that rise up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man.
verses.am: He delivereth me from mine enemies: yea, thou liftest me up above those that rise up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man. {violent...: Heb. man of violence}

verses.en: Therefore will I give thanks unto thee, O YAHUAH, among the heathen, and sing praises unto thy name.
verses.am: Therefore will I give thanks unto thee, O LORD, among the heathen, and sing praises unto thy name. {give...: or, confess}

verses.en: Great deliverance giveth he to his king; and sheweth mercy to his anointed, to Dawid, and to his seed for evermore.
verses.am: Great deliverance giveth he to his king; and sheweth mercy to his anointed, to David, and to his seed for evermore.

verses.en: The heavens declare the glory of YAHUAH; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.
verses.am: ሰማያት የእግዚአብሔርን ክብር ይናገራሉ፥ የእጁንም ሥራ ጠፈር ይናገራል።
verses.gez: ሰማያት ይነግሩ ስብሐተ እግዚአብሔር ወግብረ እደዊሁ ይዜንው ጠፈር።

verses.en: Day unto day uttereth speech, and night unto night sheweth knowledge.
verses.am: ቀን ለቀን ነገርን ያፈሳል፥ ሌሊትም ለሌሊት እውቀትን ይናገራል።

verses.en: There is no speech nor language, where their voice is not heard.
verses.am: ንግግርም የለም፥ ቃልም የለም፥ ድምፃቸውም አይሰማም።

verses.en: Their line is gone out through all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. In them hath he set a tabernacle for the sun.
verses.am: መሥመራቸው በምድር ሁሉ ወጥቶአል፥ ቃላቸውም እስከ ዓለም ዳርቻ። በእነርሱም ውስጥ ለፀሐይ ድንኳንን አደረገ።

verses.en: Which is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, and rejoiceth as a strong man to run a race.
verses.am: እርሱም እንደ ሙሽራ ከእልፍኙ ይወጣል፤ እንደ ኃያልም ሊሮጥ ደስ ይለዋል።

verses.en: His going forth is from the end of the heaven, and his circuit unto the ends of it: and there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.
verses.am: መውጫው ከሰማይ ዳርቻ ነው፥ ዙረቱም እስከ ዳርቻው፤ ከትኩሳቱም የሚሰወር የለም።

verses.en: The law of YAHUAH is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of YAHUAH is sure, making wise the simple.
verses.am: The law of the LORD {is} perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of the LORD {is} sure, making wise the simple. {law: or, doctrine} {converting: or, restoring}

verses.en: The statutes of YAHUAH are right, rejoicing the heart: the commandment of YAHUAH is pure, enlightening the eyes.
verses.am: The statutes of the LORD {are} right, rejoicing the heart: the commandment of the LORD {is} pure, enlightening the eyes.

verses.en: The fear of YAHUAH is clean, enduring for ever: the judgments of YAHUAH are true and righteous altogether.
verses.am: The fear of the LORD {is} clean, enduring for ever: the judgments of the LORD {are} true {and} righteous altogether. {true: Heb. truth}

verses.en: More to be desired are they than gold, yea, than much fine gold: sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb.
verses.am: More to be desired {are they} than gold, yea, than much fine gold: sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb. {the honeycomb: Heb. the dropping of honeycombs}

verses.en: Moreover by them is thy servant warned: and in keeping of them there is great reward.
verses.am: Moreover by them is thy servant warned: {and} in keeping of them {there is} great reward.

verses.en: Who can understand his errors? cleanse thou me from secret faults.
verses.am: Who can understand {his} errors? cleanse thou me from secret {faults}.

verses.en: Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous sins; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be upright, and I shall be innocent from the great transgression.
verses.am: Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous {sins}; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be upright, and I shall be innocent from the great transgression. {the great: or, much}

verses.en: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O YAHUAH, my strength, and my redeemer.
verses.am: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O LORD, my strength, and my redeemer. {strength: Heb. rock}

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of Dawid.] YAHUAH hear thee in the day of trouble; the name of YAHUAH of Ya'aqob defend thee;
verses.am: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.] The LORD hear thee in the day of trouble; the name of the God of Jacob defend thee; {defend...: Heb. set thee on an high place}

verses.en: Send thee help from the sanctuary, and strengthen thee out of Zion;
verses.am: Send thee help from the sanctuary, and strengthen thee out of Zion; {thee help: Heb. thy help} {strengthen: Heb. support}

verses.en: Remember all thy offerings, and accept thy burnt sacrifice; Selah.
verses.am: Remember all thy offerings, and accept thy burnt sacrifice; Selah. {accept: Heb. turn to ashes: or, make fat}

verses.en: Grant thee according to thine own heart, and fulfil all thy counsel.
verses.am: Grant thee according to thine own heart, and fulfil all thy counsel.

verses.en: We will rejoice in thy salvation, and in the name of our YAHUAH we will set up our banners: YAHUAH fulfil all thy petitions.
verses.am: We will rejoice in thy salvation, and in the name of our God we will set up {our} banners: the LORD fulfil all thy petitions.

verses.en: Now know I that YAHUAH saveth his anointed; he will hear him from his holy heaven with the saving strength of his right hand.
verses.am: Now know I that the LORD saveth his anointed; he will hear him from his holy heaven with the saving strength of his right hand. {his holy...: Heb. the heaven of his holiness} {with...: Heb. by the strength of the salvation of}

verses.en: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of YAHUAH our YAHUAH.
verses.am: Some {trust} in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of the LORD our God.

verses.en: They are brought down and fallen: but we are risen, and stand upright.
verses.am: They are brought down and fallen: but we are risen, and stand upright.

verses.en: Save, YAHUAH: let the king hear us when we call.
verses.am: Save, LORD: let the king hear us when we call.

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of Dawid.] The king shall joy in thy strength, O YAHUAH; and in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!
verses.am: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.] The king shall joy in thy strength, O LORD; and in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!

verses.en: Thou hast given him his heart's desire, and hast not withholden the request of his lips. Selah.
verses.am: Thou hast given him his heart's desire, and hast not withholden the request of his lips. Selah.

verses.en: For thou preventest him with the blessings of goodness: thou settest a crown of pure gold on his head.
verses.am: For thou preventest him with the blessings of goodness: thou settest a crown of pure gold on his head.

verses.en: He asked life of thee, and thou gavest it him, even length of days for ever and ever.
verses.am: He asked life of thee, {and} thou gavest {it} him, {even} length of days for ever and ever.

verses.en: His glory is great in thy salvation: honour and majesty hast thou laid upon him.
verses.am: His glory {is} great in thy salvation: honour and majesty hast thou laid upon him.

verses.en: For thou hast made him most blessed for ever: thou hast made him exceeding glad with thy countenance.
verses.am: For thou hast made him most blessed for ever: thou hast made him exceeding glad with thy countenance. {made him most...: Heb. set him to be blessings} {made him exceeding...: Heb. make him glad with joy}

verses.en: For the king trusteth in YAHUAH, and through the mercy of the most High he shall not be moved.
verses.am: For the king trusteth in the LORD, and through the mercy of the most High he shall not be moved.

verses.en: Thine hand shall find out all thine enemies: thy right hand shall find out those that hate thee.
verses.am: Thine hand shall find out all thine enemies: thy right hand shall find out those that hate thee.

verses.en: Thou shalt make them as a fiery oven in the time of thine anger: YAHUAH shall swallow them up in his wrath, and the fire shall devour them.
verses.am: Thou shalt make them as a fiery oven in the time of thine anger: the LORD shall swallow them up in his wrath, and the fire shall devour them.

verses.en: Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.
verses.am: Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.

verses.en: For they intended evil against thee: they imagined a mischievous device, which they are not able to perform.
verses.am: For they intended evil against thee: they imagined a mischievous device, {which} they are not able {to perform}.

verses.en: Therefore shalt thou make them turn their back, when thou shalt make ready thine arrows upon thy strings against the face of them.
verses.am: Therefore shalt thou make them turn their back, {when} thou shalt make ready {thine arrows} upon thy strings against the face of them. {shalt thou...: or, thou shalt set them as a butt} {back: Heb. shoulder}

verses.en: Be thou exalted, YAHUAH, in thine own strength: so will we sing and praise thy power.
verses.am: Be thou exalted, LORD, in thine own strength: {so} will we sing and praise thy power.

verses.en: [To the chief Musician upon Aijeleth Shahar, A Psalm of Dawid.] My YAHUAH, my YAHUAH, why hast thou forsaken me? why art thou so far from helping me, and from the words of my roaring?
verses.am: [To the chief Musician upon Aijeleth Shahar, A Psalm of David.] My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me? {why art thou so} far from helping me, {and from} the words of my roaring? {Aijeleth...: or, the hind of the morning} {helping...: Heb. my salvation}

verses.en: O my YAHUAH, I cry in the daytime, but thou hearest not; and in the night season, and am not silent.
verses.am: O my God, I cry in the daytime, but thou hearest not; and in the night season, and am not silent. {am...: Heb. there is no silence to me}

verses.en: But thou art holy, O thou that inhabitest the praises of Yisra'el.
verses.am: But thou {art} holy, {O thou} that inhabitest the praises of Israel.

verses.en: Our fathers trusted in thee: they trusted, and thou didst deliver them.
verses.am: Our fathers trusted in thee: they trusted, and thou didst deliver them.

verses.en: They cried unto thee, and were delivered: they trusted in thee, and were not confounded.
verses.am: They cried unto thee, and were delivered: they trusted in thee, and were not confounded.

verses.en: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised of the people.
verses.am: But I {am} a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised of the people.

verses.en: All they that see me laugh me to scorn: they shoot out the lip, they shake the head, saying,
verses.am: All they that see me laugh me to scorn: they shoot out the lip, they shake the head, {saying}, {shoot...: Heb. open}

verses.en: He trusted on YAHUAH that he would deliver him: let him deliver him, seeing he delighted in him.
verses.am: He trusted on the LORD {that} he would deliver him: let him deliver him, seeing he delighted in him. {He trusted...: Heb. He rolled himself on} {seeing...: or, if he delight in}

verses.en: But thou art he that took me out of the womb: thou didst make me hope when I was upon my mother's breasts.
verses.am: But thou {art} he that took me out of the womb: thou didst make me hope {when I was} upon my mother's breasts. {didst...: or, kept me in safety}

verses.en: I was cast upon thee from the womb: thou art my YAHUAH from my mother's belly.
verses.am: I was cast upon thee from the womb: thou {art} my God from my mother's belly.

verses.en: Be not far from me; for trouble is near; for there is none to help.
verses.am: Be not far from me; for trouble {is} near; for {there is} none to help. {none...: Heb. not a helper}

verses.en: Many bulls have compassed me: strong bulls of Bashan have beset me round.
verses.am: Many bulls have compassed me: strong {bulls} of Bashan have beset me round.

verses.en: They gaped upon me with their mouths, as a ravening and a roaring lion.
verses.am: They gaped upon me {with} their mouths, {as} a ravening and a roaring lion. {gaped...: Heb. opened their mouths against me}

verses.en: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint: my heart is like wax; it is melted in the midst of my bowels.
verses.am: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint: my heart is like wax; it is melted in the midst of my bowels. {out of...: or, sundered}

verses.en: My strength is dried up like a potsherd; and my tongue cleaveth to my jaws; and thou hast brought me into the dust of death.
verses.am: My strength is dried up like a potsherd; and my tongue cleaveth to my jaws; and thou hast brought me into the dust of death.

verses.en: For dogs have compassed me: the assembly of the wicked have inclosed me: they pierced my hands and my feet.
verses.am: For dogs have compassed me: the assembly of the wicked have inclosed me: they pierced my hands and my feet.

verses.en: I may tell all my bones: they look and stare upon me.
verses.am: I may tell all my bones: they look {and} stare upon me.

verses.en: They part my garments among them, and cast lots upon my vesture.
verses.am: They part my garments among them, and cast lots upon my vesture.

verses.en: But be not thou far from me, O YAHUAH: O my strength, haste thee to help me.
verses.am: But be not thou far from me, O LORD: O my strength, haste thee to help me.

verses.en: Deliver my soul from the sword; my darling from the power of the dog.
verses.am: Deliver my soul from the sword; my darling from the power of the dog. {my darling: Heb. my only one} {power: Heb. hand}

verses.en: Save me from the lion's mouth: for thou hast heard me from the horns of the unicorns.
verses.am: Save me from the lion's mouth: for thou hast heard me from the horns of the unicorns.

verses.en: I will declare thy name unto my brethren: in the midst of the congregation will I praise thee.
verses.am: I will declare thy name unto my brethren: in the midst of the congregation will I praise thee.

verses.en: Ye that fear YAHUAH, praise him; all ye the seed of Ya'aqob, glorify him; and fear him, all ye the seed of Yisra'el.
verses.am: Ye that fear the LORD, praise him; all ye the seed of Jacob, glorify him; and fear him, all ye the seed of Israel.

verses.en: For he hath not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; neither hath he hid his face from him; but when he cried unto him, he heard.
verses.am: For he hath not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; neither hath he hid his face from him; but when he cried unto him, he heard.

verses.en: My praise shall be of thee in the great congregation: I will pay my vows before them that fear him.
verses.am: My praise {shall be} of thee in the great congregation: I will pay my vows before them that fear him.

verses.en: The meek shall eat and be satisfied: they shall praise YAHUAH that seek him: your heart shall live for ever.
verses.am: The meek shall eat and be satisfied: they shall praise the LORD that seek him: your heart shall live for ever.

verses.en: All the ends of the world shall remember and turn unto YAHUAH: and all the kindreds of the nations shall worship before thee.
verses.am: All the ends of the world shall remember and turn unto the LORD: and all the kindreds of the nations shall worship before thee.

verses.en: For the kingdom is YAHUAH's: and he is the governor among the nations.
verses.am: For the kingdom {is} the LORD'S: and he {is} the governor among the nations.

verses.en: All they that be fat upon earth shall eat and worship: all they that go down to the dust shall bow before him: and none can keep alive his own soul.
verses.am: All {they that be} fat upon earth shall eat and worship: all they that go down to the dust shall bow before him: and none can keep alive his own soul.

verses.en: A seed shall serve him; it shall be accounted to YAHUAH for a generation.
verses.am: A seed shall serve him; it shall be accounted to the Lord for a generation.

verses.en: They shall come, and shall declare his righteousness unto a people that shall be born, that he hath done this.
verses.am: They shall come, and shall declare his righteousness unto a people that shall be born, that he hath done {this}.

verses.en: YAHUAH is my shepherd; I shall not want.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እረኛዬ ነው፥ የሚያሳጣኝም የለም።

verses.en: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.
verses.am: በለመለመ መስክ ያሳድረኛል፤ በዕረፍት ውኃ ዘንድ ይመራኛል።

verses.en: He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.
verses.am: ነፍሴን ይመልሳል፤ ስለ ስሙም በጽድቅ ጎዳና ይመራኛል።

verses.en: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.
verses.am: በሞት ጥላ ሸለቆ ብሄድ እንኳ ክፉን አልፈራም፥ አንተ ከእኔ ጋር ነህና።
verses.gez: ወእመሂ ሖርኩ ውስተ ገዳመ ጽልመት፤ ኢይፈርህ እኪተ እስመ አንተ ምስሌየ አንተ።

verses.en: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over.
verses.am: በጠላቶቼ ፊት ማእድን በፊቴ አዘጋጀህ፤ ራሴን በዘይት ቀባህ፥ ጽዋዬም የተትረፈረፈ ነው።

verses.en: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of YAHUAH for ever.
verses.am: በሕይወቴ ዘመን ሁሉ ቸርነትና ምሕረት ይከተሉኛል፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ለዘላለም እኖራለሁ።

verses.en: [A Psalm of Dawid.] The earth is YAHUAH's, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.
verses.am: [A Psalm of David.] The earth {is} the LORD'S, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.

verses.en: For he hath founded it upon the seas, and established it upon the floods.
verses.am: For he hath founded it upon the seas, and established it upon the floods.

verses.en: Who shall ascend into the hill of YAHUAH? or who shall stand in his holy place?
verses.am: Who shall ascend into the hill of the LORD? or who shall stand in his holy place?

verses.en: He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart; who hath not lifted up his soul unto vanity, nor sworn deceitfully.
verses.am: He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart; who hath not lifted up his soul unto vanity, nor sworn deceitfully. {He...: Heb. The clean of hands}

verses.en: He shall receive the blessing from YAHUAH, and righteousness from YAHUAH of his salvation.
verses.am: He shall receive the blessing from the LORD, and righteousness from the God of his salvation.

verses.en: This is the generation of them that seek him, that seek thy face, O Ya'aqob. Selah.
verses.am: This {is} the generation of them that seek him, that seek thy face, O Jacob. Selah. {O Jacob: or, O God of Jacob}

verses.en: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; and be ye lift up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.
verses.am: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; and be ye lift up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.

verses.en: Who is this King of glory? YAHUAH strong and mighty, YAHUAH mighty in battle.
verses.am: Who {is} this King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.

verses.en: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; even lift them up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.
verses.am: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; even lift {them} up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.

verses.en: Who is this King of glory? YAHUAH of hosts, he is the King of glory. Selah.
verses.am: Who is this King of glory? The LORD of hosts, he {is} the King of glory. Selah.

verses.en: [A Psalm of Dawid.] Unto thee, O YAHUAH, do I lift up my soul.
verses.am: [{A Psalm} of David.] Unto thee, O LORD, do I lift up my soul.

verses.en: O my YAHUAH, I trust in thee: let me not be ashamed, let not mine enemies triumph over me.
verses.am: O my God, I trust in thee: let me not be ashamed, let not mine enemies triumph over me.

verses.en: Yea, let none that wait on thee be ashamed: let them be ashamed which transgress without cause.
verses.am: Yea, let none that wait on thee be ashamed: let them be ashamed which transgress without cause.

verses.en: Shew me thy ways, O YAHUAH; teach me thy paths.
verses.am: Shew me thy ways, O LORD; teach me thy paths.

verses.en: Lead me in thy truth, and teach me: for thou art YAHUAH of my salvation; on thee do I wait all the day.
verses.am: Lead me in thy truth, and teach me: for thou {art} the God of my salvation; on thee do I wait all the day.

verses.en: Remember, O YAHUAH, thy tender mercies and thy lovingkindnesses; for they have been ever of old.
verses.am: Remember, O LORD, thy tender mercies and thy lovingkindnesses; for they {have been} ever of old. {tender...: Heb. bowels}

verses.en: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: according to thy mercy remember thou me for thy goodness' sake, O YAHUAH.
verses.am: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: according to thy mercy remember thou me for thy goodness' sake, O LORD.

verses.en: Good and upright is YAHUAH: therefore will he teach sinners in the way.
verses.am: Good and upright {is} the LORD: therefore will he teach sinners in the way.

verses.en: The meek will he guide in judgment: and the meek will he teach his way.
verses.am: The meek will he guide in judgment: and the meek will he teach his way.

verses.en: All the paths of YAHUAH are mercy and truth unto such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.
verses.am: All the paths of the LORD {are} mercy and truth unto such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.

verses.en: For thy name's sake, O YAHUAH, pardon mine iniquity; for it is great.
verses.am: For thy name's sake, O LORD, pardon mine iniquity; for it {is} great.

verses.en: What man is he that feareth YAHUAH? him shall he teach in the way that he shall choose.
verses.am: What man {is} he that feareth the LORD? him shall he teach in the way {that} he shall choose.

verses.en: His soul shall dwell at ease; and his seed shall inherit the earth.
verses.am: His soul shall dwell at ease; and his seed shall inherit the earth. {dwell...: Heb. lodge in goodness}

verses.en: The secret of YAHUAH is with them that fear him; and he will shew them his covenant.
verses.am: The secret of the LORD {is} with them that fear him; and he will shew them his covenant. {and...: or, and his covenant to make them know it}

verses.en: Mine eyes are ever toward YAHUAH; for he shall pluck my feet out of the net.
verses.am: Mine eyes {are} ever toward the LORD; for he shall pluck my feet out of the net. {pluck: Heb. bring forth}

verses.en: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; for I am desolate and afflicted.
verses.am: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; for I {am} desolate and afflicted.

verses.en: The troubles of my heart are enlarged: O bring thou me out of my distresses.
verses.am: The troubles of my heart are enlarged: {O} bring thou me out of my distresses.

verses.en: Look upon mine affliction and my pain; and forgive all my sins.
verses.am: Look upon mine affliction and my pain; and forgive all my sins.

verses.en: Consider mine enemies; for they are many; and they hate me with cruel hatred.
verses.am: Consider mine enemies; for they are many; and they hate me with cruel hatred. {cruel...: Heb. hatred of violence}

verses.en: O keep my soul, and deliver me: let me not be ashamed; for I put my trust in thee.
verses.am: O keep my soul, and deliver me: let me not be ashamed; for I put my trust in thee.

verses.en: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me; for I wait on thee.
verses.am: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me; for I wait on thee.

verses.en: Redeem Yisra'el, O YAHUAH, out of all his troubles.
verses.am: Redeem Israel, O God, out of all his troubles.

verses.en: [A Psalm of Dawid.] Judge me, O YAHUAH; for I have walked in mine integrity: I have trusted also in YAHUAH; therefore I shall not slide.
verses.am: [{A Psalm} of David.] Judge me, O LORD; for I have walked in mine integrity: I have trusted also in the LORD; {therefore} I shall not slide.

verses.en: Examine me, O YAHUAH, and prove me; try my reins and my heart.
verses.am: Examine me, O LORD, and prove me; try my reins and my heart.

verses.en: For thy lovingkindness is before mine eyes: and I have walked in thy truth.
verses.am: For thy lovingkindness {is} before mine eyes: and I have walked in thy truth.
