verses.en: I have not sat with vain persons, neither will I go in with dissemblers.
verses.am: I have not sat with vain persons, neither will I go in with dissemblers.

verses.en: I have hated the congregation of evil doers; and will not sit with the wicked.
verses.am: I have hated the congregation of evil doers; and will not sit with the wicked.

verses.en: I will wash mine hands in innocency: so will I compass thine altar, O YAHUAH:
verses.am: I will wash mine hands in innocency: so will I compass thine altar, O LORD:

verses.en: That I may publish with the voice of thanksgiving, and tell of all thy wondrous works.
verses.am: That I may publish with the voice of thanksgiving, and tell of all thy wondrous works.

verses.en: YAHUAH, I have loved the habitation of thy house, and the place where thine honour dwelleth.
verses.am: LORD, I have loved the habitation of thy house, and the place where thine honour dwelleth. {where...: Heb. of the tabernacle of thy honour}

verses.en: Gather not my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloody men:
verses.am: Gather not my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloody men: {Gather...: or, Take not away} {bloody...: Heb. men of blood}

verses.en: In whose hands is mischief, and their right hand is full of bribes.
verses.am: In whose hands {is} mischief, and their right hand is full of bribes. {full...: Heb. filled with}

verses.en: But as for me, I will walk in mine integrity: redeem me, and be merciful unto me.
verses.am: But as for me, I will walk in mine integrity: redeem me, and be merciful unto me.

verses.en: My foot standeth in an even place: in the congregations will I bless YAHUAH.
verses.am: My foot standeth in an even place: in the congregations will I bless the LORD.

verses.en: [A Psalm of Dawid.] YAHUAH is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? YAHUAH is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?
verses.am: [{A Psalm} of David.] The LORD {is} my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD {is} the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?

verses.en: When the wicked, even mine enemies and my foes, came upon me to eat up my flesh, they stumbled and fell.
verses.am: When the wicked, {even} mine enemies and my foes, came upon me to eat up my flesh, they stumbled and fell. {came...: Heb. approached against me}

verses.en: Though an host should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear: though war should rise against me, in this will I be confident.
verses.am: Though an host should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear: though war should rise against me, in this {will} I {be} confident.

verses.en: One thing have I desired of YAHUAH, that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of YAHUAH all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of YAHUAH, and to enquire in his temple.
verses.am: One {thing} have I desired of the LORD, that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the LORD, and to enquire in his temple. {the beauty: or, the delight}

verses.en: For in the time of trouble he shall hide me in his pavilion: in the secret of his tabernacle shall he hide me; he shall set me up upon a rock.
verses.am: For in the time of trouble he shall hide me in his pavilion: in the secret of his tabernacle shall he hide me; he shall set me up upon a rock.

verses.en: And now shall mine head be lifted up above mine enemies round about me: therefore will I offer in his tabernacle sacrifices of joy; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises unto YAHUAH.
verses.am: And now shall mine head be lifted up above mine enemies round about me: therefore will I offer in his tabernacle sacrifices of joy; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises unto the LORD. {joy: Heb. shouting}

verses.en: Hear, O YAHUAH, when I cry with my voice: have mercy also upon me, and answer me.
verses.am: Hear, O LORD, {when} I cry with my voice: have mercy also upon me, and answer me.

verses.en: When thou saidst, Seek ye my face; my heart said unto thee, Thy face, YAHUAH, will I seek.
verses.am: {When thou saidst}, Seek ye my face; my heart said unto thee, Thy face, LORD, will I seek. {When...: or, My heart said unto thee, Let my face seek thy face, etc}

verses.en: Hide not thy face far from me; put not thy servant away in anger: thou hast been my help; leave me not, neither forsake me, O YAHUAH of my salvation.
verses.am: Hide not thy face {far} from me; put not thy servant away in anger: thou hast been my help; leave me not, neither forsake me, O God of my salvation.

verses.en: When my father and my mother forsake me, then YAHUAH will take me up.
verses.am: When my father and my mother forsake me, then the LORD will take me up. {take...: Heb. gather me}

verses.en: Teach me thy way, O YAHUAH, and lead me in a plain path, because of mine enemies.
verses.am: Teach me thy way, O LORD, and lead me in a plain path, because of mine enemies. {a plain...: Heb. a way of plainness} {mine...: Heb. those which observe me}

verses.en: Deliver me not over unto the will of mine enemies: for false witnesses are risen up against me, and such as breathe out cruelty.
verses.am: Deliver me not over unto the will of mine enemies: for false witnesses are risen up against me, and such as breathe out cruelty.

verses.en: I had fainted, unless I had believed to see the goodness of YAHUAH in the land of the living.
verses.am: {I had fainted}, unless I had believed to see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.

verses.en: Wait on YAHUAH: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on YAHUAH.
verses.am: Wait on the LORD: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the LORD.

verses.en: [A Psalm of Dawid.] Unto thee will I cry, O YAHUAH my rock; be not silent to me: lest, if thou be silent to me, I become like them that go down into the pit.
verses.am: [{A Psalm} of David.] Unto thee will I cry, O LORD my rock; be not silent to me: lest, {if} thou be silent to me, I become like them that go down into the pit. {to me: Heb. from me}

verses.en: Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry unto thee, when I lift up my hands toward thy holy oracle.
verses.am: Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry unto thee, when I lift up my hands toward thy holy oracle. {thy...: or, the oracle of thy sanctuary}

verses.en: Draw me not away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, which speak peace to their neighbours, but mischief is in their hearts.
verses.am: Draw me not away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, which speak peace to their neighbours, but mischief {is} in their hearts.

verses.en: Give them according to their deeds, and according to the wickedness of their endeavours: give them after the work of their hands; render to them their desert.
verses.am: Give them according to their deeds, and according to the wickedness of their endeavours: give them after the work of their hands; render to them their desert.

verses.en: Because they regard not the works of YAHUAH, nor the operation of his hands, he shall destroy them, and not build them up.
verses.am: Because they regard not the works of the LORD, nor the operation of his hands, he shall destroy them, and not build them up.

verses.en: Blessed be YAHUAH, because he hath heard the voice of my supplications.
verses.am: Blessed {be} the LORD, because he hath heard the voice of my supplications.

verses.en: YAHUAH is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; and with my song will I praise him.
verses.am: The LORD {is} my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; and with my song will I praise him.

verses.en: YAHUAH is their strength, and he is the saving strength of his anointed.
verses.am: The LORD {is} their strength, and he {is} the saving strength of his anointed. {their: or, his} {saving...: Heb. strength of salvations}

verses.en: Save thy people, and bless thine inheritance: feed them also, and lift them up for ever.
verses.am: Save thy people, and bless thine inheritance: feed them also, and lift them up for ever. {feed: or, rule}

verses.en: [A Psalm of Dawid.] Give unto YAHUAH, O ye mighty, give unto YAHUAH glory and strength.
verses.am: [A Psalm of David.] Give unto the LORD, O ye mighty, give unto the LORD glory and strength. {ye mighty: Heb. ye sons of the mighty}

verses.en: Give unto YAHUAH the glory due unto his name; worship YAHUAH in the beauty of holiness.
verses.am: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name; worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness. {the glory...: Heb. the honour of his name} {in...: or, in his glorious sanctuary}

verses.en: The voice of YAHUAH is upon the waters: YAHUAH of glory thundereth: YAHUAH is upon many waters.
verses.am: The voice of the LORD {is} upon the waters: the God of glory thundereth: the LORD {is} upon many waters. {many: or, great}

verses.en: The voice of YAHUAH is powerful; the voice of YAHUAH is full of majesty.
verses.am: The voice of the LORD {is} powerful; the voice of the LORD {is} full of majesty. {powerful: Heb. in power} {full...: Heb. in majesty}

verses.en: The voice of YAHUAH breaketh the cedars; yea, YAHUAH breaketh the cedars of Lebanon.
verses.am: The voice of the LORD breaketh the cedars; yea, the LORD breaketh the cedars of Lebanon.

verses.en: He maketh them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young unicorn.
verses.am: He maketh them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young unicorn.

verses.en: The voice of YAHUAH divideth the flames of fire.
verses.am: The voice of the LORD divideth the flames of fire. {divideth: Heb. cutteth out}

verses.en: The voice of YAHUAH shaketh the wilderness; YAHUAH shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.
verses.am: The voice of the LORD shaketh the wilderness; the LORD shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.

verses.en: The voice of YAHUAH maketh the hinds to calve, and discovereth the forests: and in his temple doth every one speak of his glory.
verses.am: The voice of the LORD maketh the hinds to calve, and discovereth the forests: and in his temple doth every one speak of {his} glory. {to calve: or, to be in pain} {doth...: or, every whit of it uttereth, etc}

verses.en: YAHUAH sitteth upon the flood; yea, YAHUAH sitteth King for ever.
verses.am: The LORD sitteth upon the flood; yea, the LORD sitteth King for ever.

verses.en: YAHUAH will give strength unto his people; YAHUAH will bless his people with peace.
verses.am: The LORD will give strength unto his people; the LORD will bless his people with peace.

verses.en: [A Psalm and Song at the dedication of the house of Dawid.] I will extol thee, O YAHUAH; for thou hast lifted me up, and hast not made my foes to rejoice over me.
verses.am: [A Psalm {and} Song {at} the dedication of the house of David.] I will extol thee, O LORD; for thou hast lifted me up, and hast not made my foes to rejoice over me.

verses.en: O YAHUAH my YAHUAH, I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.
verses.am: O LORD my God, I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.

verses.en: O YAHUAH, thou hast brought up my soul from the grave: thou hast kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.
verses.am: O LORD, thou hast brought up my soul from the grave: thou hast kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

verses.en: Sing unto YAHUAH, O ye saints of his, and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
verses.am: Sing unto the LORD, O ye saints of his, and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness. {at...: or, to the memorial}

verses.en: For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.
verses.am: For his anger {endureth but} a moment; in his favour {is} life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy {cometh} in the morning. {his anger...: Heb. there is but a moment in his anger} {for a night: Heb. in the evening} {joy: Heb. singing}

verses.en: And in my prosperity I said, I shall never be moved.
verses.am: And in my prosperity I said, I shall never be moved.

verses.en: YAHUAH, by thy favour thou hast made my mountain to stand strong: thou didst hide thy face, and I was troubled.
verses.am: LORD, by thy favour thou hast made my mountain to stand strong: thou didst hide thy face, {and} I was troubled. {made...: Heb. settled strength for my mountain}

verses.en: I cried to thee, O YAHUAH; and unto YAHUAH I made supplication.
verses.am: I cried to thee, O LORD; and unto the LORD I made supplication.

verses.en: What profit is there in my blood, when I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise thee? shall it declare thy truth?
verses.am: What profit {is there} in my blood, when I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise thee? shall it declare thy truth?

verses.en: Hear, O YAHUAH, and have mercy upon me: YAHUAH, be thou my helper.
verses.am: Hear, O LORD, and have mercy upon me: LORD, be thou my helper.

verses.en: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing: thou hast put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;
verses.am: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing: thou hast put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;

verses.en: To the end that my glory may sing praise to thee, and not be silent. O YAHUAH my YAHUAH, I will give thanks unto thee for ever.
verses.am: To the end that {my} glory may sing praise to thee, and not be silent. O LORD my God, I will give thanks unto thee for ever. {my glory: that is, my tongue, or, my soul}

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of Dawid.] In thee, O YAHUAH, do I put my trust; let me never be ashamed: deliver me in thy righteousness.
verses.am: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.] In thee, O LORD, do I put my trust; let me never be ashamed: deliver me in thy righteousness.

verses.en: Bow down thine ear to me; deliver me speedily: be thou my strong rock, for an house of defence to save me.
verses.am: Bow down thine ear to me; deliver me speedily: be thou my strong rock, for an house of defence to save me. {my...: Heb. to me for a rock of strength}

verses.en: For thou art my rock and my fortress; therefore for thy name's sake lead me, and guide me.
verses.am: For thou {art} my rock and my fortress; therefore for thy name's sake lead me, and guide me.

verses.en: Pull me out of the net that they have laid privily for me: for thou art my strength.
verses.am: Pull me out of the net that they have laid privily for me: for thou {art} my strength.

verses.en: Into thine hand I commit my spirit: thou hast redeemed me, O YAHUAH of truth.
verses.am: Into thine hand I commit my spirit: thou hast redeemed me, O LORD God of truth.

verses.en: I have hated them that regard lying vanities: but I trust in YAHUAH.
verses.am: I have hated them that regard lying vanities: but I trust in the LORD.

verses.en: I will be glad and rejoice in thy mercy: for thou hast considered my trouble; thou hast known my soul in adversities;
verses.am: I will be glad and rejoice in thy mercy: for thou hast considered my trouble; thou hast known my soul in adversities;

verses.en: And hast not shut me up into the hand of the enemy: thou hast set my feet in a large room.
verses.am: And hast not shut me up into the hand of the enemy: thou hast set my feet in a large room.

verses.en: Have mercy upon me, O YAHUAH, for I am in trouble: mine eye is consumed with grief, yea, my soul and my belly.
verses.am: Have mercy upon me, O LORD, for I am in trouble: mine eye is consumed with grief, {yea}, my soul and my belly.

verses.en: For my life is spent with grief, and my years with sighing: my strength faileth because of mine iniquity, and my bones are consumed.
verses.am: For my life is spent with grief, and my years with sighing: my strength faileth because of mine iniquity, and my bones are consumed.

verses.en: I was a reproach among all mine enemies, but especially among my neighbours, and a fear to mine acquaintance: they that did see me without fled from me.
verses.am: I was a reproach among all mine enemies, but especially among my neighbours, and a fear to mine acquaintance: they that did see me without fled from me.

verses.en: I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am like a broken vessel.
verses.am: I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am like a broken vessel. {a broken...: Heb. a vessel that perisheth}

verses.en: For I have heard the slander of many: fear was on every side: while they took counsel together against me, they devised to take away my life.
verses.am: For I have heard the slander of many: fear {was} on every side: while they took counsel together against me, they devised to take away my life.

verses.en: But I trusted in thee, O YAHUAH: I said, Thou art my YAHUAH.
verses.am: But I trusted in thee, O LORD: I said, Thou {art} my God.

verses.en: My times are in thy hand: deliver me from the hand of mine enemies, and from them that persecute me.
verses.am: My times {are} in thy hand: deliver me from the hand of mine enemies, and from them that persecute me.

verses.en: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant: save me for thy mercies' sake.
verses.am: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant: save me for thy mercies' sake.

verses.en: Let me not be ashamed, O YAHUAH; for I have called upon thee: let the wicked be ashamed, and let them be silent in the grave.
verses.am: Let me not be ashamed, O LORD; for I have called upon thee: let the wicked be ashamed, {and} let them be silent in the grave. {silent...: or, cut off for}

verses.en: Let the lying lips be put to silence; which speak grievous things proudly and contemptuously against the righteous.
verses.am: Let the lying lips be put to silence; which speak grievous things proudly and contemptuously against the righteous. {grievous...: Heb. a hard thing}

verses.en: Oh how great is thy goodness, which thou hast laid up for them that fear thee; which thou hast wrought for them that trust in thee before the sons of men!
verses.am: {Oh} how great {is} thy goodness, which thou hast laid up for them that fear thee; {which} thou hast wrought for them that trust in thee before the sons of men!

verses.en: Thou shalt hide them in the secret of thy presence from the pride of man: thou shalt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.
verses.am: Thou shalt hide them in the secret of thy presence from the pride of man: thou shalt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.

verses.en: Blessed be YAHUAH: for he hath shewed me his marvellous kindness in a strong city.
verses.am: Blessed {be} the LORD: for he hath shewed me his marvellous kindness in a strong city. {strong: or, fenced}

verses.en: For I said in my haste, I am cut off from before thine eyes: nevertheless thou heardest the voice of my supplications when I cried unto thee.
verses.am: For I said in my haste, I am cut off from before thine eyes: nevertheless thou heardest the voice of my supplications when I cried unto thee.

verses.en: O love YAHUAH, all ye his saints: for YAHUAH preserveth the faithful, and plentifully rewardeth the proud doer.
verses.am: O love the LORD, all ye his saints: {for} the LORD preserveth the faithful, and plentifully rewardeth the proud doer.

verses.en: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in YAHUAH.
verses.am: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the LORD.

verses.en: [A Psalm of Dawid, Maschil.] Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
verses.am: [{A Psalm} of David, Maschil.] Blessed {is he whose} transgression {is} forgiven, {whose} sin {is} covered. {A Psalm...: or, A Psalm of David giving instruction}

verses.en: Blessed is the man unto whom YAHUAH imputeth not iniquity, and in whose spirit there is no guile.
verses.am: Blessed {is} the man unto whom the LORD imputeth not iniquity, and in whose spirit {there is} no guile.

verses.en: When I kept silence, my bones waxed old through my roaring all the day long.
verses.am: When I kept silence, my bones waxed old through my roaring all the day long.

verses.en: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: my moisture is turned into the drought of summer. Selah.
verses.am: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: my moisture is turned into the drought of summer. Selah.

verses.en: I acknowledged my sin unto thee, and mine iniquity have I not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions unto YAHUAH; and thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah.
verses.am: I acknowledged my sin unto thee, and mine iniquity have I not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions unto the LORD; and thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah.

verses.en: For this shall every one that is godly pray unto thee in a time when thou mayest be found: surely in the floods of great waters they shall not come nigh unto him.
verses.am: For this shall every one that is godly pray unto thee in a time when thou mayest be found: surely in the floods of great waters they shall not come nigh unto him. {when...: Heb. of finding}

verses.en: Thou art my hiding place; thou shalt preserve me from trouble; thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.
verses.am: Thou {art} my hiding place; thou shalt preserve me from trouble; thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.

verses.en: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine eye.
verses.am: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine eye. {guide...: Heb. counsel thee, mine eye shall be upon thee}

verses.en: Be ye not as the horse, or as the mule, which have no understanding: whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, lest they come near unto thee.
verses.am: Be ye not as the horse, {or} as the mule, {which} have no understanding: whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, lest they come near unto thee.

verses.en: Many sorrows shall be to the wicked: but he that trusteth in YAHUAH, mercy shall compass him about.
verses.am: Many sorrows {shall be} to the wicked: but he that trusteth in the LORD, mercy shall compass him about.

verses.en: Be glad in YAHUAH, and rejoice, ye righteous: and shout for joy, all ye that are upright in heart.
verses.am: Be glad in the LORD, and rejoice, ye righteous: and shout for joy, all {ye that are} upright in heart.

verses.en: Rejoice in YAHUAH, O ye righteous: for praise is comely for the upright.
verses.am: Rejoice in the LORD, O ye righteous: {for} praise is comely for the upright.

verses.en: Praise YAHUAH with harp: sing unto him with the psaltery and an instrument of ten strings.
verses.am: Praise the LORD with harp: sing unto him with the psaltery {and} an instrument of ten strings.

verses.en: Sing unto him a new song; play skilfully with a loud noise.
verses.am: Sing unto him a new song; play skilfully with a loud noise.

verses.en: For the word of YAHUAH is right; and all his works are done in truth.
verses.am: For the word of the LORD {is} right; and all his works {are done} in truth.

verses.en: He loveth righteousness and judgment: the earth is full of the goodness of YAHUAH.
verses.am: He loveth righteousness and judgment: the earth is full of the goodness of the LORD. {goodness: or, mercy}

verses.en: By the word of YAHUAH were the heavens made; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.
verses.am: By the word of the LORD were the heavens made; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.

verses.en: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as an heap: he layeth up the depth in storehouses.
verses.am: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as an heap: he layeth up the depth in storehouses.

verses.en: Let all the earth fear YAHUAH: let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.
verses.am: Let all the earth fear the LORD: let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.

verses.en: For he spake, and it was done; he commanded, and it stood fast.
verses.am: For he spake, and it was {done}; he commanded, and it stood fast.

verses.en: YAHUAH bringeth the counsel of the heathen to nought: he maketh the devices of the people of none effect.
verses.am: The LORD bringeth the counsel of the heathen to nought: he maketh the devices of the people of none effect. {bringeth: Heb. maketh frustrate}

verses.en: The counsel of YAHUAH standeth for ever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.
verses.am: The counsel of the LORD standeth for ever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations. {to all...: Heb. to generation and generation}

verses.en: Blessed is the nation whose YAHUAH is YAHUAH; and the people whom he hath chosen for his own inheritance.
verses.am: Blessed {is} the nation whose God {is} the LORD; {and} the people {whom} he hath chosen for his own inheritance.

verses.en: YAHUAH looketh from heaven; he beholdeth all the sons of men.
verses.am: The LORD looketh from heaven; he beholdeth all the sons of men.

verses.en: From the place of his habitation he looketh upon all the inhabitants of the earth.
verses.am: From the place of his habitation he looketh upon all the inhabitants of the earth.

verses.en: He fashioneth their hearts alike; he considereth all their works.
verses.am: He fashioneth their hearts alike; he considereth all their works.

verses.en: There is no king saved by the multitude of an host: a mighty man is not delivered by much strength.
verses.am: There is no king saved by the multitude of an host: a mighty man is not delivered by much strength.

verses.en: An horse is a vain thing for safety: neither shall he deliver any by his great strength.
verses.am: An horse {is} a vain thing for safety: neither shall he deliver {any} by his great strength.

verses.en: Behold, the eye of YAHUAH is upon them that fear him, upon them that hope in his mercy;
verses.am: Behold, the eye of the LORD {is} upon them that fear him, upon them that hope in his mercy;

verses.en: To deliver their soul from death, and to keep them alive in famine.
verses.am: To deliver their soul from death, and to keep them alive in famine.

verses.en: Our soul waiteth for YAHUAH: he is our help and our shield.
verses.am: Our soul waiteth for the LORD: he {is} our help and our shield.

verses.en: For our heart shall rejoice in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.
verses.am: For our heart shall rejoice in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.

verses.en: Let thy mercy, O YAHUAH, be upon us, according as we hope in thee.
verses.am: Let thy mercy, O LORD, be upon us, according as we hope in thee.

verses.en: [A Psalm of Dawid, when he changed his behaviour before Abimelech; who drove him away, and he departed.] I will bless YAHUAH at all times: his praise shall continually be in my mouth.
verses.am: [{A Psalm} of David, when he changed his behaviour before Abimelech; who drove him away, and he departed.] I will bless the LORD at all times: his praise {shall} continually {be} in my mouth. {Abimelech: or, Achish}

verses.en: My soul shall make her boast in YAHUAH: the humble shall hear thereof, and be glad.
verses.am: My soul shall make her boast in the LORD: the humble shall hear {thereof}, and be glad.

verses.en: O magnify YAHUAH with me, and let us exalt his name together.
verses.am: O magnify the LORD with me, and let us exalt his name together.

verses.en: I sought YAHUAH, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.
verses.am: I sought the LORD, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.

verses.en: They looked unto him, and were lightened: and their faces were not ashamed.
verses.am: They looked unto him, and were lightened: and their faces were not ashamed. {were lightened: or, they flowed unto him}

verses.en: This poor man cried, and YAHUAH heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
verses.am: This poor man cried, and the LORD heard {him}, and saved him out of all his troubles.

verses.en: The angel of YAHUAH encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them.
verses.am: The angel of the LORD encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them.

verses.en: O taste and see that YAHUAH is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.
verses.am: O taste and see that the LORD {is} good: blessed {is} the man {that} trusteth in him.

verses.en: O fear YAHUAH, ye his saints: for there is no want to them that fear him.
verses.am: O fear the LORD, ye his saints: for {there is} no want to them that fear him.

verses.en: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger: but they that seek YAHUAH shall not want any good thing.
verses.am: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger: but they that seek the LORD shall not want any good {thing}.

verses.en: Come, ye children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of YAHUAH.
verses.am: Come, ye children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of the LORD.

verses.en: What man is he that desireth life, and loveth many days, that he may see good?
verses.am: What man {is he that} desireth life, {and} loveth {many} days, that he may see good?

verses.en: Keep thy tongue from evil, and thy lips from speaking guile.
verses.am: Keep thy tongue from evil, and thy lips from speaking guile.

verses.en: Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.
verses.am: Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.

verses.en: The eyes of YAHUAH are upon the righteous, and his ears are open unto their cry.
verses.am: The eyes of the LORD {are} upon the righteous, and his ears {are open} unto their cry.

verses.en: The face of YAHUAH is against them that do evil, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.
verses.am: The face of the LORD {is} against them that do evil, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.

verses.en: The righteous cry, and YAHUAH heareth, and delivereth them out of all their troubles.
verses.am: {The righteous} cry, and the LORD heareth, and delivereth them out of all their troubles.

verses.en: YAHUAH is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.
verses.am: The LORD {is} nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit. {unto...: Heb. to the broken of heart} {of a contrite...: Heb. contrite of spirit}

verses.en: Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but YAHUAH delivereth him out of them all.
verses.am: Many {are} the afflictions of the righteous: but the LORD delivereth him out of them all.

verses.en: He keepeth all his bones: not one of them is broken.
verses.am: He keepeth all his bones: not one of them is broken.

verses.en: Evil shall slay the wicked: and they that hate the righteous shall be desolate.
verses.am: Evil shall slay the wicked: and they that hate the righteous shall be desolate. {desolate: or, guilty}

verses.en: YAHUAH redeemeth the soul of his servants: and none of them that trust in him shall be desolate.
verses.am: The LORD redeemeth the soul of his servants: and none of them that trust in him shall be desolate. {desolate: or, guilty}

verses.en: [A Psalm of Dawid.] Plead my cause, O YAHUAH, with them that strive with me: fight against them that fight against me.
verses.am: [{A Psalm} of David.] Plead {my cause}, O LORD, with them that strive with me: fight against them that fight against me.

verses.en: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for mine help.
verses.am: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for mine help.

verses.en: Draw out also the spear, and stop the way against them that persecute me: say unto my soul, I am thy salvation.
verses.am: Draw out also the spear, and stop {the way} against them that persecute me: say unto my soul, I {am} thy salvation.

verses.en: Let them be confounded and put to shame that seek after my soul: let them be turned back and brought to confusion that devise my hurt.
verses.am: Let them be confounded and put to shame that seek after my soul: let them be turned back and brought to confusion that devise my hurt.

verses.en: Let them be as chaff before the wind: and let the angel of YAHUAH chase them.
verses.am: Let them be as chaff before the wind: and let the angel of the LORD chase {them}.

verses.en: Let their way be dark and slippery: and let the angel of YAHUAH persecute them.
verses.am: Let their way be dark and slippery: and let the angel of the LORD persecute them. {dark...: Heb. darkness and slipperiness}

verses.en: For without cause have they hid for me their net in a pit, which without cause they have digged for my soul.
verses.am: For without cause have they hid for me their net {in} a pit, {which} without cause they have digged for my soul.

verses.en: Let destruction come upon him at unawares; and let his net that he hath hid catch himself: into that very destruction let him fall.
verses.am: Let destruction come upon him at unawares; and let his net that he hath hid catch himself: into that very destruction let him fall. {at...: Heb. which he knoweth not of}

verses.en: And my soul shall be joyful in YAHUAH: it shall rejoice in his salvation.
verses.am: And my soul shall be joyful in the LORD: it shall rejoice in his salvation.

verses.en: All my bones shall say, YAHUAH, who is like unto thee, which deliverest the poor from him that is too strong for him, yea, the poor and the needy from him that spoileth him?
verses.am: All my bones shall say, LORD, who {is} like unto thee, which deliverest the poor from him that is too strong for him, yea, the poor and the needy from him that spoileth him?

verses.en: False witnesses did rise up; they laid to my charge things that I knew not.
verses.am: False witnesses did rise up; they laid to my charge {things} that I knew not. {False...: Heb. Witnesses of wrong} {they...: Heb. they asked me}

verses.en: They rewarded me evil for good to the spoiling of my soul.
verses.am: They rewarded me evil for good {to} the spoiling of my soul. {spoiling: Heb. depriving}

verses.en: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth: I humbled my soul with fasting; and my prayer returned into mine own bosom.
verses.am: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing {was} sackcloth: I humbled my soul with fasting; and my prayer returned into mine own bosom. {humbled: or, afflicted}

verses.en: I behaved myself as though he had been my friend or brother: I bowed down heavily, as one that mourneth for his mother.
verses.am: I behaved myself as though {he had been} my friend {or} brother: I bowed down heavily, as one that mourneth {for his} mother. {behaved myself: Heb. walked} {as though...: Heb. as a friend, as a brother to me}

verses.en: But in mine adversity they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together: yea, the abjects gathered themselves together against me, and I knew it not; they did tear me, and ceased not:
verses.am: But in mine adversity they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together: {yea}, the abjects gathered themselves together against me, and I knew {it} not; they did tear {me}, and ceased not: {adversity: Heb. halting}

verses.en: With hypocritical mockers in feasts, they gnashed upon me with their teeth.
verses.am: With hypocritical mockers in feasts, they gnashed upon me with their teeth.

verses.en: YAHUAH, how long wilt thou look on? rescue my soul from their destructions, my darling from the lions.
verses.am: Lord, how long wilt thou look on? rescue my soul from their destructions, my darling from the lions. {darling: Heb. only one}

verses.en: I will give thee thanks in the great congregation: I will praise thee among much people.
verses.am: I will give thee thanks in the great congregation: I will praise thee among much people. {much: Heb. strong}

verses.en: Let not them that are mine enemies wrongfully rejoice over me: neither let them wink with the eye that hate me without a cause.
verses.am: Let not them that are mine enemies wrongfully rejoice over me: {neither} let them wink with the eye that hate me without a cause. {wrongfully: Heb. falsely}

verses.en: For they speak not peace: but they devise deceitful matters against them that are quiet in the land.
verses.am: For they speak not peace: but they devise deceitful matters against {them that are} quiet in the land.

verses.en: Yea, they opened their mouth wide against me, and said, Aha, aha, our eye hath seen it.
verses.am: Yea, they opened their mouth wide against me, {and} said, Aha, aha, our eye hath seen {it}.

verses.en: This thou hast seen, O YAHUAH: keep not silence: O YAHUAH, be not far from me.
verses.am: {This} thou hast seen, O LORD: keep not silence: O Lord, be not far from me.

verses.en: Stir up thyself, and awake to my judgment, even unto my cause, my YAHUAH and my Master.
verses.am: Stir up thyself, and awake to my judgment, {even} unto my cause, my God and my Lord.

verses.en: Judge me, O YAHUAH my YAHUAH, according to thy righteousness; and let them not rejoice over me.
verses.am: Judge me, O LORD my God, according to thy righteousness; and let them not rejoice over me.

verses.en: Let them not say in their hearts, Ah, so would we have it: let them not say, We have swallowed him up.
verses.am: Let them not say in their hearts, Ah, so would we have it: let them not say, We have swallowed him up. {Ah...: Heb. Ah, ah, our soul}

verses.en: Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion together that rejoice at mine hurt: let them be clothed with shame and dishonour that magnify themselves against me.
verses.am: Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion together that rejoice at mine hurt: let them be clothed with shame and dishonour that magnify {themselves} against me.

verses.en: Let them shout for joy, and be glad, that favour my righteous cause: yea, let them say continually, Let YAHUAH be magnified, which hath pleasure in the prosperity of his servant.
verses.am: Let them shout for joy, and be glad, that favour my righteous cause: yea, let them say continually, Let the LORD be magnified, which hath pleasure in the prosperity of his servant. {righteous...: Heb. righteousness}

verses.en: And my tongue shall speak of thy righteousness and of thy praise all the day long.
verses.am: And my tongue shall speak of thy righteousness {and} of thy praise all the day long.

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of Dawid the servant of YAHUAH.] The transgression of the wicked saith within my heart, that there is no fear of YAHUAH before his eyes.
verses.am: [To the chief Musician, {A Psalm} of David the servant of the LORD.] The transgression of the wicked saith within my heart, {that there is} no fear of God before his eyes.

verses.en: For he flattereth himself in his own eyes, until his iniquity be found to be hateful.
verses.am: For he flattereth himself in his own eyes, until his iniquity be found to be hateful. {until...: Heb. to find his iniquity to hate}

verses.en: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit: he hath left off to be wise, and to do good.
verses.am: The words of his mouth {are} iniquity and deceit: he hath left off to be wise, {and} to do good.

verses.en: He deviseth mischief upon his bed; he setteth himself in a way that is not good; he abhorreth not evil.
verses.am: He deviseth mischief upon his bed; he setteth himself in a way {that is} not good; he abhorreth not evil. {mischief: or, vanity}

verses.en: Thy mercy, O YAHUAH, is in the heavens; and thy faithfulness reacheth unto the clouds.
verses.am: Thy mercy, O LORD, {is} in the heavens; {and} thy faithfulness {reacheth} unto the clouds.

verses.en: Thy righteousness is like the great mountains; thy judgments are a great deep: O YAHUAH, thou preservest man and beast.
verses.am: Thy righteousness {is} like the great mountains; thy judgments {are} a great deep: O LORD, thou preservest man and beast. {the...: Heb. the mountains of God}

verses.en: How excellent is thy lovingkindness, O YAHUAH! therefore the children of men put their trust under the shadow of thy wings.
verses.am: How excellent {is} thy lovingkindness, O God! therefore the children of men put their trust under the shadow of thy wings. {excellent: Heb. precious}

verses.en: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of thy house; and thou shalt make them drink of the river of thy pleasures.
verses.am: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of thy house; and thou shalt make them drink of the river of thy pleasures. {abundantly...: Heb. watered}

verses.en: For with thee is the fountain of life: in thy light shall we see light.
verses.am: For with thee {is} the fountain of life: in thy light shall we see light.

verses.en: O continue thy lovingkindness unto them that know thee; and thy righteousness to the upright in heart.
verses.am: O continue thy lovingkindness unto them that know thee; and thy righteousness to the upright in heart. {continue: Heb. draw out at length}

verses.en: Let not the foot of pride come against me, and let not the hand of the wicked remove me.
verses.am: Let not the foot of pride come against me, and let not the hand of the wicked remove me.

verses.en: There are the workers of iniquity fallen: they are cast down, and shall not be able to rise.
verses.am: There are the workers of iniquity fallen: they are cast down, and shall not be able to rise.

verses.en: [A Psalm of Dawid.] Fret not thyself because of evildoers, neither be thou envious against the workers of iniquity.
verses.am: [{A Psalm} of David.] Fret not thyself because of evildoers, neither be thou envious against the workers of iniquity.

verses.en: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither as the green herb.
verses.am: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither as the green herb.

verses.en: Trust in YAHUAH, and do good; so shalt thou dwell in the land, and verily thou shalt be fed.
verses.am: Trust in the LORD, and do good; {so} shalt thou dwell in the land, and verily thou shalt be fed. {verily: Heb. in truth, or, stableness}

verses.en: Delight thyself also in YAHUAH; and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.
verses.am: Delight thyself also in the LORD; and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.

verses.en: Commit thy way unto YAHUAH; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.
verses.am: Commit thy way unto the LORD; trust also in him; and he shall bring {it} to pass. {Commit...: Heb. Roll thy way upon}

verses.en: And he shall bring forth thy righteousness as the light, and thy judgment as the noonday.
verses.am: And he shall bring forth thy righteousness as the light, and thy judgment as the noonday.

verses.en: Rest in YAHUAH, and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.
verses.am: Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass. {Rest in: Heb. Be silent to}

verses.en: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself in any wise to do evil.
verses.am: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself in any wise to do evil.

verses.en: For evildoers shall be cut off: but those that wait upon YAHUAH, they shall inherit the earth.
verses.am: For evildoers shall be cut off: but those that wait upon the LORD, they shall inherit the earth.

verses.en: For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: yea, thou shalt diligently consider his place, and it shall not be.
verses.am: For yet a little while, and the wicked {shall} not {be}: yea, thou shalt diligently consider his place, and it {shall} not {be}.

verses.en: But the meek shall inherit the earth; and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
verses.am: But the meek shall inherit the earth; and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.

verses.en: The wicked plotteth against the just, and gnasheth upon him with his teeth.
verses.am: The wicked plotteth against the just, and gnasheth upon him with his teeth. {plotteth: or, practiseth}

verses.en: YAHUAH shall laugh at him: for he seeth that his day is coming.
verses.am: The Lord shall laugh at him: for he seeth that his day is coming.

verses.en: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, and to slay such as be of upright conversation.
verses.am: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, {and} to slay such as be of upright conversation. {such...: Heb. the upright of way}

verses.en: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.
verses.am: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.

verses.en: A little that a righteous man hath is better than the riches of many wicked.
verses.am: A little that a righteous man hath {is} better than the riches of many wicked.

verses.en: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken: but YAHUAH upholdeth the righteous.
verses.am: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken: but the LORD upholdeth the righteous.

verses.en: YAHUAH knoweth the days of the upright: and their inheritance shall be for ever.
verses.am: The LORD knoweth the days of the upright: and their inheritance shall be for ever.

verses.en: They shall not be ashamed in the evil time: and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
verses.am: They shall not be ashamed in the evil time: and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.

verses.en: But the wicked shall perish, and the enemies of YAHUAH shall be as the fat of lambs: they shall consume; into smoke shall they consume away.
verses.am: But the wicked shall perish, and the enemies of the LORD {shall be} as the fat of lambs: they shall consume; into smoke shall they consume away. {the fat: Heb. the preciousness}

verses.en: The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again: but the righteous sheweth mercy, and giveth.
verses.am: The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again: but the righteous sheweth mercy, and giveth.

verses.en: For such as be blessed of him shall inherit the earth; and they that be cursed of him shall be cut off.
verses.am: For {such as be} blessed of him shall inherit the earth; and {they that be} cursed of him shall be cut off.

verses.en: The steps of a good man are ordered by YAHUAH: and he delighteth in his way.
verses.am: The steps of a {good} man are ordered by the LORD: and he delighteth in his way. {ordered: or, established}

verses.en: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for YAHUAH upholdeth him with his hand.
verses.am: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for the LORD upholdeth {him with} his hand.

verses.en: I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.
verses.am: I have been young, and {now} am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.

verses.en: He is ever merciful, and lendeth; and his seed is blessed.
verses.am: {He is} ever merciful, and lendeth; and his seed {is} blessed. {ever: Heb. all the day}

verses.en: Depart from evil, and do good; and dwell for evermore.
verses.am: Depart from evil, and do good; and dwell for evermore.

verses.en: For YAHUAH loveth judgment, and forsaketh not his saints; they are preserved for ever: but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.
verses.am: For the LORD loveth judgment, and forsaketh not his saints; they are preserved for ever: but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.

verses.en: The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein for ever.
verses.am: The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein for ever.

verses.en: The mouth of the righteous speaketh wisdom, and his tongue talketh of judgment.
verses.am: The mouth of the righteous speaketh wisdom, and his tongue talketh of judgment.

verses.en: The law of his YAHUAH is in his heart; none of his steps shall slide.
verses.am: The law of his God {is} in his heart; none of his steps shall slide. {steps: or, goings}

verses.en: The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeketh to slay him.
verses.am: The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeketh to slay him.

verses.en: YAHUAH will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.
verses.am: The LORD will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.

verses.en: Wait on YAHUAH, and keep his way, and he shall exalt thee to inherit the land: when the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see it.
verses.am: Wait on the LORD, and keep his way, and he shall exalt thee to inherit the land: when the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see {it}.

verses.en: I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a green bay tree.
verses.am: I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a green bay tree. {a green...: or, a green tree that groweth in his own soil}

verses.en: Yet he passed away, and, lo, he was not: yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.
verses.am: Yet he passed away, and, lo, he {was} not: yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.

verses.en: Marqos the perfect man, and behold the upright: for the end of that man is peace.
verses.am: Mark the perfect {man}, and behold the upright: for the end of {that} man {is} peace.

verses.en: But the transgressors shall be destroyed together: the end of the wicked shall be cut off.
verses.am: But the transgressors shall be destroyed together: the end of the wicked shall be cut off.

verses.en: But the salvation of the righteous is of YAHUAH: he is their strength in the time of trouble.
verses.am: But the salvation of the righteous {is} of the LORD: {he is} their strength in the time of trouble.

verses.en: And YAHUAH shall help them, and deliver them: he shall deliver them from the wicked, and save them, because they trust in him.
verses.am: And the LORD shall help them, and deliver them: he shall deliver them from the wicked, and save them, because they trust in him.

verses.en: [A Psalm of Dawid, to bring to remembrance.] O YAHUAH, rebuke me not in thy wrath: neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
verses.am: [A Psalm of David, to bring to remembrance.] O LORD, rebuke me not in thy wrath: neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.

verses.en: For thine arrows stick fast in me, and thy hand presseth me sore.
verses.am: For thine arrows stick fast in me, and thy hand presseth me sore.

verses.en: There is no soundness in my flesh because of thine anger; neither is there any rest in my bones because of my sin.
verses.am: {There is} no soundness in my flesh because of thine anger; neither {is there any} rest in my bones because of my sin. {rest: Heb. peace, or, health}

verses.en: For mine iniquities are gone over mine head: as an heavy burden they are too heavy for me.
verses.am: For mine iniquities are gone over mine head: as an heavy burden they are too heavy for me.

verses.en: My wounds stink and are corrupt because of my foolishness.
verses.am: My wounds stink {and} are corrupt because of my foolishness.

verses.en: I am troubled; I am bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.
verses.am: I am troubled; I am bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long. {troubled: Heb. wried}

verses.en: For my loins are filled with a loathsome disease: and there is no soundness in my flesh.
verses.am: For my loins are filled with a loathsome {disease}: and {there is} no soundness in my flesh.

verses.en: I am feeble and sore broken: I have roared by reason of the disquietness of my heart.
verses.am: I am feeble and sore broken: I have roared by reason of the disquietness of my heart.

verses.en: YAHUAH, all my desire is before thee; and my groaning is not hid from thee.
verses.am: Lord, all my desire {is} before thee; and my groaning is not hid from thee.

verses.en: My heart panteth, my strength faileth me: as for the light of mine eyes, it also is gone from me.
verses.am: My heart panteth, my strength faileth me: as for the light of mine eyes, it also is gone from me. {is gone...: Heb. is not with me}

verses.en: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my sore; and my kinsmen stand afar off.
verses.am: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my sore; and my kinsmen stand afar off. {sore: Heb. stroke} {my kinsmen: or, my neighbours}

verses.en: They also that seek after my life lay snares for me: and they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and imagine deceits all the day long.
verses.am: They also that seek after my life lay snares {for me}: and they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and imagine deceits all the day long.

verses.en: But I, as a deaf man, heard not; and I was as a dumb man that openeth not his mouth.
verses.am: But I, as a deaf {man}, heard not; and {I was} as a dumb man {that} openeth not his mouth.

verses.en: Thus I was as a man that heareth not, and in whose mouth are no reproofs.
verses.am: Thus I was as a man that heareth not, and in whose mouth {are} no reproofs.

verses.en: For in thee, O YAHUAH, do I hope: thou wilt hear, O YAHUAH my YAHUAH.
verses.am: For in thee, O LORD, do I hope: thou wilt hear, O Lord my God. {in...: or, thee do I wait for} {hear: or, answer}

verses.en: For I said, Hear me, lest otherwise they should rejoice over me: when my foot slippeth, they magnify themselves against me.
verses.am: For I said, {Hear me}, lest {otherwise} they should rejoice over me: when my foot slippeth, they magnify {themselves} against me.

verses.en: For I am ready to halt, and my sorrow is continually before me.
verses.am: For I {am} ready to halt, and my sorrow {is} continually before me. {to halt: Heb. for halting}

verses.en: For I will declare mine iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.
verses.am: For I will declare mine iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.

verses.en: But mine enemies are lively, and they are strong: and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.
verses.am: But mine enemies {are} lively, {and} they are strong: and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied. {are lively...: Heb. being living, are strong}

verses.en: They also that render evil for good are mine adversaries; because I follow the thing that good is.
verses.am: They also that render evil for good are mine adversaries; because I follow {the thing that} good {is}.

verses.en: Forsake me not, O YAHUAH: O my YAHUAH, be not far from me.
verses.am: Forsake me not, O LORD: O my God, be not far from me.

verses.en: Make haste to help me, O YAHUAH my salvation.
verses.am: Make haste to help me, O Lord my salvation. {to...: Heb. for my help}

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, even to Jeduthun, A Psalm of Dawid.] I said, I will take heed to my ways, that I sin not with my tongue: I will keep my mouth with a bridle, while the wicked is before me.
verses.am: [To the chief Musician, {even} to Jeduthun, A Psalm of David.] I said, I will take heed to my ways, that I sin not with my tongue: I will keep my mouth with a bridle, while the wicked is before me. {my mouth...: Heb. a bridle, or, muzzle for my mouth}

verses.en: I was dumb with silence, I held my peace, even from good; and my sorrow was stirred.
verses.am: I was dumb with silence, I held my peace, {even} from good; and my sorrow was stirred. {stirred: Heb. troubled}

verses.en: My heart was hot within me, while I was musing the fire burned: then spake I with my tongue,
verses.am: My heart was hot within me, while I was musing the fire burned: {then} spake I with my tongue,

verses.en: YAHUAH, make me to know mine end, and the measure of my days, what it is; that I may know how frail I am.
verses.am: LORD, make me to know mine end, and the measure of my days, what it {is; that} I may know how frail I {am}. {how...: or, what time I have here}

verses.en: Behold, thou hast made my days as an handbreadth; and mine age is as nothing before thee: verily every man at his best state is altogether vanity. Selah.
verses.am: Behold, thou hast made my days {as} an handbreadth; and mine age {is} as nothing before thee: verily every man at his best state {is} altogether vanity. Selah. {at...: Heb. settled}

verses.en: Surely every man walketh in a vain shew: surely they are disquieted in vain: he heapeth up riches, and knoweth not who shall gather them.
verses.am: Surely every man walketh in a vain shew: surely they are disquieted in vain: he heapeth up {riches}, and knoweth not who shall gather them. {a vain...: Heb. an image}

verses.en: And now, YAHUAH, what wait I for? my hope is in thee.
verses.am: And now, Lord, what wait I for? my hope {is} in thee.

verses.en: Deliver me from all my transgressions: make me not the reproach of the foolish.
verses.am: Deliver me from all my transgressions: make me not the reproach of the foolish.

verses.en: I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; because thou didst it.
verses.am: I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; because thou didst {it}.

verses.en: Remove thy stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of thine hand.
verses.am: Remove thy stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of thine hand. {blow: Heb. conflict}

verses.en: When thou with rebukes dost correct man for iniquity, thou makest his beauty to consume away like a moth: surely every man is vanity. Selah.
verses.am: When thou with rebukes dost correct man for iniquity, thou makest his beauty to consume away like a moth: surely every man {is} vanity. Selah. {his...: Heb. that which is to be desired in him to melt away}

verses.en: Hear my prayer, O YAHUAH, and give ear unto my cry; hold not thy peace at my tears: for I am a stranger with thee, and a sojourner, as all my fathers were.
verses.am: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and give ear unto my cry; hold not thy peace at my tears: for I {am} a stranger with thee, {and} a sojourner, as all my fathers {were}.

verses.en: O spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go hence, and be no more.
verses.am: O spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go hence, and be no more.

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of Dawid.] I waited patiently for YAHUAH; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.
verses.am: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.] I waited patiently for the LORD; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry. {I waited...: Heb. In waiting I waited}

verses.en: He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings.
verses.am: He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, {and} established my goings. {an...: Heb. a pit of noise}

verses.en: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our YAHUAH: many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in YAHUAH.
verses.am: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, {even} praise unto our God: many shall see {it}, and fear, and shall trust in the LORD.

verses.en: Blessed is that man that maketh YAHUAH his trust, and respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.
verses.am: Blessed {is} that man that maketh the LORD his trust, and respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.

verses.en: Many, O YAHUAH my YAHUAH, are thy wonderful works which thou hast done, and thy thoughts which are to us-ward: they cannot be reckoned up in order unto thee: if I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be numbered.
verses.am: Many, O LORD my God, {are} thy wonderful works {which} thou hast done, and thy thoughts {which are} to us-ward: they cannot be reckoned up in order unto thee: {if} I would declare and speak {of them}, they are more than can be numbered. {they cannot...: or, none can order them unto thee}

verses.en: Sacrifice and offering thou didst not desire; mine ears hast thou opened: burnt offering and sin offering hast thou not required.
verses.am: Sacrifice and offering thou didst not desire; mine ears hast thou opened: burnt offering and sin offering hast thou not required. {opened: Heb. digged}

verses.en: Then said I, Lo, I come: in the volume of the book it is written of me,
verses.am: Then said I, Lo, I come: in the volume of the book {it is} written of me,

verses.en: I delight to do thy will, O my YAHUAH: yea, thy law is within my heart.
verses.am: I delight to do thy will, O my God: yea, thy law {is} within my heart. {within...: Heb. in the midst of my bowels}

verses.en: I have preached righteousness in the great congregation: lo, I have not refrained my lips, O YAHUAH, thou knowest.
verses.am: I have preached righteousness in the great congregation: lo, I have not refrained my lips, O LORD, thou knowest.

verses.en: I have not hid thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared thy faithfulness and thy salvation: I have not concealed thy lovingkindness and thy truth from the great congregation.
verses.am: I have not hid thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared thy faithfulness and thy salvation: I have not concealed thy lovingkindness and thy truth from the great congregation.

verses.en: Withhold not thou thy tender mercies from me, O YAHUAH: let thy lovingkindness and thy truth continually preserve me.
verses.am: Withhold not thou thy tender mercies from me, O LORD: let thy lovingkindness and thy truth continually preserve me.

verses.en: For innumerable evils have compassed me about: mine iniquities have taken hold upon me, so that I am not able to look up; they are more than the hairs of mine head: therefore my heart faileth me.
verses.am: For innumerable evils have compassed me about: mine iniquities have taken hold upon me, so that I am not able to look up; they are more than the hairs of mine head: therefore my heart faileth me. {falleth: Heb. forsaketh}

verses.en: Be pleased, O YAHUAH, to deliver me: O YAHUAH, make haste to help me.
verses.am: Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me: O LORD, make haste to help me.

verses.en: Let them be ashamed and confounded together that seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be driven backward and put to shame that wish me evil.
verses.am: Let them be ashamed and confounded together that seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be driven backward and put to shame that wish me evil.

verses.en: Let them be desolate for a reward of their shame that say unto me, Aha, aha.
verses.am: Let them be desolate for a reward of their shame that say unto me, Aha, aha.

verses.en: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: let such as love thy salvation say continually, YAHUAH be magnified.
verses.am: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: let such as love thy salvation say continually, The LORD be magnified.

verses.en: But I am poor and needy; yet YAHUAH thinketh upon me: thou art my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my YAHUAH.
verses.am: But I {am} poor and needy; {yet} the Lord thinketh upon me: thou {art} my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my God.

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of Dawid.] Blessed is he that considereth the poor: YAHUAH will deliver him in time of trouble.
verses.am: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.] Blessed {is} he that considereth the poor: the LORD will deliver him in time of trouble. {the poor: or, the weak, or, sick} {in time...: Heb. in the day of evil}

verses.en: YAHUAH will preserve him, and keep him alive; and he shall be blessed upon the earth: and thou wilt not deliver him unto the will of his enemies.
verses.am: The LORD will preserve him, and keep him alive; {and} he shall be blessed upon the earth: and thou wilt not deliver him unto the will of his enemies. {thou...: or, do not thou deliver}

verses.en: YAHUAH will strengthen him upon the bed of languishing: thou wilt make all his bed in his sickness.
verses.am: The LORD will strengthen him upon the bed of languishing: thou wilt make all his bed in his sickness. {make: Heb. turn}

verses.en: I said, YAHUAH, be merciful unto me: heal my soul; for I have sinned against thee.
verses.am: I said, LORD, be merciful unto me: heal my soul; for I have sinned against thee.

verses.en: Mine enemies speak evil of me, When shall he die, and his name perish?
verses.am: Mine enemies speak evil of me, When shall he die, and his name perish?

verses.en: And if he come to see me, he speaketh vanity: his heart gathereth iniquity to itself; when he goeth abroad, he telleth it.
verses.am: And if he come to see {me}, he speaketh vanity: his heart gathereth iniquity to itself; {when} he goeth abroad, he telleth {it}.

verses.en: All that hate me whisper together against me: against me do they devise my hurt.
verses.am: All that hate me whisper together against me: against me do they devise my hurt. {my...: Heb. evil to me}

verses.en: An evil disease, say they, cleaveth fast unto him: and now that he lieth he shall rise up no more.
verses.am: An evil disease, {say they}, cleaveth fast unto him: and {now} that he lieth he shall rise up no more. {An...: Heb. A thing of Belial}

verses.en: Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, which did eat of my bread, hath lifted up his heel against me.
verses.am: Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, which did eat of my bread, hath lifted up {his} heel against me. {mine...: Heb. the man of my peace} {lifted...: Heb. magnified}

verses.en: But thou, O YAHUAH, be merciful unto me, and raise me up, that I may requite them.
verses.am: But thou, O LORD, be merciful unto me, and raise me up, that I may requite them.

verses.en: By this I know that thou favourest me, because mine enemy doth not triumph over me.
verses.am: By this I know that thou favourest me, because mine enemy doth not triumph over me.

verses.en: And as for me, thou upholdest me in mine integrity, and settest me before thy face for ever.
verses.am: And as for me, thou upholdest me in mine integrity, and settest me before thy face for ever.

verses.en: Blessed be YAHUAH of Yisra'el from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.
verses.am: Blessed {be} the LORD God of Israel from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, Maschil, for the sons of Korah.] As the hart panteth after the water brooks, so panteth my soul after thee, O YAHUAH.
verses.am: [To the chief Musician, Maschil, for the sons of Korah.] As the hart panteth after the water brooks, so panteth my soul after thee, O God. {Maschil...: or, A Psalm giving instruction of the sons, etc} {panteth: Heb. brayeth}

verses.en: My soul thirsteth for YAHUAH, for the living YAHUAH: when shall I come and appear before YAHUAH?
verses.am: My soul thirsteth for God, for the living God: when shall I come and appear before God?

verses.en: My tears have been my meat day and night, while they continually say unto me, Where is thy YAHUAH?
verses.am: My tears have been my meat day and night, while they continually say unto me, Where {is} thy God?

verses.en: When I remember these things, I pour out my soul in me: for I had gone with the multitude, I went with them to the house of YAHUAH, with the voice of joy and praise, with a multitude that kept holyday.
verses.am: When I remember these {things}, I pour out my soul in me: for I had gone with the multitude, I went with them to the house of God, with the voice of joy and praise, with a multitude that kept holyday.

verses.en: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted in me? hope thou in YAHUAH: for I shall yet praise him for the help of his countenance.
verses.am: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and {why} art thou disquieted in me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him {for} the help of his countenance. {cast: Heb. bowed} {praise: or, give thanks} {for the...: or, his presence is salvation}

verses.en: O my YAHUAH, my soul is cast down within me: therefore will I remember thee from the land of Jordan, and of the Hermonites, from the hill Mizar.
verses.am: O my God, my soul is cast down within me: therefore will I remember thee from the land of Jordan, and of the Hermonites, from the hill Mizar. {the hill...: or, the little hill}

verses.en: Deep calleth unto deep at the noise of thy waterspouts: all thy waves and thy billows are gone over me.
verses.am: Deep calleth unto deep at the noise of thy waterspouts: all thy waves and thy billows are gone over me.

verses.en: Yet YAHUAH will command his lovingkindness in the daytime, and in the night his song shall be with me, and my prayer unto YAHUAH of my life.
verses.am: {Yet} the LORD will command his lovingkindness in the daytime, and in the night his song {shall be} with me, {and} my prayer unto the God of my life.

verses.en: I will say unto YAHUAH my rock, Why hast thou forgotten me? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
verses.am: I will say unto God my rock, Why hast thou forgotten me? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

verses.en: As with a sword in my bones, mine enemies reproach me; while they say daily unto me, Where is thy YAHUAH?
verses.am: {As} with a sword in my bones, mine enemies reproach me; while they say daily unto me, Where {is} thy God? {sword: or, killing}

verses.en: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in YAHUAH: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my YAHUAH.
verses.am: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, {who is} the health of my countenance, and my God.

verses.en: Judge me, O YAHUAH, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.
verses.am: Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man. {ungodly: or, unmerciful} {the deceitful...: Heb. a man of deceit and iniquity}

verses.en: For thou art YAHUAH of my strength: why dost thou cast me off? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
verses.am: For thou {art} the God of my strength: why dost thou cast me off? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

verses.en: O send out thy light and thy truth: let them lead me; let them bring me unto thy holy hill, and to thy tabernacles.
verses.am: O send out thy light and thy truth: let them lead me; let them bring me unto thy holy hill, and to thy tabernacles.

verses.en: Then will I go unto the altar of YAHUAH, unto YAHUAH my exceeding joy: yea, upon the harp will I praise thee, O YAHUAH my YAHUAH.
verses.am: Then will I go unto the altar of God, unto God my exceeding joy: yea, upon the harp will I praise thee, O God my God. {my exceeding...: Heb. the gladness of my joy}

verses.en: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope in YAHUAH: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my YAHUAH.
verses.am: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope in God: for I shall yet praise him, {who is} the health of my countenance, and my God.

verses.en: [To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, Maschil.] We have heard with our ears, O YAHUAH, our fathers have told us, what work thou didst in their days, in the times of old.
verses.am: [To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, Maschil.] We have heard with our ears, O God, our fathers have told us, {what} work thou didst in their days, in the times of old. {Maschil: or, of instruction}

verses.en: How thou didst drive out the heathen with thy hand, and plantedst them; how thou didst afflict the people, and cast them out.
verses.am: {How} thou didst drive out the heathen with thy hand, and plantedst them; {how} thou didst afflict the people, and cast them out.

verses.en: For they got not the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them: but thy right hand, and thine arm, and the light of thy countenance, because thou hadst a favour unto them.
verses.am: For they got not the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them: but thy right hand, and thine arm, and the light of thy countenance, because thou hadst a favour unto them.

verses.en: Thou art my King, O YAHUAH: command deliverances for Ya'aqob.
verses.am: Thou art my King, O God: command deliverances for Jacob.

verses.en: Through thee will we push down our enemies: through thy name will we tread them under that rise up against us.
verses.am: Through thee will we push down our enemies: through thy name will we tread them under that rise up against us.

verses.en: For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.
verses.am: For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.

verses.en: But thou hast saved us from our enemies, and hast put them to shame that hated us.
verses.am: But thou hast saved us from our enemies, and hast put them to shame that hated us.

verses.en: In YAHUAH we boast all the day long, and praise thy name for ever. Selah.
verses.am: In God we boast all the day long, and praise thy name for ever. Selah.

verses.en: But thou hast cast off, and put us to shame; and goest not forth with our armies.
verses.am: But thou hast cast off, and put us to shame; and goest not forth with our armies.

verses.en: Thou makest us to turn back from the enemy: and they which hate us spoil for themselves.
verses.am: Thou makest us to turn back from the enemy: and they which hate us spoil for themselves.

verses.en: Thou hast given us like sheep appointed for meat; and hast scattered us among the heathen.
verses.am: Thou hast given us like sheep {appointed} for meat; and hast scattered us among the heathen. {like...: Heb. as sheep of meat}

verses.en: Thou sellest thy people for nought, and dost not increase thy wealth by their price.
verses.am: Thou sellest thy people for nought, and dost not increase {thy wealth} by their price. {for...: Heb. without riches}

verses.en: Thou makest us a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and a derision to them that are round about us.
verses.am: Thou makest us a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and a derision to them that are round about us.

verses.en: Thou makest us a byword among the heathen, a shaking of the head among the people.
verses.am: Thou makest us a byword among the heathen, a shaking of the head among the people.

verses.en: My confusion is continually before me, and the shame of my face hath covered me,
verses.am: My confusion {is} continually before me, and the shame of my face hath covered me,

verses.en: For the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth; by reason of the enemy and avenger.
verses.am: For the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth; by reason of the enemy and avenger.

verses.en: All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten thee, neither have we dealt falsely in thy covenant.
verses.am: All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten thee, neither have we dealt falsely in thy covenant.

verses.en: Our heart is not turned back, neither have our steps declined from thy way;
verses.am: Our heart is not turned back, neither have our steps declined from thy way; {steps: or, goings}

verses.en: Though thou hast sore broken us in the place of dragons, and covered us with the shadow of death.
verses.am: Though thou hast sore broken us in the place of dragons, and covered us with the shadow of death.

verses.en: If we have forgotten the name of our YAHUAH, or stretched out our hands to a strange god;
verses.am: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or stretched out our hands to a strange god;

verses.en: Shall not YAHUAH search this out? for he knoweth the secrets of the heart.
verses.am: Shall not God search this out? for he knoweth the secrets of the heart.

verses.en: Yea, for thy sake are we killed all the day long; we are counted as sheep for the slaughter.
verses.am: Yea, for thy sake are we killed all the day long; we are counted as sheep for the slaughter.

verses.en: Awake, why sleepest thou, O YAHUAH? arise, cast us not off for ever.
verses.am: Awake, why sleepest thou, O Lord? arise, cast {us} not off for ever.

verses.en: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, and forgettest our affliction and our oppression?
verses.am: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, {and} forgettest our affliction and our oppression?

verses.en: For our soul is bowed down to the dust: our belly cleaveth unto the earth.
verses.am: For our soul is bowed down to the dust: our belly cleaveth unto the earth.

verses.en: Arise for our help, and redeem us for thy mercies' sake.
verses.am: Arise for our help, and redeem us for thy mercies' sake. {for our...: Heb. a help for us}

verses.en: [To the chief Musician upon Shoshannim, for the sons of Korah, Maschil, A Song of loves.] My heart is inditing a good matter: I speak of the things which I have made touching the king: my tongue is the pen of a ready writer.
verses.am: [To the chief Musician upon Shoshannim, for the sons of Korah, Maschil, A Song of loves.] My heart is inditing a good matter: I speak of the things which I have made touching the king: my tongue {is} the pen of a ready writer. {Maschil: or, of instruction} {is inditing: Heb. boileth, or, bubbleth up}

verses.en: Thou art fairer than the children of men: grace is poured into thy lips: therefore YAHUAH hath blessed thee for ever.
verses.am: Thou art fairer than the children of men: grace is poured into thy lips: therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.

verses.en: Gird thy sword upon thy thigh, O most mighty, with thy glory and thy majesty.
verses.am: Gird thy sword upon {thy} thigh, O {most} mighty, with thy glory and thy majesty.

verses.en: And in thy majesty ride prosperously because of truth and meekness and righteousness; and thy right hand shall teach thee terrible things.
verses.am: And in thy majesty ride prosperously because of truth and meekness {and} righteousness; and thy right hand shall teach thee terrible things. {ride...: Heb. prosper thou, ride thou}

verses.en: Thine arrows are sharp in the heart of the king's enemies; whereby the people fall under thee.
verses.am: Thine arrows {are} sharp in the heart of the king's enemies; {whereby} the people fall under thee.

verses.en: Thy throne, O YAHUAH, is for ever and ever: the sceptre of thy kingdom is a right sceptre.
verses.am: Thy throne, O God, {is} for ever and ever: the sceptre of thy kingdom {is} a right sceptre.

verses.en: Thou lovest righteousness, and hatest wickedness: therefore YAHUAH, thy YAHUAH, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.
verses.am: Thou lovest righteousness, and hatest wickedness: therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.

verses.en: All thy garments smell of myrrh, and aloes, and cassia, out of the ivory palaces, whereby they have made thee glad.

verses.am: Kings' daughters {were} among thy honourable women: upon thy right hand did stand the queen in gold of Ophir.

verses.en: Instead of thy fathers shall be thy children, whom thou mayest make princes in all the earth.

verses.am: For I acknowledge my transgressions: and my sin {is} ever before me.
