verses.en: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread: they have not called upon YAHUAH.
verses.am: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people {as} they eat bread: they have not called upon God.

verses.en: There were they in great fear, where no fear was: for YAHUAH hath scattered the bones of him that encampeth against thee: thou hast put them to shame, because YAHUAH hath despised them.
verses.am: There were they in great fear, {where} no fear was: for God hath scattered the bones of him that encampeth {against} thee: thou hast put {them} to shame, because God hath despised them. {were...: Heb. they feared a fear}

verses.en: Oh that the salvation of Yisra'el were come out of Zion! When YAHUAH bringeth back the captivity of his people, Ya'aqob shall rejoice, and Yisra'el shall be glad.
verses.am: Oh that the salvation of Israel {were come} out of Zion! When God bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, {and} Israel shall be glad. {Oh that...: Heb. Who will give salvation, etc}

verses.en: [To the chief Musician on Neginoth, Maschil, A Psalm of Dawid, when the Ziphims came and said to Sha'ul, Doth not Dawid hide himself with us?] Save me, O YAHUAH, by thy name, and judge me by thy strength.
verses.am: [To the chief Musician on Neginoth, Maschil, {A Psalm} of David, when the Ziphims came and said to Saul, Doth not David hide himself with us?] Save me, O God, by thy name, and judge me by thy strength. {chief...: or, overseer} {Maschil: or, of instruction}

verses.en: Hear my prayer, O YAHUAH; give ear to the words of my mouth.
verses.am: Hear my prayer, O God; give ear to the words of my mouth.

verses.en: For strangers are risen up against me, and oppressors seek after my soul: they have not set YAHUAH before them. Selah.
verses.am: For strangers are risen up against me, and oppressors seek after my soul: they have not set God before them. Selah.

verses.en: Behold, YAHUAH is mine helper: YAHUAH is with them that uphold my soul.
verses.am: Behold, God {is} mine helper: the Lord {is} with them that uphold my soul.

verses.en: He shall reward evil unto mine enemies: cut them off in thy truth.
verses.am: He shall reward evil unto mine enemies: cut them off in thy truth. {mine...: Heb. those that observe me}

verses.en: I will freely sacrifice unto thee: I will praise thy name, O YAHUAH; for it is good.
verses.am: I will freely sacrifice unto thee: I will praise thy name, O LORD; for {it is} good.

verses.en: For he hath delivered me out of all trouble: and mine eye hath seen his desire upon mine enemies.
verses.am: For he hath delivered me out of all trouble: and mine eye hath seen {his desire} upon mine enemies.

verses.en: [To the chief Musician on Neginoth, Maschil, A Psalm of Dawid.] Give ear to my prayer, O YAHUAH; and hide not thyself from my supplication.
verses.am: [To the chief Musician on Neginoth, Maschil, {A Psalm} of David.] Give ear to my prayer, O God; and hide not thyself from my supplication. {chief...: or, overseer} {Maschil: or, of instruction}

verses.en: Attend unto me, and hear me: I mourn in my complaint, and make a noise;
verses.am: Attend unto me, and hear me: I mourn in my complaint, and make a noise;

verses.en: Because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked: for they cast iniquity upon me, and in wrath they hate me.
verses.am: Because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked: for they cast iniquity upon me, and in wrath they hate me.

verses.en: My heart is sore pained within me: and the terrors of death are fallen upon me.
verses.am: My heart is sore pained within me: and the terrors of death are fallen upon me.

verses.en: Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me, and horror hath overwhelmed me.
verses.am: Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me, and horror hath overwhelmed me. {overwhelmed: Heb. covered}

verses.en: And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove! for then would I fly away, and be at rest.
verses.am: And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove! {for then} would I fly away, and be at rest.

verses.en: Lo, then would I wander far off, and remain in the wilderness. Selah.
verses.am: Lo, {then} would I wander far off, {and} remain in the wilderness. Selah.

verses.en: I would hasten my escape from the windy storm and tempest.
verses.am: I would hasten my escape from the windy storm {and} tempest.

verses.en: Destroy, O YAHUAH, and divide their tongues: for I have seen violence and strife in the city.
verses.am: Destroy, O Lord, {and} divide their tongues: for I have seen violence and strife in the city.

verses.en: Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof: mischief also and sorrow are in the midst of it.
verses.am: Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof: mischief also and sorrow {are} in the midst of it.

verses.en: Wickedness is in the midst thereof: deceit and guile depart not from her streets.
verses.am: Wickedness {is} in the midst thereof: deceit and guile depart not from her streets.

verses.en: For it was not an enemy that reproached me; then I could have borne it: neither was it he that hated me that did magnify himself against me; then I would have hid myself from him:
verses.am: For {it was} not an enemy {that} reproached me; then I could have borne {it}: neither {was it} he that hated me {that} did magnify {himself} against me; then I would have hid myself from him:

verses.en: But it was thou, a man mine equal, my guide, and mine acquaintance.
verses.am: But {it was} thou, a man mine equal, my guide, and mine acquaintance. {mine equal: Heb. according to my rank}

verses.en: We took sweet counsel together, and walked unto the house of YAHUAH in company.
verses.am: We took sweet counsel together, {and} walked unto the house of God in company. {We...: Heb. Who sweetened counsel}

verses.en: Let death seize upon them, and let them go down quick into hell: for wickedness is in their dwellings, and among them.
verses.am: Let death seize upon them, {and} let them go down quick into hell: for wickedness {is} in their dwellings, {and} among them. {hell: or, the grave}

verses.en: As for me, I will call upon YAHUAH; and YAHUAH shall save me.
verses.am: As for me, I will call upon God; and the LORD shall save me.

verses.en: Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I pray, and cry aloud: and he shall hear my voice.
verses.am: Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I pray, and cry aloud: and he shall hear my voice.

verses.en: He hath delivered my soul in peace from the battle that was against me: for there were many with me.
verses.am: He hath delivered my soul in peace from the battle {that was} against me: for there were many with me.

verses.en: YAHUAH shall hear, and afflict them, even he that abideth of old. Selah. Because they have no changes, therefore they fear not YAHUAH.
verses.am: God shall hear, and afflict them, even he that abideth of old. Selah. Because they have no changes, therefore they fear not God. {Because...: or, With whom also there be no changes, yet they}

verses.en: He hath put forth his hands against such as be at peace with him: he hath broken his covenant.
verses.am: He hath put forth his hands against such as be at peace with him: he hath broken his covenant. {broken: Heb. profaned}

verses.en: The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart: his words were softer than oil, yet were they drawn swords.
verses.am: {The words} of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war {was} in his heart: his words were softer than oil, yet {were} they drawn swords.

verses.en: Cast thy burden upon YAHUAH, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.
verses.am: Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved. {burden: or, gift}

verses.en: But thou, O YAHUAH, shalt bring them down into the pit of destruction: bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; but I will trust in thee.
verses.am: But thou, O God, shalt bring them down into the pit of destruction: bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; but I will trust in thee. {bloody...: Heb. men of bloods and deceit} {shall...: Heb. shall not half their days}

verses.en: [To the chief Musician upon Jonathelemrechokim, Michtam of Dawid, when the Philistines took him in Gath.] Be merciful unto me, O YAHUAH: for man would swallow me up; he fighting daily oppresseth me.
verses.am: [To the chief Musician upon Jonathelemrechokim, Michtam of David, when the Philistines took him in Gath.] Be merciful unto me, O God: for man would swallow me up; he fighting daily oppresseth me. {Michtam...: or, A golden Psalm of David}

verses.en: Mine enemies would daily swallow me up: for they be many that fight against me, O thou most High.
verses.am: Mine enemies would daily swallow {me} up: for {they be} many that fight against me, O thou most High. {enemies: Heb. observers}

verses.en: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.
verses.am: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.

verses.en: In YAHUAH I will praise his word, in YAHUAH I have put my trust; I will not fear what flesh can do unto me.
verses.am: In God I will praise his word, in God I have put my trust; I will not fear what flesh can do unto me.

verses.en: Every day they wrest my words: all their thoughts are against me for evil.
verses.am: Every day they wrest my words: all their thoughts {are} against me for evil.

verses.en: They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, they mark my steps, when they wait for my soul.
verses.am: They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, they mark my steps, when they wait for my soul.

verses.en: Shall they escape by iniquity? in thine anger cast down the people, O YAHUAH.
verses.am: Shall they escape by iniquity? in {thine} anger cast down the people, O God.

verses.en: Thou tellest my wanderings: put thou my tears into thy bottle: are they not in thy book?
verses.am: Thou tellest my wanderings: put thou my tears into thy bottle: {are they} not in thy book?

verses.en: When I cry unto thee, then shall mine enemies turn back: this I know; for YAHUAH is for me.
verses.am: When I cry {unto thee}, then shall mine enemies turn back: this I know; for God {is} for me.

verses.en: In YAHUAH will I praise his word: in YAHUAH will I praise his word.
verses.am: In God will I praise {his} word: in the LORD will I praise {his} word.

verses.en: In YAHUAH have I put my trust: I will not be afraid what man can do unto me.
verses.am: In God have I put my trust: I will not be afraid what man can do unto me.

verses.en: Thy vows are upon me, O YAHUAH: I will render praises unto thee.
verses.am: Thy vows {are} upon me, O God: I will render praises unto thee.

verses.en: For thou hast delivered my soul from death: wilt not thou deliver my feet from falling, that I may walk before YAHUAH in the light of the living?
verses.am: For thou hast delivered my soul from death: {wilt} not {thou deliver} my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living?

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, Altaschith, Michtam of Dawid, when he fled from Sha'ul in the cave.] Be merciful unto me, O YAHUAH, be merciful unto me: for my soul trusteth in thee: yea, in the shadow of thy wings will I make my refuge, until these calamities be overpast.
verses.am: [To the chief Musician, Altaschith, Michtam of David, when he fled from Saul in the cave.] Be merciful unto me, O God, be merciful unto me: for my soul trusteth in thee: yea, in the shadow of thy wings will I make my refuge, until {these} calamities be overpast. {Altaschith: or, Destroy not} {Michtam: or, A golden Psalm}

verses.en: I will cry unto YAHUAH most high; unto YAHUAH that performeth all things for me.
verses.am: I will cry unto God most high; unto God that performeth {all things} for me.

verses.en: He shall send from heaven, and save me from the reproach of him that would swallow me up. Selah. YAHUAH shall send forth his mercy and his truth.
verses.am: He shall send from heaven, and save me {from} the reproach of him that would swallow me up. Selah. God shall send forth his mercy and his truth. {from the...: or, he reproacheth him that}

verses.en: My soul is among lions: and I lie even among them that are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.
verses.am: My soul {is} among lions: {and} I lie {even among} them that are set on fire, {even} the sons of men, whose teeth {are} spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.

verses.en: Be thou exalted, O YAHUAH, above the heavens; let thy glory be above all the earth.
verses.am: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; {let} thy glory {be} above all the earth.

verses.en: They have prepared a net for my steps; my soul is bowed down: they have digged a pit before me, into the midst whereof they are fallen themselves. Selah.
verses.am: They have prepared a net for my steps; my soul is bowed down: they have digged a pit before me, into the midst whereof they are fallen {themselves}. Selah.

verses.en: My heart is fixed, O YAHUAH, my heart is fixed: I will sing and give praise.
verses.am: My heart is fixed, O God, my heart is fixed: I will sing and give praise. {fixed: or, prepared}

verses.en: Awake up, my glory; awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.
verses.am: Awake up, my glory; awake, psaltery and harp: I {myself} will awake early.

verses.en: I will praise thee, O YAHUAH, among the people: I will sing unto thee among the nations.
verses.am: I will praise thee, O Lord, among the people: I will sing unto thee among the nations.

verses.en: For thy mercy is great unto the heavens, and thy truth unto the clouds.
verses.am: For thy mercy {is} great unto the heavens, and thy truth unto the clouds.

verses.en: Be thou exalted, O YAHUAH, above the heavens: let thy glory be above all the earth.
verses.am: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: {let} thy glory {be} above all the earth.

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, Altaschith, Michtam of Dawid.] Do ye indeed speak righteousness, O congregation? do ye judge uprightly, O ye sons of men?
verses.am: [To the chief Musician, Altaschith, Michtam of David.] Do ye indeed speak righteousness, O congregation? do ye judge uprightly, O ye sons of men? {Altaschith...: or, Destroy not} {Michtam: or, A golden Psalm}

verses.en: Yea, in heart ye work wickedness; ye weigh the violence of your hands in the earth.
verses.am: Yea, in heart ye work wickedness; ye weigh the violence of your hands in the earth.

verses.en: The wicked are estranged from the womb: they go astray as soon as they be born, speaking lies.
verses.am: The wicked are estranged from the womb: they go astray as soon as they be born, speaking lies. {as soon...: Heb. from the belly}

verses.en: Their poison is like the poison of a serpent: they are like the deaf adder that stoppeth her ear;
verses.am: Their poison {is} like the poison of a serpent: {they are} like the deaf adder {that} stoppeth her ear; {like the poison: Heb. according to the likeness, etc} {adder: or, asp}

verses.en: Which will not hearken to the voice of charmers, charming never so wisely.
verses.am: Which will not hearken to the voice of charmers, charming never so wisely. {charming...: or, be the charmer never so cunning}

verses.en: Break their teeth, O YAHUAH, in their mouth: break out the great teeth of the young lions, O YAHUAH.
verses.am: Break their teeth, O God, in their mouth: break out the great teeth of the young lions, O LORD.

verses.en: Let them melt away as waters which run continually: when he bendeth his bow to shoot his arrows, let them be as cut in pieces.
verses.am: Let them melt away as waters {which} run continually: {when} he bendeth {his bow to shoot} his arrows, let them be as cut in pieces.

verses.en: As a snail which melteth, let every one of them pass away: like the untimely birth of a woman, that they may not see the sun.
verses.am: As a snail {which} melteth, let {every one of them} pass away: {like} the untimely birth of a woman, {that} they may not see the sun.

verses.en: Before your pots can feel the thorns, he shall take them away as with a whirlwind, both living, and in his wrath.
verses.am: Before your pots can feel the thorns, he shall take them away as with a whirlwind, both living, and in {his} wrath. {both...: Heb. as living as wrath}

verses.en: The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance: he shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.
verses.am: The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance: he shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.

verses.en: So that a man shall say, Verily there is a reward for the righteous: verily he is a YAHUAH that judgeth in the earth.
verses.am: So that a man shall say, Verily {there is} a reward for the righteous: verily he is a God that judgeth in the earth. {a reward...: Heb. fruit of the, etc}

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, Altaschith, Michtam of Dawid; when Sha'ul sent, and they watched the house to kill him.] Deliver me from mine enemies, O my YAHUAH: defend me from them that rise up against me.
verses.am: [To the chief Musician, Altaschith, Michtam of David; when Saul sent, and they watched the house to kill him.] Deliver me from mine enemies, O my God: defend me from them that rise up against me. {Altaschith...: or, Destroy not} {Michtam: or, A golden Psalm} {defend...: Heb. set me on high}

verses.en: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, and save me from bloody men.
verses.am: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, and save me from bloody men.

verses.en: For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul: the mighty are gathered against me; not for my transgression, nor for my sin, O YAHUAH.
verses.am: For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul: the mighty are gathered against me; not {for} my transgression, nor {for} my sin, O LORD.

verses.en: They run and prepare themselves without my fault: awake to help me, and behold.
verses.am: They run and prepare themselves without {my} fault: awake to help me, and behold. {help: Heb. meet}

verses.en: Thou therefore, O YAHUAH of hosts, YAHUAH of Yisra'el, awake to visit all the heathen: be not merciful to any wicked transgressors. Selah.
verses.am: Thou therefore, O LORD God of hosts, the God of Israel, awake to visit all the heathen: be not merciful to any wicked transgressors. Selah.

verses.en: They return at evening: they make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.
verses.am: They return at evening: they make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.

verses.en: Behold, they belch out with their mouth: swords are in their lips: for who, say they, doth hear?
verses.am: Behold, they belch out with their mouth: swords {are} in their lips: for who, {say they}, doth hear?

verses.en: But thou, O YAHUAH, shalt laugh at them; thou shalt have all the heathen in derision.
verses.am: But thou, O LORD, shalt laugh at them; thou shalt have all the heathen in derision.

verses.en: Because of his strength will I wait upon thee: for YAHUAH is my defence.
verses.am: {Because of} his strength will I wait upon thee: for God {is} my defence. {defence: Heb. high place}

verses.en: YAHUAH of my mercy shall prevent me: YAHUAH shall let me see my desire upon mine enemies.
verses.am: The God of my mercy shall prevent me: God shall let me see {my desire} upon mine enemies. {enemies: Heb. observers}

verses.en: Slay them not, lest my people forget: scatter them by thy power; and bring them down, O YAHUAH our shield.
verses.am: Slay them not, lest my people forget: scatter them by thy power; and bring them down, O Lord our shield.

verses.en: For the sin of their mouth and the words of their lips let them even be taken in their pride: and for cursing and lying which they speak.
verses.am: {For} the sin of their mouth {and} the words of their lips let them even be taken in their pride: and for cursing and lying {which} they speak.

verses.en: Consume them in wrath, consume them, that they may not be: and let them know that YAHUAH ruleth in Ya'aqob unto the ends of the earth. Selah.
verses.am: Consume {them} in wrath, consume {them}, that they {may} not {be}: and let them know that God ruleth in Jacob unto the ends of the earth. Selah.

verses.en: And at evening let them return; and let them make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.
verses.am: And at evening let them return; {and} let them make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.

verses.en: Let them wander up and down for meat, and grudge if they be not satisfied.
verses.am: Let them wander up and down for meat, and grudge if they be not satisfied. {for meat: Heb. to eat} {and grudge...: or, if they be not satisfied, then they will stay all night}

verses.en: But I will sing of thy power; yea, I will sing aloud of thy mercy in the morning: for thou hast been my defence and refuge in the day of my trouble.
verses.am: But I will sing of thy power; yea, I will sing aloud of thy mercy in the morning: for thou hast been my defence and refuge in the day of my trouble.

verses.en: Unto thee, O my strength, will I sing: for YAHUAH is my defence, and YAHUAH of my mercy.
verses.am: Unto thee, O my strength, will I sing: for God {is} my defence, {and} the God of my mercy.

verses.en: [To the chief Musician upon Shushaneduth, Michtam of Dawid, to teach; when he strove with Aramnaharaim and with Aramzobah, when Joab returned, and smote of Edom in the valley of salt twelve thousand.] O YAHUAH, thou hast cast us off, thou hast scattered us, thou hast been displeased; O turn thyself to us again.
verses.am: [To the chief Musician upon Shushaneduth, Michtam of David, to teach; when he strove with Aramnaharaim and with Aramzobah, when Joab returned, and smote of Edom in the valley of salt twelve thousand.] O God, thou hast cast us off, thou hast scattered us, thou hast been displeased; O turn thyself to us again. {Michtam: or, A golden Psalm} {scattered: Heb. broken}

verses.en: Thou hast made the earth to tremble; thou hast broken it: heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh.
verses.am: Thou hast made the earth to tremble; thou hast broken it: heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh.

verses.en: Thou hast shewed thy people hard things: thou hast made us to drink the wine of astonishment.
verses.am: Thou hast shewed thy people hard things: thou hast made us to drink the wine of astonishment.

verses.en: Thou hast given a banner to them that fear thee, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.
verses.am: Thou hast given a banner to them that fear thee, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.

verses.en: That thy beloved may be delivered; save with thy right hand, and hear me.
verses.am: That thy beloved may be delivered; save {with} thy right hand, and hear me.

verses.en: YAHUAH hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
verses.am: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

verses.en: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Yehudah is my lawgiver;
verses.am: Gilead {is} mine, and Manasseh {is} mine; Ephraim also {is} the strength of mine head; Judah {is} my lawgiver;

verses.en: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe: Philistia, triumph thou because of me.
verses.am: Moab {is} my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe: Philistia, triumph thou because of me. {triumph...: or, triumph thou over me: (by an irony}

verses.en: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?
verses.am: Who will bring me {into} the strong city? who will lead me into Edom? {strong...: Heb. city of strength?}

verses.en: Wilt not thou, O YAHUAH, which hadst cast us off? and thou, O YAHUAH, which didst not go out with our armies?
verses.am: {Wilt} not thou, O God, {which} hadst cast us off? and {thou}, O God, {which} didst not go out with our armies?

verses.en: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.
verses.am: Give us help from trouble: for vain {is} the help of man. {help of man: Heb. salvation, etc}

verses.en: Through YAHUAH we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.
verses.am: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he {it is that} shall tread down our enemies.

verses.en: [To the chief Musician upon Neginah, A Psalm of Dawid.] Hear my cry, O YAHUAH; attend unto my prayer.
verses.am: [To the chief Musician upon Neginah, {A Psalm} of David.] Hear my cry, O God; attend unto my prayer.

verses.en: From the end of the earth will I cry unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
verses.am: From the end of the earth will I cry unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: lead me to the rock {that} is higher than I.

verses.en: For thou hast been a shelter for me, and a strong tower from the enemy.
verses.am: For thou hast been a shelter for me, {and} a strong tower from the enemy.

verses.en: I will abide in thy tabernacle for ever: I will trust in the covert of thy wings. Selah.
verses.am: I will abide in thy tabernacle for ever: I will trust in the covert of thy wings. Selah. {trust: or, make my refuge}

verses.en: For thou, O YAHUAH, hast heard my vows: thou hast given me the heritage of those that fear thy name.
verses.am: For thou, O God, hast heard my vows: thou hast given {me} the heritage of those that fear thy name.

verses.en: Thou wilt prolong the king's life: and his years as many generations.
verses.am: Thou wilt prolong the king's life: {and} his years as many generations. {Thou...: Heb. Thou shalt add days to the days of the king} {as...: Heb. as generation and generation}

verses.en: He shall abide before YAHUAH for ever: O prepare mercy and truth, which may preserve him.
verses.am: He shall abide before God for ever: O prepare mercy and truth, {which} may preserve him.

verses.en: So will I sing praise unto thy name for ever, that I may daily perform my vows.
verses.am: So will I sing praise unto thy name for ever, that I may daily perform my vows.

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, to Jeduthun, A Psalm of Dawid.] Truly my soul waiteth upon YAHUAH: from him cometh my salvation.
verses.am: [To the chief Musician, to Jeduthun, A Psalm of David.] Truly my soul waiteth upon God: from him {cometh} my salvation. {Truly: or, Only} {waiteth: Heb. is silent}

verses.en: He only is my rock and my salvation; he is my defence; I shall not be greatly moved.
verses.am: He only {is} my rock and my salvation; {he is} my defence; I shall not be greatly moved. {defence: Heb. high place}

verses.en: How long will ye imagine mischief against a man? ye shall be slain all of you: as a bowing wall shall ye be, and as a tottering fence.
verses.am: How long will ye imagine mischief against a man? ye shall be slain all of you: as a bowing wall {shall ye be, and as} a tottering fence.

verses.en: They only consult to cast him down from his excellency: they delight in lies: they bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.
verses.am: They only consult to cast {him} down from his excellency: they delight in lies: they bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah. {inwardly: Heb. in their inward parts}

verses.en: My soul, wait thou only upon YAHUAH; for my expectation is from him.
verses.am: My soul, wait thou only upon God; for my expectation {is} from him.

verses.en: He only is my rock and my salvation: he is my defence; I shall not be moved.
verses.am: He only {is} my rock and my salvation: {he is} my defence; I shall not be moved.

verses.en: In YAHUAH is my salvation and my glory: the rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in YAHUAH.
verses.am: In God {is} my salvation and my glory: the rock of my strength, {and} my refuge, {is} in God.

verses.en: Trust in him at all times; ye people, pour out your heart before him: YAHUAH is a refuge for us. Selah.
verses.am: Trust in him at all times; {ye} people, pour out your heart before him: God {is} a refuge for us. Selah.

verses.en: Surely men of low degree are vanity, and men of high degree are a lie: to be laid in the balance, they are altogether lighter than vanity.
verses.am: Surely men of low degree {are} vanity, {and} men of high degree {are} a lie: to be laid in the balance, they {are} altogether {lighter} than vanity. {altogether: or, alike}

verses.en: Trust not in oppression, and become not vain in robbery: if riches increase, set not your heart upon them.
verses.am: Trust not in oppression, and become not vain in robbery: if riches increase, set not your heart {upon them}.

verses.en: YAHUAH hath spoken once; twice have I heard this; that power belongeth unto YAHUAH.
verses.am: God hath spoken once; twice have I heard this; that power {belongeth} unto God. {power: or, strength}

verses.en: Also unto thee, O YAHUAH, belongeth mercy: for thou renderest to every man according to his work.
verses.am: Also unto thee, O Lord, {belongeth} mercy: for thou renderest to every man according to his work.

verses.en: [A Psalm of Dawid, when he was in the wilderness of Yehudah.] O YAHUAH, thou art my YAHUAH; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;
verses.am: [A Psalm of David, when he was in the wilderness of Judah.] O God, thou {art} my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is; {thirsty: Heb. weary} {where...: without water}

verses.en: To see thy power and thy glory, so as I have seen thee in the sanctuary.
verses.am: To see thy power and thy glory, so {as} I have seen thee in the sanctuary.

verses.en: Because thy lovingkindness is better than life, my lips shall praise thee.
verses.am: Because thy lovingkindness {is} better than life, my lips shall praise thee.

verses.en: Thus will I bless thee while I live: I will lift up my hands in thy name.
verses.am: Thus will I bless thee while I live: I will lift up my hands in thy name.

verses.en: My soul shall be satisfied as with marrow and fatness; and my mouth shall praise thee with joyful lips:
verses.am: My soul shall be satisfied as {with} marrow and fatness; and my mouth shall praise {thee} with joyful lips: {marrow: Heb. fatness}

verses.en: When I remember thee upon my bed, and meditate on thee in the night watches.
verses.am: When I remember thee upon my bed, {and} meditate on thee in the {night} watches.

verses.en: Because thou hast been my help, therefore in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice.
verses.am: Because thou hast been my help, therefore in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice.

verses.en: My soul followeth hard after thee: thy right hand upholdeth me.
verses.am: My soul followeth hard after thee: thy right hand upholdeth me.

verses.en: But those that seek my soul, to destroy it, shall go into the lower parts of the earth.
verses.am: But those {that} seek my soul, to destroy {it}, shall go into the lower parts of the earth.

verses.en: They shall fall by the sword: they shall be a portion for foxes.
verses.am: They shall fall by the sword: they shall be a portion for foxes. {They shall fall...: Heb. They shall make him run out like water by the hands of}

verses.en: But the king shall rejoice in YAHUAH; every one that sweareth by him shall glory: but the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped.
verses.am: But the king shall rejoice in God; every one that sweareth by him shall glory: but the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped.

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of Dawid.] Hear my voice, O YAHUAH, in my prayer: preserve my life from fear of the enemy.
verses.am: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.] Hear my voice, O God, in my prayer: preserve my life from fear of the enemy.

verses.en: Hide me from the secret counsel of the wicked; from the insurrection of the workers of iniquity:
verses.am: Hide me from the secret counsel of the wicked; from the insurrection of the workers of iniquity:

verses.en: Who whet their tongue like a sword, and bend their bows to shoot their arrows, even bitter words:
verses.am: Who whet their tongue like a sword, {and} bend {their bows to shoot} their arrows, {even} bitter words:

verses.en: That they may shoot in secret at the perfect: suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not.
verses.am: That they may shoot in secret at the perfect: suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not.

verses.en: They encourage themselves in an evil matter: they commune of laying snares privily; they say, Who shall see them?
verses.am: They encourage themselves {in} an evil matter: they commune of laying snares privily; they say, Who shall see them? {matter: or, speech} {of...: Heb. to hide his snares}

verses.en: They search out iniquities; they accomplish a diligent search: both the inward thought of every one of them, and the heart, is deep.
verses.am: They search out iniquities; they accomplish a diligent search: both the inward {thought} of every one {of them}, and the heart, {is} deep. {they...: or, we are consumed by that which they have throughly searched} {a diligent...: Heb. a search searched}

verses.en: But YAHUAH shall shoot at them with an arrow; suddenly shall they be wounded.
verses.am: But God shall shoot at them {with} an arrow; suddenly shall they be wounded. {shall they...: Heb. their wound shall be}

verses.en: So they shall make their own tongue to fall upon themselves: all that see them shall flee away.
verses.am: So they shall make their own tongue to fall upon themselves: all that see them shall flee away.

verses.en: And all men shall fear, and shall declare the work of YAHUAH; for they shall wisely consider of his doing.
verses.am: And all men shall fear, and shall declare the work of God; for they shall wisely consider of his doing.

verses.en: The righteous shall be glad in YAHUAH, and shall trust in him; and all the upright in heart shall glory.
verses.am: The righteous shall be glad in the LORD, and shall trust in him; and all the upright in heart shall glory.

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm and Song of Dawid.] Praise waiteth for thee, O YAHUAH, in Sion: and unto thee shall the vow be performed.
verses.am: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm {and} Song of David.] Praise waiteth for thee, O God, in Sion: and unto thee shall the vow be performed. {waiteth: Heb. is silent}

verses.en: O thou that hearest prayer, unto thee shall all flesh come.
verses.am: O thou that hearest prayer, unto thee shall all flesh come.

verses.en: Iniquities prevail against me: as for our transgressions, thou shalt purge them away.
verses.am: Iniquities prevail against me: {as for} our transgressions, thou shalt purge them away. {iniquities: Heb. Words, or, Matters of iniquities}

verses.en: Blessed is the man whom thou choosest, and causest to approach unto thee, that he may dwell in thy courts: we shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house, even of thy holy temple.
verses.am: Blessed {is the man whom} thou choosest, and causest to approach {unto thee, that} he may dwell in thy courts: we shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house, {even} of thy holy temple.

verses.en: By terrible things in righteousness wilt thou answer us, O YAHUAH of our salvation; who art the confidence of all the ends of the earth, and of them that are afar off upon the sea:
verses.am: {By} terrible things in righteousness wilt thou answer us, O God of our salvation; {who art} the confidence of all the ends of the earth, and of them that are afar off {upon} the sea:

verses.en: Which by his strength setteth fast the mountains; being girded with power:
verses.am: Which by his strength setteth fast the mountains; {being} girded with power:

verses.en: Which stilleth the noise of the seas, the noise of their waves, and the tumult of the people.
verses.am: Which stilleth the noise of the seas, the noise of their waves, and the tumult of the people.

verses.en: They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens: thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.
verses.am: They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens: thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice. {rejoice: or, sing}

verses.en: Thou visitest the earth, and waterest it: thou greatly enrichest it with the river of YAHUAH, which is full of water: thou preparest them corn, when thou hast so provided for it.
verses.am: Thou visitest the earth, and waterest it: thou greatly enrichest it with the river of God, {which} is full of water: thou preparest them corn, when thou hast so provided for it. {and...: or, after thou hadst made it to desire rain}

verses.en: Thou waterest the ridges thereof abundantly: thou settlest the furrows thereof: thou makest it soft with showers: thou blessest the springing thereof.
verses.am: Thou waterest the ridges thereof abundantly: thou settlest the furrows thereof: thou makest it soft with showers: thou blessest the springing thereof. {settlest: or, causest rain to descend into} {makest...: Heb. dissolvest it}

verses.en: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; and thy paths drop fatness.
verses.am: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; and thy paths drop fatness. {with: Heb. of}

verses.en: They drop upon the pastures of the wilderness: and the little hills rejoice on every side.
verses.am: They drop {upon} the pastures of the wilderness: and the little hills rejoice on every side. {rejoice...: Heb. are girded with joy}

verses.en: The pastures are clothed with flocks; the valleys also are covered over with corn; they shout for joy, they also sing.
verses.am: The pastures are clothed with flocks; the valleys also are covered over with corn; they shout for joy, they also sing.

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, A Song or Psalm.] Make a joyful noise unto YAHUAH, all ye lands:
verses.am: [To the chief Musician, A Song {or} Psalm.] Make a joyful noise unto God, all ye lands: {all...: Heb. all the earth}

verses.en: Sing forth the honour of his name: make his praise glorious.
verses.am: Sing forth the honour of his name: make his praise glorious.

verses.en: Say unto YAHUAH, How terrible art thou in thy works! through the greatness of thy power shall thine enemies submit themselves unto thee.
verses.am: Say unto God, How terrible {art thou in} thy works! through the greatness of thy power shall thine enemies submit themselves unto thee. {submit...: or, yield feigned obedience: Heb. lie}

verses.en: All the earth shall worship thee, and shall sing unto thee; they shall sing to thy name. Selah.
verses.am: All the earth shall worship thee, and shall sing unto thee; they shall sing {to} thy name. Selah.

verses.en: Come and see the works of YAHUAH: he is terrible in his doing toward the children of men.
verses.am: Come and see the works of God: {he is} terrible {in his} doing toward the children of men.

verses.en: He turned the sea into dry land: they went through the flood on foot: there did we rejoice in him.
verses.am: He turned the sea into dry {land}: they went through the flood on foot: there did we rejoice in him.

verses.en: He ruleth by his power for ever; his eyes behold the nations: let not the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah.
verses.am: He ruleth by his power for ever; his eyes behold the nations: let not the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah.

verses.en: O bless our YAHUAH, ye people, and make the voice of his praise to be heard:
verses.am: O bless our God, ye people, and make the voice of his praise to be heard:

verses.en: Which holdeth our soul in life, and suffereth not our feet to be moved.
verses.am: Which holdeth our soul in life, and suffereth not our feet to be moved. {holdeth: Heb. putteth}

verses.en: For thou, O YAHUAH, hast proved us: thou hast tried us, as silver is tried.
verses.am: For thou, O God, hast proved us: thou hast tried us, as silver is tried.

verses.en: Thou broughtest us into the net; thou laidst affliction upon our loins.
verses.am: Thou broughtest us into the net; thou laidst affliction upon our loins.

verses.en: Thou hast caused men to ride over our heads; we went through fire and through water: but thou broughtest us out into a wealthy place.
verses.am: Thou hast caused men to ride over our heads; we went through fire and through water: but thou broughtest us out into a wealthy {place}. {wealthy: Heb. moist}

verses.en: I will go into thy house with burnt offerings: I will pay thee my vows,
verses.am: I will go into thy house with burnt offerings: I will pay thee my vows,

verses.en: Which my lips have uttered, and my mouth hath spoken, when I was in trouble.
verses.am: Which my lips have uttered, and my mouth hath spoken, when I was in trouble. {uttered: Heb. opened}

verses.en: I will offer unto thee burnt sacrifices of fatlings, with the incense of rams; I will offer bullocks with goats. Selah.
verses.am: I will offer unto thee burnt sacrifices of fatlings, with the incense of rams; I will offer bullocks with goats. Selah. {fatlings: Heb. marrow}

verses.en: Come and hear, all ye that fear YAHUAH, and I will declare what he hath done for my soul.
verses.am: Come {and} hear, all ye that fear God, and I will declare what he hath done for my soul.

verses.en: I cried unto him with my mouth, and he was extolled with my tongue.
verses.am: I cried unto him with my mouth, and he was extolled with my tongue.

verses.en: If I regard iniquity in my heart, YAHUAH will not hear me:
verses.am: If I regard iniquity in my heart, the Lord will not hear {me}:

verses.en: But verily YAHUAH hath heard me; he hath attended to the voice of my prayer.
verses.am: {But} verily God hath heard {me}; he hath attended to the voice of my prayer.

verses.en: Blessed be YAHUAH, which hath not turned away my prayer, nor his mercy from me.
verses.am: Blessed {be} God, which hath not turned away my prayer, nor his mercy from me.

verses.en: [To the chief Musician on Neginoth, A Psalm or Song.] YAHUAH be merciful unto us, and bless us; and cause his face to shine upon us; Selah.
verses.am: [To the chief Musician on Neginoth, A Psalm {or} Song.] God be merciful unto us, and bless us; {and} cause his face to shine upon us; Selah. {chief...: or, overseer} {upon: Heb. with}

verses.en: That thy way may be known upon earth, thy saving health among all nations.
verses.am: That thy way may be known upon earth, thy saving health among all nations.

verses.en: Let the people praise thee, O YAHUAH; let all the people praise thee.
verses.am: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.

verses.en: O let the nations be glad and sing for joy: for thou shalt judge the people righteously, and govern the nations upon earth. Selah.
verses.am: O let the nations be glad and sing for joy: for thou shalt judge the people righteously, and govern the nations upon earth. Selah. {govern: Heb. lead}

verses.en: Let the people praise thee, O YAHUAH; let all the people praise thee.
verses.am: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.

verses.en: Then shall the earth yield her increase; and YAHUAH, even our own YAHUAH, shall bless us.
verses.am: {Then} shall the earth yield her increase; {and} God, {even} our own God, shall bless us.

verses.en: YAHUAH shall bless us; and all the ends of the earth shall fear him.
verses.am: God shall bless us; and all the ends of the earth shall fear him.

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm or Song of Dawid.] Let YAHUAH arise, let his enemies be scattered: let them also that hate him flee before him.
verses.am: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm {or} Song of David.] Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered: let them also that hate him flee before him. {before...: Heb. from his face}

verses.en: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away: as wax melteth before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of YAHUAH.
verses.am: As smoke is driven away, {so} drive {them} away: as wax melteth before the fire, {so} let the wicked perish at the presence of God.

verses.en: But let the righteous be glad; let them rejoice before YAHUAH: yea, let them exceedingly rejoice.
verses.am: But let the righteous be glad; let them rejoice before God: yea, let them exceedingly rejoice. {exceedingly...: Heb. rejoice with gladness}

verses.en: Sing unto YAHUAH, sing praises to his name: extol him that rideth upon the heavens by his name JAH, and rejoice before him.
verses.am: Sing unto God, sing praises to his name: extol him that rideth upon the heavens by his name JAH, and rejoice before him.

verses.en: A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, is YAHUAH in his holy habitation.
verses.am: A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, {is} God in his holy habitation.

verses.en: YAHUAH setteth the solitary in families: he bringeth out those which are bound with chains: but the rebellious dwell in a dry land.
verses.am: God setteth the solitary in families: he bringeth out those which are bound with chains: but the rebellious dwell in a dry {land}. {in families: Heb. in a house}

verses.en: O YAHUAH, when thou wentest forth before thy people, when thou didst march through the wilderness; Selah:
verses.am: O God, when thou wentest forth before thy people, when thou didst march through the wilderness; Selah:

verses.en: The earth shook, the heavens also dropped at the presence of YAHUAH: even Sinai itself was moved at the presence of YAHUAH, YAHUAH of Yisra'el.
verses.am: The earth shook, the heavens also dropped at the presence of God: {even} Sinai itself {was moved} at the presence of God, the God of Israel.

verses.en: Thou, O YAHUAH, didst send a plentiful rain, whereby thou didst confirm thine inheritance, when it was weary.
verses.am: Thou, O God, didst send a plentiful rain, whereby thou didst confirm thine inheritance, when it was weary. {send: Heb. shake out} {confirm: Heb. confirm it}

verses.en: Thy congregation hath dwelt therein: thou, O YAHUAH, hast prepared of thy goodness for the poor.
verses.am: Thy congregation hath dwelt therein: thou, O God, hast prepared of thy goodness for the poor.

verses.en: YAHUAH gave the word: great was the company of those that published it.
verses.am: The Lord gave the word: great {was} the company of those that published {it}. {company: Heb. army}

verses.en: Kings of armies did flee apace: and she that tarried at home divided the spoil.
verses.am: Kings of armies did flee apace: and she that tarried at home divided the spoil. {did...: Heb. did flee, did flee}

verses.en: Though ye have lien among the pots, yet shall ye be as the wings of a dove covered with silver, and her feathers with yellow gold.
verses.am: Though ye have lien among the pots, {yet shall ye be as} the wings of a dove covered with silver, and her feathers with yellow gold.

verses.en: When the Almighty scattered kings in it, it was white as snow in Salmon.
verses.am: When the Almighty scattered kings in it, it was {white} as snow in Salmon. {in it...: or, for her, she}

verses.en: The hill of YAHUAH is as the hill of Bashan; an high hill as the hill of Bashan.
verses.am: The hill of God {is as} the hill of Bashan; an high hill {as} the hill of Bashan.

verses.en: Why leap ye, ye high hills? this is the hill which YAHUAH desireth to dwell in; yea, YAHUAH will dwell in it for ever.
verses.am: Why leap ye, ye high hills? {this is} the hill {which} God desireth to dwell in; yea, the LORD will dwell {in it} for ever.

verses.en: The chariots of YAHUAH are twenty thousand, even thousands of angels: YAHUAH is among them, as in Sinai, in the holy place.
verses.am: The chariots of God {are} twenty thousand, {even} thousands of angels: the Lord {is} among them, {as in} Sinai, in the holy {place}. {even...: or, even many thousands}

verses.en: Thou hast ascended on high, thou hast led captivity captive: thou hast received gifts for men; yea, for the rebellious also, that YAHUAH might dwell among them.
verses.am: Thou hast ascended on high, thou hast led captivity captive: thou hast received gifts for men; yea, {for} the rebellious also, that the LORD God might dwell {among them}. {for men: Heb. in the man}

verses.en: Blessed be YAHUAH, who daily loadeth us with benefits, even YAHUAH of our salvation. Selah.
verses.am: Blessed {be} the Lord, {who} daily loadeth us {with benefits, even} the God of our salvation. Selah.

verses.en: He that is our YAHUAH is YAHUAH of salvation; and unto YAHUAH belong the issues from death.
verses.am: {He that is} our God {is} the God of salvation; and unto GOD the Lord {belong} the issues from death.

verses.en: But YAHUAH shall wound the head of his enemies, and the hairy scalp of such an one as goeth on still in his trespasses.
verses.am: But God shall wound the head of his enemies, {and} the hairy scalp of such an one as goeth on still in his trespasses.

verses.en: YAHUAH said, I will bring again from Bashan, I will bring my people again from the depths of the sea:
verses.am: The Lord said, I will bring again from Bashan, I will bring {my people} again from the depths of the sea:

verses.en: That thy foot may be dipped in the blood of thine enemies, and the tongue of thy dogs in the same.
verses.am: That thy foot may be dipped in the blood of {thine} enemies, {and} the tongue of thy dogs in the same. {dipped: or, red}

verses.en: They have seen thy goings, O YAHUAH; even the goings of my YAHUAH, my King, in the sanctuary.
verses.am: They have seen thy goings, O God; {even} the goings of my God, my King, in the sanctuary.

verses.en: The singers went before, the players on instruments followed after; among them were the damsels playing with timbrels.
verses.am: The singers went before, the players on instruments {followed} after; among {them were} the damsels playing with timbrels.

verses.en: Bless ye YAHUAH in the congregations, even YAHUAH, from the fountain of Yisra'el.
verses.am: Bless ye God in the congregations, {even} the Lord, from the fountain of Israel. {from...: or, ye that are of the fountain of Israel}

verses.en: There is little Benjamin with their ruler, the princes of Yehudah and their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.
verses.am: There {is} little Benjamin {with} their ruler, the princes of Judah {and} their council, the princes of Zebulun, {and} the princes of Naphtali. {and their...: or, with their company}

verses.en: Thy YAHUAH hath commanded thy strength: strengthen, O YAHUAH, that which thou hast wrought for us.
verses.am: Thy God hath commanded thy strength: strengthen, O God, that which thou hast wrought for us.

verses.en: Because of thy temple at Yerushalayim shall kings bring presents unto thee.
verses.am: Because of thy temple at Jerusalem shall kings bring presents unto thee.

verses.en: Rebuke the company of spearmen, the multitude of the bulls, with the calves of the people, till every one submit himself with pieces of silver: scatter thou the people that delight in war.
verses.am: Rebuke the company of spearmen, the multitude of the bulls, with the calves of the people, {till every one} submit himself with pieces of silver: scatter thou the people {that} delight in war. {the company...: or, the beasts of the reeds} {scatter...: or, he scattereth}

verses.en: Princes shall come out of Mitsrayim; Ethiopia shall soon stretch out her hands unto YAHUAH.
verses.am: Princes shall come out of Egypt; Ethiopia shall soon stretch out her hands unto God.

verses.en: Sing unto YAHUAH, ye kingdoms of the earth; O sing praises unto YAHUAH; Selah:
verses.am: Sing unto God, ye kingdoms of the earth; O sing praises unto the Lord; Selah:

verses.en: To him that rideth upon the heavens of heavens, which were of old; lo, he doth send out his voice, and that a mighty voice.
verses.am: To him that rideth upon the heavens of heavens, {which were} of old; lo, he doth send out his voice, {and that} a mighty voice. {send...: Heb. give}

verses.en: Ascribe ye strength unto YAHUAH: his excellency is over Yisra'el, and his strength is in the clouds.
verses.am: Ascribe ye strength unto God: his excellency {is} over Israel, and his strength {is} in the clouds. {clouds: or, heavens}

verses.en: O YAHUAH, thou art terrible out of thy holy places: YAHUAH of Yisra'el is he that giveth strength and power unto his people. Blessed be YAHUAH.
verses.am: O God, {thou art} terrible out of thy holy places: the God of Israel {is} he that giveth strength and power unto {his} people. Blessed {be} God.

verses.en: [To the chief Musician upon Shoshannim, A Psalm of Dawid.] Save me, O YAHUAH; for the waters are come in unto my soul.
verses.am: [To the chief Musician upon Shoshannim, {A Psalm} of David.] Save me, O God; for the waters are come in unto {my} soul.

verses.en: I sink in deep mire, where there is no standing: I am come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.
verses.am: I sink in deep mire, where {there is} no standing: I am come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me. {deep mire: Heb. the mire of depth} {deep waters: Heb. depth of waters}

verses.en: I am weary of my crying: my throat is dried: mine eyes fail while I wait for my YAHUAH.
verses.am: I am weary of my crying: my throat is dried: mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.

verses.en: They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of mine head: they that would destroy me, being mine enemies wrongfully, are mighty: then I restored that which I took not away.
verses.am: They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of mine head: they that would destroy me, {being} mine enemies wrongfully, are mighty: then I restored {that} which I took not away.

verses.en: O YAHUAH, thou knowest my foolishness; and my sins are not hid from thee.
verses.am: O God, thou knowest my foolishness; and my sins are not hid from thee. {sins: Heb. guiltiness}

verses.en: Let not them that wait on thee, O YAHUAH of hosts, be ashamed for my sake: let not those that seek thee be confounded for my sake, O YAHUAH of Yisra'el.
verses.am: Let not them that wait on thee, O Lord GOD of hosts, be ashamed for my sake: let not those that seek thee be confounded for my sake, O God of Israel.

verses.en: Because for thy sake I have borne reproach; shame hath covered my face.
verses.am: Because for thy sake I have borne reproach; shame hath covered my face.

verses.en: I am become a stranger unto my brethren, and an alien unto my mother's children.
verses.am: I am become a stranger unto my brethren, and an alien unto my mother's children.

verses.en: For the zeal of thine house hath eaten me up; and the reproaches of them that reproached thee are fallen upon me.
verses.am: For the zeal of thine house hath eaten me up; and the reproaches of them that reproached thee are fallen upon me.

verses.en: When I wept, and chastened my soul with fasting, that was to my reproach.
verses.am: When I wept, {and chastened} my soul with fasting, that was to my reproach.

verses.en: I made sackcloth also my garment; and I became a proverb to them.
verses.am: I made sackcloth also my garment; and I became a proverb to them.

verses.en: They that sit in the gate speak against me; and I was the song of the drunkards.
verses.am: They that sit in the gate speak against me; and I {was} the song of the drunkards. {drunkards: Heb. drinkers of strong drink}

verses.en: But as for me, my prayer is unto thee, O YAHUAH, in an acceptable time: O YAHUAH, in the multitude of thy mercy hear me, in the truth of thy salvation.
verses.am: But as for me, my prayer {is} unto thee, O LORD, {in} an acceptable time: O God, in the multitude of thy mercy hear me, in the truth of thy salvation.

verses.en: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink: let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.
verses.am: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink: let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.

verses.en: Let not the waterflood overflow me, neither let the deep swallow me up, and let not the pit shut her mouth upon me.
verses.am: Let not the waterflood overflow me, neither let the deep swallow me up, and let not the pit shut her mouth upon me.

verses.en: Hear me, O YAHUAH; for thy lovingkindness is good: turn unto me according to the multitude of thy tender mercies.
verses.am: Hear me, O LORD; for thy lovingkindness {is} good: turn unto me according to the multitude of thy tender mercies.

verses.en: And hide not thy face from thy servant; for I am in trouble: hear me speedily.
verses.am: And hide not thy face from thy servant; for I am in trouble: hear me speedily. {hear...: Heb. make haste to hear me}

verses.am: Draw nigh unto my soul, {and} redeem it: deliver me because of mine enemies.

verses.en: Thou hast known my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonour: mine adversaries are all before thee.
verses.am: Thou hast known my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonour: mine adversaries {are} all before thee.

verses.am: Reproach hath broken my heart; and I am full of heaviness: and I looked {for some} to take pity, but {there was} none; and for comforters, but I found none. {to take...: Heb. to lament with me}

verses.en: They gave me also gall for my meat; and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.
verses.am: They gave me also gall for my meat; and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.

verses.en: Let their table become a snare before them: and that which should have been for their welfare, let it become a trap.
verses.am: Let their table become a snare before them: and {that which should have been} for {their} welfare, {let it become} a trap.

verses.en: Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not; and make their loins continually to shake.
verses.am: Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not; and make their loins continually to shake.

verses.en: Pour out thine indignation upon them, and let thy wrathful anger take hold of them.
verses.am: Pour out thine indignation upon them, and let thy wrathful anger take hold of them.

verses.en: Let their habitation be desolate; and let none dwell in their tents.
verses.am: Let their habitation be desolate; {and} let none dwell in their tents. {their habitation: Heb. their palace} {let none...: Heb. let there not be a dweller}

verses.en: For they persecute him whom thou hast smitten; and they talk to the grief of those whom thou hast wounded.
verses.am: For they persecute {him} whom thou hast smitten; and they talk to the grief of those whom thou hast wounded. {those...: Heb. thy wounded}

verses.en: Add iniquity unto their iniquity: and let them not come into thy righteousness.
verses.am: Add iniquity unto their iniquity: and let them not come into thy righteousness. {iniquity unto...: or, punishment of iniquity, etc}

verses.en: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, and not be written with the righteous.
verses.am: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, and not be written with the righteous.

verses.am: But I {am} poor and sorrowful: let thy salvation, O God, set me up on high.

verses.en: For YAHUAH heareth the poor, and despiseth not his prisoners.
verses.am: For the LORD heareth the poor, and despiseth not his prisoners.

verses.en: Let the heaven and earth praise him, the seas, and every thing that moveth therein.
verses.am: Let the heaven and earth praise him, the seas, and every thing that moveth therein. {moveth: Heb. creepeth}

verses.en: For YAHUAH will save Zion, and will build the cities of Yehudah: that they may dwell there, and have it in possession.
verses.am: For God will save Zion, and will build the cities of Judah: that they may dwell there, and have it in possession.

verses.en: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it: and they that love his name shall dwell therein.
verses.am: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it: and they that love his name shall dwell therein.

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of Dawid, to bring to remembrance.] Make haste, O YAHUAH, to deliver me; make haste to help me, O YAHUAH.
verses.am: [To the chief Musician, {A Psalm} of David, to bring to remembrance.] {Make haste}, O God, to deliver me; make haste to help me, O LORD. {to help...: Heb. to my help}

verses.en: Let them be ashamed and confounded that seek after my soul: let them be turned backward, and put to confusion, that desire my hurt.

verses.am: Let them be turned back for a reward of their shame that say, Aha, aha.

verses.en: I am as a wonder unto many; but thou art my strong refuge.
verses.am: I am as a wonder unto many; but thou {art} my strong refuge.

verses.am: Let my mouth be filled {with} thy praise {and with} thy honour all the day.

verses.am: Cast me not off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength faileth.

verses.en: For mine enemies speak against me; and they that lay wait for my soul take counsel together,
verses.am: For mine enemies speak against me; and they that lay wait for my soul take counsel together, {lay...: Heb. watch, or, observe}

verses.am: Thou shalt increase my greatness, and comfort me on every side.

verses.en: My tongue also shall talk of thy righteousness all the day long: for they are confounded, for they are brought unto shame, that seek my hurt.
verses.am: My tongue also shall talk of thy righteousness all the day long: for they are confounded, for they are brought unto shame, that seek my hurt.

verses.am: He shall judge the poor of the people, he shall save the children of the needy, and shall break in pieces the oppressor.

verses.am: They shall fear thee as long as the sun and moon endure, throughout all generations.

verses.en: He shall come down like rain upon the mown grass: as showers that water the earth.
verses.am: He shall come down like rain upon the mown grass: as showers {that} water the earth.

verses.am: They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him; and his enemies shall lick the dust.

verses.am: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall bring presents: the kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.

verses.en: Yea, all kings shall fall down before him: all nations shall serve him.
verses.am: Yea, all kings shall fall down before him: all nations shall serve him.

verses.am: For he shall deliver the needy when he crieth; the poor also, and {him} that hath no helper.

verses.am: He shall spare the poor and needy, and shall save the souls of the needy.

verses.am: He shall redeem their soul from deceit and violence: and precious shall their blood be in his sight.

verses.en: And he shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba: prayer also shall be made for him continually; and daily shall he be praised.
verses.am: And he shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba: prayer also shall be made for him continually; {and} daily shall he be praised. {shall be given: Heb. one shall give}

verses.am: There shall be an handful of corn in the earth upon the top of the mountains; the fruit thereof shall shake like Lebanon: and {they} of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth.

verses.am: His name shall endure for ever: his name shall be continued as long as the sun: and {men} shall be blessed in him: all nations shall call him blessed. {endure: Heb. be} {his name shall be...: Heb. shall be as a son to continue his father's name for ever}

verses.am: Blessed {be} the LORD God, the God of Israel, who only doeth wondrous things.

verses.am: And blessed {be} his glorious name for ever: and let the whole earth be filled {with} his glory; Amen, and Amen.

verses.en: The prayers of Dawid the son of Jesse are ended.
verses.am: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.

verses.en: [A Psalm of Asaph.] Truly YAHUAH is good to Yisra'el, even to such as are of a clean heart.
verses.am: [A Psalm of Asaph.] Truly God {is} good to Israel, {even} to such as are of a clean heart. {of: or, for} {Truly: or, Yet} {of...: Heb. clean of heart}

verses.en: But as for me, my feet were almost gone; my steps had well nigh slipped.
verses.am: But as for me, my feet were almost gone; my steps had well nigh slipped.

verses.en: For I was envious at the foolish, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
verses.am: For I was envious at the foolish, {when} I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

verses.am: For {there are} no bands in their death: but their strength {is} firm. {firm: Heb. fat}

verses.am: Therefore pride compasseth them about as a chain; violence covereth them {as} a garment.

verses.am: Their eyes stand out with fatness: they have more than heart could wish. {have...: Heb. pass the thoughts of the heart}

verses.am: They are corrupt, and speak wickedly {concerning} oppression: they speak loftily.

verses.en: They set their mouth against the heavens, and their tongue walketh through the earth.
verses.am: They set their mouth against the heavens, and their tongue walketh through the earth.

verses.en: Therefore his people return hither: and waters of a full cup are wrung out to them.
verses.am: Therefore his people return hither: and waters of a full {cup} are wrung out to them.

verses.am: And they say, How doth God know? and is there knowledge in the most High?

verses.en: Behold, these are the ungodly, who prosper in the world; they increase in riches.
verses.am: Behold, these {are} the ungodly, who prosper in the world; they increase {in} riches.

verses.en: Verily I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocency.
verses.am: Verily I have cleansed my heart {in} vain, and washed my hands in innocency.

verses.en: For all the day long have I been plagued, and chastened every morning.
verses.am: For all the day long have I been plagued, and chastened every morning. {chastened: Heb. my chastisement was}

verses.am: If I say, I will speak thus; behold, I should offend {against} the generation of thy children.

verses.en: When I thought to know this, it was too painful for me;

verses.en: Thou didst cleave the fountain and the flood: thou driedst up mighty rivers.
verses.am: Thou didst cleave the fountain and the flood: thou driedst up mighty rivers. {mighty...: Heb. rivers of strength}

verses.en: The day is thine, the night also is thine: thou hast prepared the light and the sun.
verses.am: The day {is} thine, the night also {is} thine: thou hast prepared the light and the sun.

verses.en: Thou hast set all the borders of the earth: thou hast made summer and winter.
verses.am: Thou hast set all the borders of the earth: thou hast made summer and winter. {made: Heb. made them}

verses.en: Remember this, that the enemy hath reproached, O YAHUAH, and that the foolish people have blasphemed thy name.
verses.am: Remember this, {that} the enemy hath reproached, O LORD, and {that} the foolish people have blasphemed thy name.

verses.en: O deliver not the soul of thy turtledove unto the multitude of the wicked: forget not the congregation of thy poor for ever.
verses.am: O deliver not the soul of thy turtledove unto the multitude {of the wicked}: forget not the congregation of thy poor for ever.

verses.en: Have respect unto the covenant: for the dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of cruelty.
verses.am: Have respect unto the covenant: for the dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of cruelty.

verses.en: O let not the oppressed return ashamed: let the poor and needy praise thy name.
verses.am: O let not the oppressed return ashamed: let the poor and needy praise thy name.

verses.en: Arise, O YAHUAH, plead thine own cause: remember how the foolish man reproacheth thee daily.
verses.am: Arise, O God, plead thine own cause: remember how the foolish man reproacheth thee daily.

verses.en: Forget not the voice of thine enemies: the tumult of those that rise up against thee increaseth continually.
verses.am: Forget not the voice of thine enemies: the tumult of those that rise up against thee increaseth continually. {increaseth: Heb. ascendeth}

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, Altaschith, A Psalm or Song of Asaph.] Unto thee, O YAHUAH, do we give thanks, unto thee do we give thanks: for that thy name is near thy wondrous works declare.
verses.am: [To the chief Musician, Altaschith, A Psalm {or} Song of Asaph.] Unto thee, O God, do we give thanks, {unto thee} do we give thanks: for {that} thy name is near thy wondrous works declare. {Altaschith: or, Destroy not} {of: or, for}

verses.en: When I shall receive the congregation I will judge uprightly.
verses.am: When I shall receive the congregation I will judge uprightly. {receive...: or, take a set time}

verses.en: The earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved: I bear up the pillars of it. Selah.
verses.am: The earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved: I bear up the pillars of it. Selah.

verses.en: I said unto the fools, Deal not foolishly: and to the wicked, Lift not up the horn:
verses.am: I said unto the fools, Deal not foolishly: and to the wicked, Lift not up the horn:

verses.en: Lift not up your horn on high: speak not with a stiff neck.
verses.am: Lift not up your horn on high: speak {not with} a stiff neck.

verses.en: For promotion cometh neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the south.
verses.am: For promotion {cometh} neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the south. {south: Heb. desert}

verses.en: But YAHUAH is the judge: he putteth down one, and setteth up another.
verses.am: But God {is} the judge: he putteth down one, and setteth up another.

verses.en: For in the hand of YAHUAH there is a cup, and the wine is red; it is full of mixture; and he poureth out of the same: but the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall wring them out, and drink them.
verses.am: For in the hand of the LORD {there is} a cup, and the wine is red; it is full of mixture; and he poureth out of the same: but the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall wring {them} out, {and} drink {them}.

verses.en: But I will declare for ever; I will sing praises to YAHUAH of Ya'aqob.
verses.am: But I will declare for ever; I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.

verses.en: All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; but the horns of the righteous shall be exalted.
verses.am: All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; {but} the horns of the righteous shall be exalted.

verses.en: [To the chief Musician on Neginoth, A Psalm or Song of Asaph.] In Yehudah is YAHUAH known: his name is great in Yisra'el.
verses.am: [To the chief Musician on Neginoth, A Psalm {or} Song of Asaph.] In Judah {is} God known: his name {is} great in Israel. {chief...: or, overseer} {of: or, for}

verses.en: In Salem also is his tabernacle, and his dwelling place in Zion.
verses.am: In Salem also is his tabernacle, and his dwelling place in Zion.

verses.en: There brake he the arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the battle. Selah.
verses.am: There brake he the arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the battle. Selah.

verses.en: Thou art more glorious and excellent than the mountains of prey.
verses.am: Thou {art} more glorious {and} excellent than the mountains of prey.

verses.en: The stouthearted are spoiled, they have slept their sleep: and none of the men of might have found their hands.
verses.am: The stouthearted are spoiled, they have slept their sleep: and none of the men of might have found their hands.

verses.en: At thy rebuke, O YAHUAH of Ya'aqob, both the chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.
verses.am: At thy rebuke, O God of Jacob, both the chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.

verses.en: Thou, even thou, art to be feared: and who may stand in thy sight when once thou art angry?
verses.am: Thou, {even} thou, {art} to be feared: and who may stand in thy sight when once thou art angry?

verses.en: Thou didst cause judgment to be heard from heaven; the earth feared, and was still,
verses.am: Thou didst cause judgment to be heard from heaven; the earth feared, and was still,

verses.en: When YAHUAH arose to judgment, to save all the meek of the earth. Selah.
verses.am: When God arose to judgment, to save all the meek of the earth. Selah.

verses.en: Surely the wrath of man shall praise thee: the remainder of wrath shalt thou restrain.
verses.am: Surely the wrath of man shall praise thee: the remainder of wrath shalt thou restrain.

verses.en: Vow, and pay unto YAHUAH your YAHUAH: let all that be round about him bring presents unto him that ought to be feared.
verses.am: Vow, and pay unto the LORD your God: let all that be round about him bring presents unto him that ought to be feared. {unto him...: Heb. to fear}

verses.en: He shall cut off the spirit of princes: he is terrible to the kings of the earth.
verses.am: He shall cut off the spirit of princes: {he is} terrible to the kings of the earth.

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, to Jeduthun, A Psalm of Asaph.] I cried unto YAHUAH with my voice, even unto YAHUAH with my voice; and he gave ear unto me.
verses.am: [To the chief Musician, to Jeduthun, A Psalm of Asaph.] I cried unto God with my voice, {even} unto God with my voice; and he gave ear unto me. {of: or, for}

verses.en: In the day of my trouble I sought YAHUAH: my sore ran in the night, and ceased not: my soul refused to be comforted.
verses.am: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord: my sore ran in the night, and ceased not: my soul refused to be comforted. {sore: Heb. hand}

verses.en: I remembered YAHUAH, and was troubled: I complained, and my spirit was overwhelmed. Selah.
verses.am: I remembered God, and was troubled: I complained, and my spirit was overwhelmed. Selah.

verses.en: Thou holdest mine eyes waking: I am so troubled that I cannot speak.
verses.am: Thou holdest mine eyes waking: I am so troubled that I cannot speak.

verses.en: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.
verses.am: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.

verses.en: I call to remembrance my song in the night: I commune with mine own heart: and my spirit made diligent search.
verses.am: I call to remembrance my song in the night: I commune with mine own heart: and my spirit made diligent search.

verses.en: Will YAHUAH cast off for ever? and will he be favourable no more?
verses.am: Will the Lord cast off for ever? and will he be favourable no more?

verses.en: Is his mercy clean gone for ever? doth his promise fail for evermore?
verses.am: Is his mercy clean gone for ever? doth {his} promise fail for evermore? {for evermore: Heb. to generation and generation?}

verses.en: Hath YAHUAH forgotten to be gracious? hath he in anger shut up his tender mercies? Selah.
verses.am: Hath God forgotten to be gracious? hath he in anger shut up his tender mercies? Selah.

verses.en: And I said, This is my infirmity: but I will remember the years of the right hand of the most High.
verses.am: And I said, This {is} my infirmity: {but I will remember} the years of the right hand of the most High.

verses.en: I will remember the works of YAHUAH: surely I will remember thy wonders of old.
verses.am: I will remember the works of the LORD: surely I will remember thy wonders of old.

verses.en: I will meditate also of all thy work, and talk of thy doings.
verses.am: I will meditate also of all thy work, and talk of thy doings.

verses.en: Thy way, O YAHUAH, is in the sanctuary: who is so great a YAHUAH as our YAHUAH?
verses.am: Thy way, O God, {is} in the sanctuary: who {is so} great a God as {our} God?

verses.en: Thou art YAHUAH that doest wonders: thou hast declared thy strength among the people.
verses.am: Thou {art} the God that doest wonders: thou hast declared thy strength among the people.

verses.en: Thou hast with thine arm redeemed thy people, the sons of Ya'aqob and Yoseph. Selah.
verses.am: Thou hast with {thine} arm redeemed thy people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.

verses.en: The waters saw thee, O YAHUAH, the waters saw thee; they were afraid: the depths also were troubled.
verses.am: The waters saw thee, O God, the waters saw thee; they were afraid: the depths also were troubled.

verses.en: The clouds poured out water: the skies sent out a sound: thine arrows also went abroad.
verses.am: The clouds poured out water: the skies sent out a sound: thine arrows also went abroad. {poured...: Heb. were poured forth with water}

verses.en: The voice of thy thunder was in the heaven: the lightnings lightened the world: the earth trembled and shook.
verses.am: The voice of thy thunder {was} in the heaven: the lightnings lightened the world: the earth trembled and shook.

verses.en: Thy way is in the sea, and thy path in the great waters, and thy footsteps are not known.
verses.am: Thy way {is} in the sea, and thy path in the great waters, and thy footsteps are not known.

verses.en: Thou leddest thy people like a flock by the hand of Mosheh and Aaron.
verses.am: Thou leddest thy people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

verses.en: [Maschil of Asaph.] Give ear, O my people, to my law: incline your ears to the words of my mouth.
verses.am: [Maschil of Asaph.] Give ear, O my people, {to} my law: incline your ears to the words of my mouth. {Maschil...: or, A Psalm for Asaph to give instruction}

verses.en: I will open my mouth in a parable: I will utter dark sayings of old:
verses.am: I will open my mouth in a parable: I will utter dark sayings of old:

verses.en: Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.
verses.am: Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.

verses.en: We will not hide them from their children, shewing to the generation to come the praises of YAHUAH, and his strength, and his wonderful works that he hath done.
verses.am: We will not hide {them} from their children, shewing to the generation to come the praises of the LORD, and his strength, and his wonderful works that he hath done.

verses.en: For he established a testimony in Ya'aqob, and appointed a law in Yisra'el, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children:
verses.am: For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children:

verses.en: That the generation to come might know them, even the children which should be born; who should arise and declare them to their children:
verses.am: That the generation to come might know {them, even} the children {which} should be born; {who} should arise and declare {them} to their children:

verses.en: That they might set their hope in YAHUAH, and not forget the works of YAHUAH, but keep his commandments:
verses.am: That they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep his commandments:

verses.en: And might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation; a generation that set not their heart aright, and whose spirit was not stedfast with YAHUAH.
verses.am: And might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation; a generation {that} set not their heart aright, and whose spirit was not stedfast with God. {that...: Heb. that prepared not their heart}

verses.en: The children of Ephraim, being armed, and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.
verses.am: The children of Ephraim, {being} armed, {and} carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle. {carrying: Heb. throwing forth}

verses.en: They kept not the covenant of YAHUAH, and refused to walk in his law;
verses.am: They kept not the covenant of God, and refused to walk in his law;

verses.en: And forgat his works, and his wonders that he had shewed them.
