verses.am: And forgat his works, and his wonders that he had shewed them.

verses.en: Marvellous things did he in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Mitsrayim, in the field of Zoan.
verses.am: Marvellous things did he in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, {in} the field of Zoan.

verses.en: He divided the sea, and caused them to pass through; and he made the waters to stand as an heap.
verses.am: He divided the sea, and caused them to pass through; and he made the waters to stand as an heap.

verses.en: In the daytime also he led them with a cloud, and all the night with a light of fire.
verses.am: In the daytime also he led them with a cloud, and all the night with a light of fire.

verses.en: He clave the rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink as out of the great depths.
verses.am: He clave the rocks in the wilderness, and gave {them} drink as {out of} the great depths.

verses.en: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.
verses.am: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.

verses.en: And they sinned yet more against him by provoking the most High in the wilderness.
verses.am: And they sinned yet more against him by provoking the most High in the wilderness.

verses.en: And they tempted YAHUAH in their heart by asking meat for their lust.
verses.am: And they tempted God in their heart by asking meat for their lust.

verses.en: Yea, they spake against YAHUAH; they said, Can YAHUAH furnish a table in the wilderness?
verses.am: Yea, they spake against God; they said, Can God furnish a table in the wilderness? {furnish: Heb. order}

verses.en: Behold, he smote the rock, that the waters gushed out, and the streams overflowed; can he give bread also? can he provide flesh for his people?
verses.am: Behold, he smote the rock, that the waters gushed out, and the streams overflowed; can he give bread also? can he provide flesh for his people?

verses.en: Therefore YAHUAH heard this, and was wroth: so a fire was kindled against Ya'aqob, and anger also came up against Yisra'el;
verses.am: Therefore the LORD heard {this}, and was wroth: so a fire was kindled against Jacob, and anger also came up against Israel;

verses.en: Because they believed not in YAHUAH, and trusted not in his salvation:
verses.am: Because they believed not in God, and trusted not in his salvation:

verses.en: Though he had commanded the clouds from above, and opened the doors of heaven,
verses.am: Though he had commanded the clouds from above, and opened the doors of heaven,

verses.en: And had rained down manna upon them to eat, and had given them of the corn of heaven.
verses.am: And had rained down manna upon them to eat, and had given them of the corn of heaven.

verses.en: Man did eat angels' food: he sent them meat to the full.
verses.am: Man did eat angels' food: he sent them meat to the full. {Man...: or, Every one did eat the bread of the mighty}

verses.en: He caused an east wind to blow in the heaven: and by his power he brought in the south wind.
verses.am: He caused an east wind to blow in the heaven: and by his power he brought in the south wind. {to blow: Heb. to go}

verses.en: He rained flesh also upon them as dust, and feathered fowls like as the sand of the sea:
verses.am: He rained flesh also upon them as dust, and feathered fowls like as the sand of the sea: {feathered...: Heb. fowl of wing}

verses.en: And he let it fall in the midst of their camp, round about their habitations.
verses.am: And he let {it} fall in the midst of their camp, round about their habitations.

verses.en: So they did eat, and were well filled: for he gave them their own desire;
verses.am: So they did eat, and were well filled: for he gave them their own desire;

verses.en: They were not estranged from their lust. But while their meat was yet in their mouths,
verses.am: They were not estranged from their lust. But while their meat {was} yet in their mouths,

verses.en: The wrath of YAHUAH came upon them, and slew the fattest of them, and smote down the chosen men of Yisra'el.
verses.am: The wrath of God came upon them, and slew the fattest of them, and smote down the chosen {men} of Israel. {smote...: Heb. made to bow} {Chosen...: or, young men}

verses.en: For all this they sinned still, and believed not for his wondrous works.
verses.am: For all this they sinned still, and believed not for his wondrous works.

verses.en: Therefore their days did he consume in vanity, and their years in trouble.
verses.am: Therefore their days did he consume in vanity, and their years in trouble.

verses.en: When he slew them, then they sought him: and they returned and enquired early after YAHUAH.
verses.am: When he slew them, then they sought him: and they returned and enquired early after God.

verses.en: And they remembered that YAHUAH was their rock, and the high YAHUAH their redeemer.
verses.am: And they remembered that God {was} their rock, and the high God their redeemer.

verses.en: Nevertheless they did flatter him with their mouth, and they lied unto him with their tongues.
verses.am: Nevertheless they did flatter him with their mouth, and they lied unto him with their tongues.

verses.en: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they stedfast in his covenant.
verses.am: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they stedfast in his covenant.

verses.en: But he, being full of compassion, forgave their iniquity, and destroyed them not: yea, many a time turned he his anger away, and did not stir up all his wrath.
verses.am: But he, {being} full of compassion, forgave {their} iniquity, and destroyed {them} not: yea, many a time turned he his anger away, and did not stir up all his wrath.

verses.en: For he remembered that they were but flesh; a wind that passeth away, and cometh not again.
verses.am: For he remembered that they {were but} flesh; a wind that passeth away, and cometh not again.

verses.en: How oft did they provoke him in the wilderness, and grieve him in the desert!
verses.am: How oft did they provoke him in the wilderness, {and} grieve him in the desert! {provoke: or, rebel against}

verses.en: Yea, they turned back and tempted YAHUAH, and limited the Holy One of Yisra'el.
verses.am: Yea, they turned back and tempted God, and limited the Holy One of Israel.

verses.en: They remembered not his hand, nor the day when he delivered them from the enemy.
verses.am: They remembered not his hand, {nor} the day when he delivered them from the enemy. {from...: or, from affliction}

verses.en: How he had wrought his signs in Mitsrayim, and his wonders in the field of Zoan:
verses.am: How he had wrought his signs in Egypt, and his wonders in the field of Zoan: {wrought: Heb. set}

verses.en: And had turned their rivers into blood; and their floods, that they could not drink.
verses.am: And had turned their rivers into blood; and their floods, that they could not drink.

verses.en: He sent divers sorts of flies among them, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.
verses.am: He sent divers sorts of flies among them, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.

verses.en: He gave also their increase unto the caterpiller, and their labour unto the locust.
verses.am: He gave also their increase unto the caterpiller, and their labour unto the locust.

verses.en: He destroyed their vines with hail, and their sycomore trees with frost.
verses.am: He destroyed their vines with hail, and their sycomore trees with frost. {destroyed: Heb. killed} {frost: or, great hailstones}

verses.en: He gave up their cattle also to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.
verses.am: He gave up their cattle also to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts. {gave...: Heb. shut up} {hot...: or, lightnings}

verses.en: He cast upon them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, and indignation, and trouble, by sending evil angels among them.
verses.am: He cast upon them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, and indignation, and trouble, by sending evil angels {among them}.

verses.en: He made a way to his anger; he spared not their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence;
verses.am: He made a way to his anger; he spared not their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence; {He made...: Heb. He weighed a path} {life...: or, beasts to the murrain}

verses.en: And smote all the firstborn in Mitsrayim; the chief of their strength in the tabernacles of Ham:
verses.am: And smote all the firstborn in Egypt; the chief of {their} strength in the tabernacles of Ham:

verses.en: But made his own people to go forth like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
verses.am: But made his own people to go forth like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.

verses.en: And he led them on safely, so that they feared not: but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.
verses.am: And he led them on safely, so that they feared not: but the sea overwhelmed their enemies. {overwhelmed: Heb. covered}

verses.en: And he brought them to the border of his sanctuary, even to this mountain, which his right hand had purchased.
verses.am: And he brought them to the border of his sanctuary, {even to} this mountain, {which} his right hand had purchased.

verses.en: He cast out the heathen also before them, and divided them an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Yisra'el to dwell in their tents.
verses.am: He cast out the heathen also before them, and divided them an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.

verses.en: Yet they tempted and provoked the most high YAHUAH, and kept not his testimonies:
verses.am: Yet they tempted and provoked the most high God, and kept not his testimonies:

verses.en: But turned back, and dealt unfaithfully like their fathers: they were turned aside like a deceitful bow.
verses.am: But turned back, and dealt unfaithfully like their fathers: they were turned aside like a deceitful bow.

verses.en: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their graven images.
verses.am: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their graven images.

verses.en: When YAHUAH heard this, he was wroth, and greatly abhorred Yisra'el:
verses.am: When God heard {this}, he was wroth, and greatly abhorred Israel:

verses.en: So that he forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men;
verses.am: So that he forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent {which} he placed among men;

verses.en: And delivered his strength into captivity, and his glory into the enemy's hand.
verses.am: And delivered his strength into captivity, and his glory into the enemy's hand.

verses.en: He gave his people over also unto the sword; and was wroth with his inheritance.
verses.am: He gave his people over also unto the sword; and was wroth with his inheritance.

verses.en: The fire consumed their young men; and their maidens were not given to marriage.
verses.am: The fire consumed their young men; and their maidens were not given to marriage. {given...: Heb. praised}

verses.en: Their priests fell by the sword; and their widows made no lamentation.
verses.am: Their priests fell by the sword; and their widows made no lamentation.

verses.en: Then YAHUAH awaked as one out of sleep, and like a mighty man that shouteth by reason of wine.
verses.am: Then the Lord awaked as one out of sleep, {and} like a mighty man that shouteth by reason of wine.

verses.en: And he smote his enemies in the hinder parts: he put them to a perpetual reproach.
verses.am: And he smote his enemies in the hinder parts: he put them to a perpetual reproach.

verses.en: Moreover he refused the tabernacle of Yoseph, and chose not the tribe of Ephraim:
verses.am: Moreover he refused the tabernacle of Joseph, and chose not the tribe of Ephraim:

verses.en: But chose the tribe of Yehudah, the mount Zion which he loved.
verses.am: But chose the tribe of Judah, the mount Zion which he loved.

verses.en: And he built his sanctuary like high palaces, like the earth which he hath established for ever.
verses.am: And he built his sanctuary like high {palaces}, like the earth which he hath established for ever. {established: Heb. founded}

verses.en: He chose Dawid also his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds:
verses.am: He chose David also his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds:

verses.en: From following the ewes great with young he brought him to feed Ya'aqob his people, and Yisra'el his inheritance.
verses.am: From following the ewes great with young he brought him to feed Jacob his people, and Israel his inheritance. {following: Heb. after}

verses.en: So he fed them according to the integrity of his heart; and guided them by the skilfulness of his hands.
verses.am: So he fed them according to the integrity of his heart; and guided them by the skilfulness of his hands.

verses.en: [A Psalm of Asaph.] O YAHUAH, the heathen are come into thine inheritance; thy holy temple have they defiled; they have laid Yerushalayim on heaps.
verses.am: [A Psalm of Asaph.] O God, the heathen are come into thine inheritance; thy holy temple have they defiled; they have laid Jerusalem on heaps. {of: or, for}

verses.en: The dead bodies of thy servants have they given to be meat unto the fowls of the heaven, the flesh of thy saints unto the beasts of the earth.
verses.am: The dead bodies of thy servants have they given {to be} meat unto the fowls of the heaven, the flesh of thy saints unto the beasts of the earth.

verses.en: Their blood have they shed like water round about Yerushalayim; and there was none to bury them.
verses.am: Their blood have they shed like water round about Jerusalem; and {there was} none to bury {them}.

verses.en: We are become a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and derision to them that are round about us.
verses.am: We are become a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and derision to them that are round about us.

verses.en: How long, YAHUAH? wilt thou be angry for ever? shall thy jealousy burn like fire?
verses.am: How long, LORD? wilt thou be angry for ever? shall thy jealousy burn like fire?

verses.en: Pour out thy wrath upon the heathen that have not known thee, and upon the kingdoms that have not called upon thy name.
verses.am: Pour out thy wrath upon the heathen that have not known thee, and upon the kingdoms that have not called upon thy name.

verses.en: For they have devoured Ya'aqob, and laid waste his dwelling place.
verses.am: For they have devoured Jacob, and laid waste his dwelling place.

verses.en: O remember not against us former iniquities: let thy tender mercies speedily prevent us: for we are brought very low.
verses.am: O remember not against us former iniquities: let thy tender mercies speedily prevent us: for we are brought very low. {former...: or, the iniquities of them that were before us}

verses.en: Help us, O YAHUAH of our salvation, for the glory of thy name: and deliver us, and purge away our sins, for thy name's sake.
verses.am: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of thy name: and deliver us, and purge away our sins, for thy name's sake.

verses.en: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is their YAHUAH? let him be known among the heathen in our sight by the revenging of the blood of thy servants which is shed.
verses.am: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where {is} their God? let him be known among the heathen in our sight {by} the revenging of the blood of thy servants {which is} shed. {revenging: Heb. vengeance}

verses.en: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before thee; according to the greatness of thy power preserve thou those that are appointed to die;
verses.am: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before thee; according to the greatness of thy power preserve thou those that are appointed to die; {thy...: Heb. thine arm} {preserve...: Heb. reserve the children of death}

verses.en: And render unto our neighbours sevenfold into their bosom their reproach, wherewith they have reproached thee, O YAHUAH.
verses.am: And render unto our neighbours sevenfold into their bosom their reproach, wherewith they have reproached thee, O Lord.

verses.en: So we thy people and sheep of thy pasture will give thee thanks for ever: we will shew forth thy praise to all generations.
verses.am: So we thy people and sheep of thy pasture will give thee thanks for ever: we will shew forth thy praise to all generations. {to all...: Heb. to generation and generation}

verses.en: [To the chief Musician upon Shoshannimeduth, A Psalm of Asaph.] Give ear, O Shepherd of Yisra'el, thou that leadest Yoseph like a flock; thou that dwellest between the cherubims, shine forth.
verses.am: [To the chief Musician upon Shoshannimeduth, A Psalm of Asaph.] Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, thou that leadest Joseph like a flock; thou that dwellest {between} the cherubims, shine forth. {of: or, for}

verses.en: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh stir up thy strength, and come and save us.
verses.am: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh stir up thy strength, and come {and} save us. {come...: Heb. come for salvation to us}

verses.en: Turn us again, O YAHUAH, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
verses.am: Turn us again, O God, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

verses.en: O YAHUAH of hosts, how long wilt thou be angry against the prayer of thy people?
verses.am: O LORD God of hosts, how long wilt thou be angry against the prayer of thy people? {be...: Heb. smoke}

verses.en: Thou feedest them with the bread of tears; and givest them tears to drink in great measure.
verses.am: Thou feedest them with the bread of tears; and givest them tears to drink in great measure.

verses.en: Thou makest us a strife unto our neighbours: and our enemies laugh among themselves.
verses.am: Thou makest us a strife unto our neighbours: and our enemies laugh among themselves.

verses.en: Turn us again, O YAHUAH of hosts, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
verses.am: Turn us again, O God of hosts, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

verses.en: Thou hast brought a vine out of Mitsrayim: thou hast cast out the heathen, and planted it.
verses.am: Thou hast brought a vine out of Egypt: thou hast cast out the heathen, and planted it.

verses.en: Thou preparedst room before it, and didst cause it to take deep root, and it filled the land.
verses.am: Thou preparedst {room} before it, and didst cause it to take deep root, and it filled the land.

verses.en: The hills were covered with the shadow of it, and the boughs thereof were like the goodly cedars.
verses.am: The hills were covered with the shadow of it, and the boughs thereof {were like} the goodly cedars. {goodly...: Heb. cedars of God}

verses.en: She sent out her boughs unto the sea, and her branches unto the river.
verses.am: She sent out her boughs unto the sea, and her branches unto the river.

verses.en: Why hast thou then broken down her hedges, so that all they which pass by the way do pluck her?
verses.am: Why hast thou {then} broken down her hedges, so that all they which pass by the way do pluck her?

verses.en: The boar out of the wood doth waste it, and the wild beast of the field doth devour it.
verses.am: The boar out of the wood doth waste it, and the wild beast of the field doth devour it.

verses.en: Return, we beseech thee, O YAHUAH of hosts: look down from heaven, and behold, and visit this vine;
verses.am: Return, we beseech thee, O God of hosts: look down from heaven, and behold, and visit this vine;

verses.en: And the vineyard which thy right hand hath planted, and the branch that thou madest strong for thyself.
verses.am: And the vineyard which thy right hand hath planted, and the branch {that} thou madest strong for thyself.

verses.en: It is burned with fire, it is cut down: they perish at the rebuke of thy countenance.
verses.am: {It is} burned with fire, {it is} cut down: they perish at the rebuke of thy countenance.

verses.en: Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand, upon the son of man whom thou madest strong for thyself.
verses.am: Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand, upon the son of man {whom} thou madest strong for thyself.

verses.en: So will not we go back from thee: quicken us, and we will call upon thy name.
verses.am: So will not we go back from thee: quicken us, and we will call upon thy name.

verses.en: Turn us again, O YAHUAH of hosts, cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
verses.am: Turn us again, O LORD God of hosts, cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

verses.en: [To the chief Musician upon Gittith, A Psalm of Asaph.] Sing aloud unto YAHUAH our strength: make a joyful noise unto YAHUAH of Ya'aqob.
verses.am: [To the chief Musician upon Gittith, {A Psalm} of Asaph.] Sing aloud unto God our strength: make a joyful noise unto the God of Jacob. {of Asaph: or, for Asaph}

verses.en: Take a psalm, and bring hither the timbrel, the pleasant harp with the psaltery.
verses.am: Take a psalm, and bring hither the timbrel, the pleasant harp with the psaltery.

verses.en: Blow up the trumpet in the new moon, in the time appointed, on our solemn feast day.
verses.am: Blow up the trumpet in the new moon, in the time appointed, on our solemn feast day.

verses.en: For this was a statute for Yisra'el, and a law of YAHUAH of Ya'aqob.
verses.am: For this {was} a statute for Israel, {and} a law of the God of Jacob.

verses.en: This he ordained in Yoseph for a testimony, when he went out through the land of Mitsrayim: where I heard a language that I understood not.
verses.am: This he ordained in Joseph {for} a testimony, when he went out through the land of Egypt: {where} I heard a language {that} I understood not. {through: or, against}

verses.en: I removed his shoulder from the burden: his hands were delivered from the pots.
verses.am: I removed his shoulder from the burden: his hands were delivered from the pots. {were...: Heb. passed away}

verses.en: Thou calledst in trouble, and I delivered thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder: I proved thee at the waters of Meribah. Selah.
verses.am: Thou calledst in trouble, and I delivered thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder: I proved thee at the waters of Meribah. Selah. {Meribah: or, Strife}

verses.en: Hear, O my people, and I will testify unto thee: O Yisra'el, if thou wilt hearken unto me;
verses.am: Hear, O my people, and I will testify unto thee: O Israel, if thou wilt hearken unto me;

verses.en: There shall no strange god be in thee; neither shalt thou worship any strange god.
verses.am: There shall no strange god be in thee; neither shalt thou worship any strange god.

verses.en: I am YAHUAH thy YAHUAH, which brought thee out of the land of Mitsrayim: open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.
verses.am: I {am} the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt: open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.

verses.en: But my people would not hearken to my voice; and Yisra'el would none of me.
verses.am: But my people would not hearken to my voice; and Israel would none of me.

verses.en: So I gave them up unto their own hearts' lust: and they walked in their own counsels.
verses.am: So I gave them up unto their own hearts' lust: {and} they walked in their own counsels. {unto...: or, to the hardness of their hearts, or, imagination}

verses.en: Oh that my people had hearkened unto me, and Yisra'el had walked in my ways!
verses.am: Oh that my people had hearkened unto me, {and} Israel had walked in my ways!

verses.en: I should soon have subdued their enemies, and turned my hand against their adversaries.
verses.am: I should soon have subdued their enemies, and turned my hand against their adversaries.

verses.en: The haters of YAHUAH should have submitted themselves unto him: but their time should have endured for ever.
verses.am: The haters of the LORD should have submitted themselves unto him: but their time should have endured for ever. {submitted...: or, yielded feigned obedience: Heb. lied}

verses.en: He should have fed them also with the finest of the wheat: and with honey out of the rock should I have satisfied thee.
verses.am: He should have fed them also with the finest of the wheat: and with honey out of the rock should I have satisfied thee. {finest...: Heb. fat of wheat}

verses.en: [A Psalm of Asaph.] YAHUAH standeth in the congregation of the mighty; he judgeth among the elohim.
verses.am: [A Psalm of Asaph.] God standeth in the congregation of the mighty; he judgeth among the gods. {of Asaph: or, for Asaph}

verses.en: How long will ye judge unjustly, and accept the persons of the wicked? Selah.
verses.am: How long will ye judge unjustly, and accept the persons of the wicked? Selah.

verses.en: Defend the poor and fatherless: do justice to the afflicted and needy.
verses.am: Defend the poor and fatherless: do justice to the afflicted and needy. {Defend: Heb. Judge}

verses.en: Deliver the poor and needy: rid them out of the hand of the wicked.
verses.am: Deliver the poor and needy: rid {them} out of the hand of the wicked.

verses.en: They know not, neither will they understand; they walk on in darkness: all the foundations of the earth are out of course.
verses.am: They know not, neither will they understand; they walk on in darkness: all the foundations of the earth are out of course. {out...: Heb. moved}

verses.en: I have said, Ye are elohim; and all of you are children of the most High.
verses.am: I have said, Ye {are} gods; and all of you {are} children of the most High.

verses.en: But ye shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.
verses.am: But ye shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.

verses.en: Arise, O YAHUAH, judge the earth: for thou shalt inherit all nations.
verses.am: Arise, O God, judge the earth: for thou shalt inherit all nations.

verses.en: [A Song or Psalm of Asaph.] Keep not thou silence, O YAHUAH: hold not thy peace, and be not still, O YAHUAH.
verses.am: [A Song {or} Psalm of Asaph.] Keep not thou silence, O God: hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God. {of Asaph: or, for Asaph}

verses.en: For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult: and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.
verses.am: For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult: and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.

verses.en: They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.
verses.am: They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.

verses.en: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; that the name of Yisra'el may be no more in remembrance.
verses.am: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from {being} a nation; that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.

verses.en: For they have consulted together with one consent: they are confederate against thee:
verses.am: For they have consulted together with one consent: they are confederate against thee: {consent: Heb. heart}

verses.en: The tabernacles of Edom, and the Ishmaelites; of Moab, and the Hagarenes;
verses.am: The tabernacles of Edom, and the Ishmaelites; of Moab, and the Hagarenes;

verses.en: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; the Philistines with the inhabitants of Tyre;
verses.am: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; the Philistines with the inhabitants of Tyre;

verses.en: Assur also is joined with them: they have holpen the children of Lot. Selah.
verses.am: Assur also is joined with them: they have holpen the children of Lot. Selah. {holpen: Heb. been an arm to}

verses.en: Do unto them as unto the Midianites; as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the brook of Kison:
verses.am: Do unto them as {unto} the Midianites; as {to} Sisera, as {to} Jabin, at the brook of Kison:

verses.en: Which perished at Endor: they became as dung for the earth.
verses.am: {Which} perished at Endor: they became {as} dung for the earth.

verses.en: Make their nobles like Oreb, and like Zeeb: yea, all their princes as Zebah, and as Zalmunna:
verses.am: Make their nobles like Oreb, and like Zeeb: yea, all their princes as Zebah, and as Zalmunna:

verses.en: Who said, Let us take to ourselves the houses of YAHUAH in possession.
verses.am: Who said, Let us take to ourselves the houses of God in possession.

verses.en: O my YAHUAH, make them like a wheel; as the stubble before the wind.
verses.am: O my God, make them like a wheel; as the stubble before the wind.

verses.en: As the fire burneth a wood, and as the flame setteth the mountains on fire;
verses.am: As the fire burneth a wood, and as the flame setteth the mountains on fire;

verses.en: So persecute them with thy tempest, and make them afraid with thy storm.
verses.am: So persecute them with thy tempest, and make them afraid with thy storm.

verses.en: Fill their faces with shame; that they may seek thy name, O YAHUAH.
verses.am: Fill their faces with shame; that they may seek thy name, O LORD.

verses.en: Let them be confounded and troubled for ever; yea, let them be put to shame, and perish:
verses.am: Let them be confounded and troubled for ever; yea, let them be put to shame, and perish:

verses.en: That men may know that thou, whose name alone is YAHUAH, art the most high over all the earth.
verses.am: That {men} may know that thou, whose name alone {is} JEHOVAH, {art} the most high over all the earth.

verses.en: [To the chief Musician upon Gittith, A Psalm for the sons of Korah.] How amiable are thy tabernacles, O YAHUAH of hosts!
verses.am: [To the chief Musician upon Gittith, A Psalm for the sons of Korah.] How amiable {are} thy tabernacles, O LORD of hosts! {for the sons: or, of the sons}

verses.en: My soul longeth, yea, even fainteth for the courts of YAHUAH: my heart and my flesh crieth out for the living YAHUAH.
verses.am: My soul longeth, yea, even fainteth for the courts of the LORD: my heart and my flesh crieth out for the living God.

verses.en: Yea, the sparrow hath found an house, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may lay her young, even thine altars, O YAHUAH of hosts, my King, and my YAHUAH.
verses.am: Yea, the sparrow hath found an house, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may lay her young, {even} thine altars, O LORD of hosts, my King, and my God.

verses.en: Blessed are they that dwell in thy house: they will be still praising thee. Selah.
verses.am: Blessed {are} they that dwell in thy house: they will be still praising thee. Selah.

verses.en: Blessed is the man whose strength is in thee; in whose heart are the ways of them.
verses.am: Blessed {is} the man whose strength {is} in thee; in whose heart {are} the ways {of them}.

verses.en: Who passing through the valley of Baca make it a well; the rain also filleth the pools.
verses.am: {Who} passing through the valley of Baca make it a well; the rain also filleth the pools. {Baca...: or, mulberry trees make him a well, etc} {filleth: Heb. covereth}

verses.en: They go from strength to strength, every one of them in Zion appeareth before YAHUAH.
verses.am: They go from strength to strength, {every one of them} in Zion appeareth before God. {strength to...: or, company to company}

verses.en: O YAHUAH of hosts, hear my prayer: give ear, O YAHUAH of Ya'aqob. Selah.
verses.am: O LORD God of hosts, hear my prayer: give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah.

verses.en: Behold, O YAHUAH our shield, and look upon the face of thine anointed.
verses.am: Behold, O God our shield, and look upon the face of thine anointed.

verses.en: For a day in thy courts is better than a thousand. I had rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my YAHUAH, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.
verses.am: For a day in thy courts {is} better than a thousand. I had rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness. {I had...: Heb. I would choose rather to sit at the threshold}

verses.en: For YAHUAH is a sun and shield: YAHUAH will give grace and glory: no good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.
verses.am: For the LORD God {is} a sun and shield: the LORD will give grace and glory: no good {thing} will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.

verses.en: O YAHUAH of hosts, blessed is the man that trusteth in thee.
verses.am: O LORD of hosts, blessed {is} the man that trusteth in thee.

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm for the sons of Korah.] YAHUAH, thou hast been favourable unto thy land: thou hast brought back the captivity of Ya'aqob.
verses.am: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm for the sons of Korah.] LORD, thou hast been favourable unto thy land: thou hast brought back the captivity of Jacob. {for the sons: or, of the sons} {favourable: or, well pleased}

verses.en: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people, thou hast covered all their sin. Selah.
verses.am: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people, thou hast covered all their sin. Selah.

verses.en: Thou hast taken away all thy wrath: thou hast turned thyself from the fierceness of thine anger.
verses.am: Thou hast taken away all thy wrath: thou hast turned {thyself} from the fierceness of thine anger. {thyself...: or, thine anger from waxing hot}

verses.en: Turn us, O YAHUAH of our salvation, and cause thine anger toward us to cease.
verses.am: Turn us, O God of our salvation, and cause thine anger toward us to cease.

verses.en: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever? wilt thou draw out thine anger to all generations?
verses.am: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever? wilt thou draw out thine anger to all generations?

verses.en: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
verses.am: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?

verses.en: Shew us thy mercy, O YAHUAH, and grant us thy salvation.
verses.am: Shew us thy mercy, O LORD, and grant us thy salvation.

verses.en: I will hear what YAHUAH will speak: for he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints: but let them not turn again to folly.
verses.am: I will hear what God the LORD will speak: for he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints: but let them not turn again to folly.

verses.en: Surely his salvation is nigh them that fear him; that glory may dwell in our land.
verses.am: Surely his salvation {is} nigh them that fear him; that glory may dwell in our land.

verses.en: Mercy and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
verses.am: Mercy and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed {each other}.

verses.en: Truth shall spring out of the earth; and righteousness shall look down from heaven.
verses.am: Truth shall spring out of the earth; and righteousness shall look down from heaven.

verses.en: Yea, YAHUAH shall give that which is good; and our land shall yield her increase.
verses.am: Yea, the LORD shall give {that which is} good; and our land shall yield her increase.

verses.en: Righteousness shall go before him; and shall set us in the way of his steps.
verses.am: Righteousness shall go before him; and shall set {us} in the way of his steps.

verses.en: [A Prayer of Dawid.] Bow down thine ear, O YAHUAH, hear me: for I am poor and needy.
verses.am: [A Prayer of David.] Bow down thine ear, O LORD, hear me: for I {am} poor and needy. {A Prayer...: or, A Prayer, being a Psalm of David}

verses.en: Preserve my soul; for I am holy: O thou my YAHUAH, save thy servant that trusteth in thee.
verses.am: Preserve my soul; for I {am} holy: O thou my God, save thy servant that trusteth in thee. {holy: or, one whom thou favourest}

verses.en: Be merciful unto me, O YAHUAH: for I cry unto thee daily.
verses.am: Be merciful unto me, O Lord: for I cry unto thee daily. {daily: or, all the day}

verses.en: Rejoice the soul of thy servant: for unto thee, O YAHUAH, do I lift up my soul.
verses.am: Rejoice the soul of thy servant: for unto thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.

verses.en: For thou, YAHUAH, art good, and ready to forgive; and plenteous in mercy unto all them that call upon thee.
verses.am: For thou, Lord, {art} good, and ready to forgive; and plenteous in mercy unto all them that call upon thee.

verses.en: Give ear, O YAHUAH, unto my prayer; and attend to the voice of my supplications.
verses.am: Give ear, O LORD, unto my prayer; and attend to the voice of my supplications.

verses.en: In the day of my trouble I will call upon thee: for thou wilt answer me.
verses.am: In the day of my trouble I will call upon thee: for thou wilt answer me.

verses.en: Among the elohim there is none like unto thee, O YAHUAH; neither are there any works like unto thy works.
verses.am: Among the gods {there is} none like unto thee, O Lord; neither {are there any works} like unto thy works.

verses.en: All nations whom thou hast made shall come and worship before thee, O YAHUAH; and shall glorify thy name.
verses.am: All nations whom thou hast made shall come and worship before thee, O Lord; and shall glorify thy name.

verses.en: For thou art great, and doest wondrous things: thou art YAHUAH alone.
verses.am: For thou {art} great, and doest wondrous things: thou {art} God alone.

verses.en: Teach me thy way, O YAHUAH; I will walk in thy truth: unite my heart to fear thy name.
verses.am: Teach me thy way, O LORD; I will walk in thy truth: unite my heart to fear thy name.

verses.en: I will praise thee, O YAHUAH my YAHUAH, with all my heart: and I will glorify thy name for evermore.
verses.am: I will praise thee, O Lord my God, with all my heart: and I will glorify thy name for evermore.

verses.en: For great is thy mercy toward me: and thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest hell.
verses.am: For great {is} thy mercy toward me: and thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest hell. {hell: or, grave}

verses.en: O YAHUAH, the proud are risen against me, and the assemblies of violent men have sought after my soul; and have not set thee before them.
verses.am: O God, the proud are risen against me, and the assemblies of violent {men} have sought after my soul; and have not set thee before them. {violent: Heb. terrible}

verses.en: But thou, O YAHUAH, art a YAHUAH full of compassion, and gracious, longsuffering, and plenteous in mercy and truth.
verses.am: But thou, O Lord, {art} a God full of compassion, and gracious, longsuffering, and plenteous in mercy and truth.

verses.en: O turn unto me, and have mercy upon me; give thy strength unto thy servant, and save the son of thine handmaid.
verses.am: O turn unto me, and have mercy upon me; give thy strength unto thy servant, and save the son of thine handmaid.

verses.en: Shew me a token for good; that they which hate me may see it, and be ashamed: because thou, YAHUAH, hast holpen me, and comforted me.
verses.am: Shew me a token for good; that they which hate me may see {it}, and be ashamed: because thou, LORD, hast holpen me, and comforted me.

verses.en: [A Psalm or Song for the sons of Korah.] His foundation is in the holy mountains.
verses.am: [A Psalm {or} Song for the sons of Korah.] His foundation {is} in the holy mountains. {for the sons: or, of the sons}

verses.en: YAHUAH loveth the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Ya'aqob.
verses.am: The LORD loveth the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

verses.en: Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of YAHUAH. Selah.
verses.am: Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God. Selah.

verses.en: I will make mention of Rahab and Babel to them that know me: behold Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia; this man was born there.
verses.am: I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon to them that know me: behold Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia; this {man} was born there.

verses.en: And of Zion it shall be said, This and that man was born in her: and the highest himself shall establish her.
verses.am: And of Zion it shall be said, This and that man was born in her: and the highest himself shall establish her.

verses.en: YAHUAH shall count, when he writeth up the people, that this man was born there. Selah.
verses.am: The LORD shall count, when he writeth up the people, {that} this {man} was born there. Selah.

verses.en: As well the singers as the players on instruments shall be there: all my springs are in thee.
verses.am: As well the singers as the players on instruments {shall be there}: all my springs {are} in thee.

verses.en: [A Song or Psalm for the sons of Korah, to the chief Musician upon Mahalath Leannoth, Maschil of Heman the Ezrahite.] O YAHUAH of my salvation, I have cried day and night before thee:
verses.am: [A Song {or} Psalm for the sons of Korah, to the chief Musician upon Mahalath Leannoth, Maschil of Heman the Ezrahite.] O LORD God of my salvation, I have cried day {and} night before thee: {for the sons: or, of the sons} {Maschil...: or, A Psalm of Heman the Ezrahite, giving instruction}

verses.en: Let my prayer come before thee: incline thine ear unto my cry;
verses.am: Let my prayer come before thee: incline thine ear unto my cry;

verses.en: For my soul is full of troubles: and my life draweth nigh unto the grave.
verses.am: For my soul is full of troubles: and my life draweth nigh unto the grave.

verses.en: I am counted with them that go down into the pit: I am as a man that hath no strength:
verses.am: I am counted with them that go down into the pit: I am as a man {that hath} no strength:

verses.en: Free among the dead, like the slain that lie in the grave, whom thou rememberest no more: and they are cut off from thy hand.
verses.am: Free among the dead, like the slain that lie in the grave, whom thou rememberest no more: and they are cut off from thy hand. {from: or, by}

verses.en: Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit, in darkness, in the deeps.
verses.am: Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit, in darkness, in the deeps.

verses.en: Thy wrath lieth hard upon me, and thou hast afflicted me with all thy waves. Selah.
verses.am: Thy wrath lieth hard upon me, and thou hast afflicted {me} with all thy waves. Selah.

verses.en: Thou hast put away mine acquaintance far from me; thou hast made me an abomination unto them: I am shut up, and I cannot come forth.
verses.am: Thou hast put away mine acquaintance far from me; thou hast made me an abomination unto them: {I am} shut up, and I cannot come forth.

verses.en: Mine eye mourneth by reason of affliction: YAHUAH, I have called daily upon thee, I have stretched out my hands unto thee.
verses.am: Mine eye mourneth by reason of affliction: LORD, I have called daily upon thee, I have stretched out my hands unto thee.

verses.en: Wilt thou shew wonders to the dead? shall the dead arise and praise thee? Selah.
verses.am: Wilt thou shew wonders to the dead? shall the dead arise {and} praise thee? Selah.

verses.en: Shall thy lovingkindness be declared in the grave? or thy faithfulness in destruction?
verses.am: Shall thy lovingkindness be declared in the grave? {or} thy faithfulness in destruction?

verses.en: Shall thy wonders be known in the dark? and thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
verses.am: Shall thy wonders be known in the dark? and thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

verses.en: But unto thee have I cried, O YAHUAH; and in the morning shall my prayer prevent thee.
verses.am: But unto thee have I cried, O LORD; and in the morning shall my prayer prevent thee.

verses.en: YAHUAH, why castest thou off my soul? why hidest thou thy face from me?
verses.am: LORD, why castest thou off my soul? {why} hidest thou thy face from me?

verses.en: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up: while I suffer thy terrors I am distracted.
verses.am: I {am} afflicted and ready to die from {my} youth up: {while} I suffer thy terrors I am distracted.

verses.en: Thy fierce wrath goeth over me; thy terrors have cut me off.
verses.am: Thy fierce wrath goeth over me; thy terrors have cut me off.

verses.en: They came round about me daily like water; they compassed me about together.
verses.am: They came round about me daily like water; they compassed me about together. {daily: or, all the day}

verses.en: Lover and friend hast thou put far from me, and mine acquaintance into darkness.
verses.am: Lover and friend hast thou put far from me, {and} mine acquaintance into darkness.

verses.en: [Maschil of Ethan the Ezrahite.] I will sing of the mercies of YAHUAH for ever: with my mouth will I make known thy faithfulness to all generations.
verses.am: [Maschil of Ethan the Ezrahite.] I will sing of the mercies of the LORD for ever: with my mouth will I make known thy faithfulness to all generations. {Maschil...: or, A Psalm for Ethan the Ezrahite, to give instruction} {to all...: Heb. to generation and generation}

verses.en: For I have said, Mercy shall be built up for ever: thy faithfulness shalt thou establish in the very heavens.
verses.am: For I have said, Mercy shall be built up for ever: thy faithfulness shalt thou establish in the very heavens.

verses.en: I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn unto Dawid my servant,
verses.am: I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn unto David my servant,

verses.en: Thy seed will I establish for ever, and build up thy throne to all generations. Selah.
verses.am: Thy seed will I establish for ever, and build up thy throne to all generations. Selah.

verses.en: And the heavens shall praise thy wonders, O YAHUAH: thy faithfulness also in the congregation of the saints.
verses.am: And the heavens shall praise thy wonders, O LORD: thy faithfulness also in the congregation of the saints.

verses.en: For who in the heaven can be compared unto YAHUAH? who among the sons of the mighty can be likened unto YAHUAH?
verses.am: For who in the heaven can be compared unto the LORD? {who} among the sons of the mighty can be likened unto the LORD?

verses.en: YAHUAH is greatly to be feared in the assembly of the saints, and to be had in reverence of all them that are about him.
verses.am: God is greatly to be feared in the assembly of the saints, and to be had in reverence of all {them that are} about him.

verses.en: O YAHUAH of hosts, who is a strong YAHUAH like unto thee? or to thy faithfulness round about thee?
verses.am: O LORD God of hosts, who {is} a strong LORD like unto thee? or to thy faithfulness round about thee?

verses.en: Thou rulest the raging of the sea: when the waves thereof arise, thou stillest them.
verses.am: Thou rulest the raging of the sea: when the waves thereof arise, thou stillest them.

verses.en: Thou hast broken Rahab in pieces, as one that is slain; thou hast scattered thine enemies with thy strong arm.
verses.am: Thou hast broken Rahab in pieces, as one that is slain; thou hast scattered thine enemies with thy strong arm. {Rahab: or, Egypt} {thy...: Heb. the arm of thy strength}

verses.en: The heavens are thine, the earth also is thine: as for the world and the fulness thereof, thou hast founded them.
verses.am: The heavens {are} thine, the earth also {is} thine: {as for} the world and the fulness thereof, thou hast founded them. {the fulness...: or, all it containeth}

verses.en: The north and the south thou hast created them: Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in thy name.
verses.am: The north and the south thou hast created them: Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in thy name.

verses.en: Thou hast a mighty arm: strong is thy hand, and high is thy right hand.
verses.am: Thou hast a mighty arm: strong is thy hand, {and} high is thy right hand. {a...: Heb. an arm with might}

verses.en: Justice and judgment are the habitation of thy throne: mercy and truth shall go before thy face.
verses.am: Justice and judgment {are} the habitation of thy throne: mercy and truth shall go before thy face. {habitation: or, establishment}

verses.en: Blessed is the people that know the joyful sound: they shall walk, O YAHUAH, in the light of thy countenance.
verses.am: Blessed {is} the people that know the joyful sound: they shall walk, O LORD, in the light of thy countenance.

verses.en: In thy name shall they rejoice all the day: and in thy righteousness shall they be exalted.
verses.am: In thy name shall they rejoice all the day: and in thy righteousness shall they be exalted.

verses.en: For thou art the glory of their strength: and in thy favour our horn shall be exalted.
verses.am: For thou {art} the glory of their strength: and in thy favour our horn shall be exalted.

verses.en: For YAHUAH is our defence; and the Holy One of Yisra'el is our king.
verses.am: For the LORD {is} our defence; and the Holy One of Israel {is} our king. {the LORD...: or, our shield is of the LORD, and our king is of the Holy One of Israel}

verses.en: Then thou spakest in vision to thy holy one, and saidst, I have laid help upon one that is mighty; I have exalted one chosen out of the people.
verses.am: Then thou spakest in vision to thy holy one, and saidst, I have laid help upon {one that is} mighty; I have exalted {one} chosen out of the people.

verses.en: I have found Dawid my servant; with my holy oil have I anointed him:
verses.am: I have found David my servant; with my holy oil have I anointed him:

verses.en: With whom my hand shall be established: mine arm also shall strengthen him.
verses.am: With whom my hand shall be established: mine arm also shall strengthen him.

verses.en: The enemy shall not exact upon him; nor the son of wickedness afflict him.
verses.am: The enemy shall not exact upon him; nor the son of wickedness afflict him.

verses.en: And I will beat down his foes before his face, and plague them that hate him.
verses.am: And I will beat down his foes before his face, and plague them that hate him.

verses.en: But my faithfulness and my mercy shall be with him: and in my name shall his horn be exalted.
verses.am: But my faithfulness and my mercy {shall be} with him: and in my name shall his horn be exalted.

verses.en: I will set his hand also in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers.
verses.am: I will set his hand also in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers.

verses.en: He shall cry unto me, Thou art my father, my YAHUAH, and the rock of my salvation.
verses.am: He shall cry unto me, Thou {art} my father, my God, and the rock of my salvation.

verses.en: Also I will make him my firstborn, higher than the kings of the earth.
verses.am: Also I will make him {my} firstborn, higher than the kings of the earth.

verses.en: My mercy will I keep for him for evermore, and my covenant shall stand fast with him.
verses.am: My mercy will I keep for him for evermore, and my covenant shall stand fast with him.

verses.en: His seed also will I make to endure for ever, and his throne as the days of heaven.
verses.am: His seed also will I make {to endure} for ever, and his throne as the days of heaven.

verses.en: If his children forsake my law, and walk not in my judgments;
verses.am: If his children forsake my law, and walk not in my judgments;

verses.en: If they break my statutes, and keep not my commandments;
verses.am: If they break my statutes, and keep not my commandments; {break: Heb. profane}

verses.en: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.
verses.am: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.

verses.en: Nevertheless my lovingkindness will I not utterly take from him, nor suffer my faithfulness to fail.
verses.am: Nevertheless my lovingkindness will I not utterly take from him, nor suffer my faithfulness to fail. {will...: Heb. I will not make void from him} {to fall: Heb. to lie}

verses.en: My covenant will I not break, nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips.
verses.am: My covenant will I not break, nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips.

verses.en: Once have I sworn by my holiness that I will not lie unto Dawid.
verses.am: Once have I sworn by my holiness that I will not lie unto David. {that...: Heb. if I lie}

verses.en: His seed shall endure for ever, and his throne as the sun before me.
verses.am: His seed shall endure for ever, and his throne as the sun before me.

verses.en: It shall be established for ever as the moon, and as a faithful witness in heaven. Selah.
verses.am: It shall be established for ever as the moon, and {as} a faithful witness in heaven. Selah.

verses.en: But thou hast cast off and abhorred, thou hast been wroth with thine anointed.
verses.am: But thou hast cast off and abhorred, thou hast been wroth with thine anointed.

verses.en: Thou hast made void the covenant of thy servant: thou hast profaned his crown by casting it to the ground.
verses.am: Thou hast made void the covenant of thy servant: thou hast profaned his crown {by casting it} to the ground.

verses.en: Thou hast broken down all his hedges; thou hast brought his strong holds to ruin.
verses.am: Thou hast broken down all his hedges; thou hast brought his strong holds to ruin.

verses.en: All that pass by the way spoil him: he is a reproach to his neighbours.
verses.am: All that pass by the way spoil him: he is a reproach to his neighbours.

verses.en: Thou hast set up the right hand of his adversaries; thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.
verses.am: Thou hast set up the right hand of his adversaries; thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.

verses.en: Thou hast also turned the edge of his sword, and hast not made him to stand in the battle.
verses.am: Thou hast also turned the edge of his sword, and hast not made him to stand in the battle.

verses.en: Thou hast made his glory to cease, and cast his throne down to the ground.
verses.am: Thou hast made his glory to cease, and cast his throne down to the ground. {glory: Heb. brightness}

verses.en: The days of his youth hast thou shortened: thou hast covered him with shame. Selah.
verses.am: The days of his youth hast thou shortened: thou hast covered him with shame. Selah.

verses.en: How long, YAHUAH? wilt thou hide thyself for ever? shall thy wrath burn like fire?
verses.am: How long, LORD? wilt thou hide thyself for ever? shall thy wrath burn like fire?

verses.en: Remember how short my time is: wherefore hast thou made all men in vain?
verses.am: Remember how short my time is: wherefore hast thou made all men in vain?

verses.en: What man is he that liveth, and shall not see death? shall he deliver his soul from the hand of the grave? Selah.
verses.am: What man {is he that} liveth, and shall not see death? shall he deliver his soul from the hand of the grave? Selah.

verses.en: YAHUAH, where are thy former lovingkindnesses, which thou swarest unto Dawid in thy truth?
verses.am: Lord, where {are} thy former lovingkindnesses, {which} thou swarest unto David in thy truth?

verses.en: Remember, YAHUAH, the reproach of thy servants; how I do bear in my bosom the reproach of all the mighty people;
verses.am: Remember, Lord, the reproach of thy servants; {how} I do bear in my bosom {the reproach of} all the mighty people;

verses.en: Wherewith thine enemies have reproached, O YAHUAH; wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed.
verses.am: Wherewith thine enemies have reproached, O LORD; wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed.

verses.en: Blessed be YAHUAH for evermore. Amen, and Amen.
verses.am: Blessed {be} the LORD for evermore. Amen, and Amen.

verses.en: [A Prayer of Mosheh the man of YAHUAH.] YAHUAH, thou hast been our dwelling place in all generations.
verses.am: [A Prayer of Moses the man of God.] Lord, thou hast been our dwelling place in all generations. {A Prayer...: or, A Prayer, being a Psalm of Moses} {in...: Heb. in generation and generation}

verses.en: Before the mountains were brought forth, or ever thou hadst formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, thou art YAHUAH.
verses.am: Before the mountains were brought forth, or ever thou hadst formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, thou {art} God.

verses.en: Thou turnest man to destruction; and sayest, Return, ye children of men.
verses.am: Thou turnest man to destruction; and sayest, Return, ye children of men.

verses.en: For a thousand years in thy sight are but as yesterday when it is past, and as a watch in the night.
verses.am: For a thousand years in thy sight {are but} as yesterday when it is past, and {as} a watch in the night. {when...: or, when he hath passed them}

verses.en: Thou carriest them away as with a flood; they are as a sleep: in the morning they are like grass which groweth up.
verses.am: Thou carriest them away as with a flood; they are {as} a sleep: in the morning {they are} like grass {which} groweth up. {groweth...: or, is changed}

verses.en: In the morning it flourisheth, and groweth up; in the evening it is cut down, and withereth.
verses.am: In the morning it flourisheth, and groweth up; in the evening it is cut down, and withereth.

verses.en: For we are consumed by thine anger, and by thy wrath are we troubled.
verses.am: For we are consumed by thine anger, and by thy wrath are we troubled.

verses.en: Thou hast set our iniquities before thee, our secret sins in the light of thy countenance.
verses.am: Thou hast set our iniquities before thee, our secret {sins} in the light of thy countenance.

verses.en: For all our days are passed away in thy wrath: we spend our years as a tale that is told.
verses.am: For all our days are passed away in thy wrath: we spend our years as a tale {that is told}. {passed...: Heb. turned away} {as a...: or, as a meditation}

verses.en: The days of our years are threescore years and ten; and if by reason of strength they be fourscore years, yet is their strength labour and sorrow; for it is soon cut off, and we fly away.
verses.am: The days of our years {are} threescore years and ten; and if by reason of strength {they be} fourscore years, yet {is} their strength labour and sorrow; for it is soon cut off, and we fly away. {The days...: Heb. As for the days of our years, in them are seventy years}

verses.en: Who knoweth the power of thine anger? even according to thy fear, so is thy wrath.
verses.am: Who knoweth the power of thine anger? even according to thy fear, {so is} thy wrath.

verses.en: So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.
verses.am: So teach {us} to number our days, that we may apply {our} hearts unto wisdom. {apply: Heb. cause to come}

verses.en: Return, O YAHUAH, how long? and let it repent thee concerning thy servants.
verses.am: Return, O LORD, how long? and let it repent thee concerning thy servants.

verses.en: O satisfy us early with thy mercy; that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
verses.am: O satisfy us early with thy mercy; that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.

verses.en: Make us glad according to the days wherein thou hast afflicted us, and the years wherein we have seen evil.
verses.am: Make us glad according to the days {wherein} thou hast afflicted us, {and} the years {wherein} we have seen evil.

verses.en: Let thy work appear unto thy servants, and thy glory unto their children.
verses.am: Let thy work appear unto thy servants, and thy glory unto their children.

verses.en: And let the beauty of YAHUAH our YAHUAH be upon us: and establish thou the work of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands establish thou it.
verses.am: And let the beauty of the LORD our God be upon us: and establish thou the work of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands establish thou it.

verses.en: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
verses.am: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty. {abide: Heb. lodge}

verses.en: I will say of YAHUAH, He is my refuge and my fortress: my YAHUAH; in him will I trust.
verses.am: I will say of the LORD, {He is} my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.

verses.en: Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, and from the noisome pestilence.
verses.am: Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, {and} from the noisome pestilence.

verses.en: He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth shall be thy shield and buckler.
verses.am: He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth {shall be thy} shield and buckler.

verses.en: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day;
verses.am: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; {nor} for the arrow {that} flieth by day;

verses.en: Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness; nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.
verses.am: {Nor} for the pestilence {that} walketh in darkness; {nor} for the destruction {that} wasteth at noonday.

verses.en: A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; but it shall not come nigh thee.
verses.am: A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; {but} it shall not come nigh thee.

verses.en: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked.
verses.am: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked.

verses.en: Because thou hast made YAHUAH, which is my refuge, even the most High, thy habitation;
verses.am: Because thou hast made the LORD, {which is} my refuge, {even} the most High, thy habitation;

verses.en: There shall no evil befall thee, neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling.
verses.am: There shall no evil befall thee, neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling.

verses.en: For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.
verses.am: For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.

verses.en: They shall bear thee up in their hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.
verses.am: They shall bear thee up in {their} hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.

verses.en: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder: the young lion and the dragon shalt thou trample under feet.
verses.am: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder: the young lion and the dragon shalt thou trample under feet. {adder: or, asp}

verses.en: Because he hath set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him: I will set him on high, because he hath known my name.
verses.am: Because he hath set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him: I will set him on high, because he hath known my name.

verses.en: He shall call upon me, and I will answer him: I will be with him in trouble; I will deliver him, and honour him.
verses.am: He shall call upon me, and I will answer him: I {will be} with him in trouble; I will deliver him, and honour him.

verses.en: With long life will I satisfy him, and shew him my salvation.
verses.am: With long life will I satisfy him, and shew him my salvation. {long...: Heb. length of days}

verses.en: [A Psalm or Song for the sabbath day.] It is a good thing to give thanks unto YAHUAH, and to sing praises unto thy name, O most High:
verses.am: [A Psalm {or} Song for the sabbath day.] {It is a} good {thing} to give thanks unto the LORD, and to sing praises unto thy name, O most High:

verses.en: To shew forth thy lovingkindness in the morning, and thy faithfulness every night,
verses.am: To shew forth thy lovingkindness in the morning, and thy faithfulness every night, {every...: Heb. in the nights}

verses.en: Upon an instrument of ten strings, and upon the psaltery; upon the harp with a solemn sound.
verses.am: Upon an instrument of ten strings, and upon the psaltery; upon the harp with a solemn sound. {the harp...: or, the solemn sound with the harp} {a solemn...: Heb. Higgaion}

verses.en: For thou, YAHUAH, hast made me glad through thy work: I will triumph in the works of thy hands.
verses.am: For thou, LORD, hast made me glad through thy work: I will triumph in the works of thy hands.

verses.en: O YAHUAH, how great are thy works! and thy thoughts are very deep.
verses.am: O LORD, how great are thy works! {and} thy thoughts are very deep.

verses.en: A brutish man knoweth not; neither doth a fool understand this.
verses.am: A brutish man knoweth not; neither doth a fool understand this.

verses.en: When the wicked spring as the grass, and when all the workers of iniquity do flourish; it is that they shall be destroyed for ever:
verses.am: When the wicked spring as the grass, and when all the workers of iniquity do flourish; {it is} that they shall be destroyed for ever:

verses.en: But thou, YAHUAH, art most high for evermore.
verses.am: But thou, LORD, {art most} high for evermore.

verses.en: For, lo, thine enemies, O YAHUAH, for, lo, thine enemies shall perish; all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.
verses.am: For, lo, thine enemies, O LORD, for, lo, thine enemies shall perish; all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.

verses.en: But my horn shalt thou exalt like the horn of an unicorn: I shall be anointed with fresh oil.
verses.am: But my horn shalt thou exalt like {the horn of} an unicorn: I shall be anointed with fresh oil.

verses.en: Mine eye also shall see my desire on mine enemies, and mine ears shall hear my desire of the wicked that rise up against me.
verses.am: Mine eye also shall see {my desire} on mine enemies, {and} mine ears shall hear {my desire} of the wicked that rise up against me.

verses.en: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree: he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
verses.am: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree: he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

verses.en: Those that be planted in the house of YAHUAH shall flourish in the courts of our YAHUAH.
verses.am: Those that be planted in the house of the LORD shall flourish in the courts of our God.

verses.en: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; they shall be fat and flourishing;
verses.am: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; they shall be fat and flourishing; {flourishing: Heb. green}

verses.en: To shew that YAHUAH is upright: he is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.
verses.am: To shew that the LORD {is} upright: {he is} my rock, and {there is} no unrighteousness in him.

verses.en: YAHUAH reigneth, he is clothed with majesty; YAHUAH is clothed with strength, wherewith he hath girded himself: the world also is stablished, that it cannot be moved.
verses.am: The LORD reigneth, he is clothed with majesty; the LORD is clothed with strength, {wherewith} he hath girded himself: the world also is stablished, that it cannot be moved.

verses.en: Thy throne is established of old: thou art from everlasting.
verses.am: Thy throne {is} established of old: thou {art} from everlasting. {of old: Heb. from then}

verses.en: The floods have lifted up, O YAHUAH, the floods have lifted up their voice; the floods lift up their waves.
verses.am: The floods have lifted up, O LORD, the floods have lifted up their voice; the floods lift up their waves.

verses.en: YAHUAH on high is mightier than the noise of many waters, yea, than the mighty waves of the sea.
verses.am: The LORD on high {is} mightier than the noise of many waters, {yea, than} the mighty waves of the sea.

verses.en: Thy testimonies are very sure: holiness becometh thine house, O YAHUAH, for ever.
verses.am: Thy testimonies are very sure: holiness becometh thine house, O LORD, for ever. {for ever: Heb. to length of days}

verses.en: O YAHUAH, to whom vengeance belongeth; O YAHUAH, to whom vengeance belongeth, shew thyself.
verses.am: O LORD God, to whom vengeance belongeth; O God, to whom vengeance belongeth, shew thyself. {God...: Heb. God of revenges} {shew...: Heb. shine forth}

verses.en: Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth: render a reward to the proud.
verses.am: Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth: render a reward to the proud.

verses.en: YAHUAH, how long shall the wicked, how long shall the wicked triumph?
verses.am: LORD, how long shall the wicked, how long shall the wicked triumph?

verses.en: How long shall they utter and speak hard things? and all the workers of iniquity boast themselves?
verses.am: {How long} shall they utter {and} speak hard things? {and} all the workers of iniquity boast themselves?

verses.en: They break in pieces thy people, O YAHUAH, and afflict thine heritage.
verses.am: They break in pieces thy people, O LORD, and afflict thine heritage.

verses.en: They slay the widow and the stranger, and murder the fatherless.
verses.am: They slay the widow and the stranger, and murder the fatherless.

verses.en: Yet they say, YAHUAH shall not see, neither shall YAHUAH of Ya'aqob regard it.
verses.am: Yet they say, The LORD shall not see, neither shall the God of Jacob regard {it}.

verses.en: Understand, ye brutish among the people: and ye fools, when will ye be wise?
verses.am: Understand, ye brutish among the people: and {ye} fools, when will ye be wise?

verses.en: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? he that formed the eye, shall he not see?
verses.am: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? he that formed the eye, shall he not see?

verses.en: He that chastiseth the heathen, shall not he correct? he that teacheth man knowledge, shall not he know?
verses.am: He that chastiseth the heathen, shall not he correct? he that teacheth man knowledge, {shall not he know}?

verses.en: YAHUAH knoweth the thoughts of man, that they are vanity.
verses.am: The LORD knoweth the thoughts of man, that they {are} vanity.

verses.en: Blessed is the man whom thou chastenest, O YAHUAH, and teachest him out of thy law;
verses.am: Blessed {is} the man whom thou chastenest, O LORD, and teachest him out of thy law;

verses.en: That thou mayest give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit be digged for the wicked.
verses.am: That thou mayest give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit be digged for the wicked.

verses.en: For YAHUAH will not cast off his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.
verses.am: For the LORD will not cast off his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.

verses.en: But judgment shall return unto righteousness: and all the upright in heart shall follow it.
verses.am: But judgment shall return unto righteousness: and all the upright in heart shall follow it. {shall follow...: Heb. shall be after it}

verses.en: Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? or who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?
verses.am: Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? {or} who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?

verses.en: Unless YAHUAH had been my help, my soul had almost dwelt in silence.
verses.am: Unless the LORD {had been} my help, my soul had almost dwelt in silence. {almost: or, quickly}

verses.en: When I said, My foot slippeth; thy mercy, O YAHUAH, held me up.
verses.am: When I said, My foot slippeth; thy mercy, O LORD, held me up.

verses.en: In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul.
verses.am: In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul.

verses.en: Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law?
verses.am: Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law?

verses.en: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.
verses.am: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.

verses.en: But YAHUAH is my defence; and my YAHUAH is the rock of my refuge.
verses.am: But the LORD is my defence; and my God {is} the rock of my refuge.

verses.en: And he shall bring upon them their own iniquity, and shall cut them off in their own wickedness; yea, YAHUAH our YAHUAH shall cut them off.
verses.am: And he shall bring upon them their own iniquity, and shall cut them off in their own wickedness; {yea}, the LORD our God shall cut them off.

verses.en: O come, let us sing unto YAHUAH: let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.
verses.am: O come, let us sing unto the LORD: let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.

verses.en: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise unto him with psalms.
verses.am: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise unto him with psalms. {come...: Heb. prevent his face}

verses.en: For YAHUAH is a great YAHUAH, and a great King above all elohim.
verses.am: For the LORD {is} a great God, and a great King above all gods.

verses.en: In his hand are the deep places of the earth: the strength of the hills is his also.
verses.am: In his hand {are} the deep places of the earth: the strength of the hills {is} his also. {In...: Heb. In whose} {the strength...: or, the heights of the hills are his}

verses.en: The sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land.
verses.am: The sea {is} his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry {land}. {The sea...: Heb. Whose the sea is}

verses.en: O come, let us worship and bow down: let us kneel before YAHUAH our maker.
verses.am: O come, let us worship and bow down: let us kneel before the LORD our maker.

verses.en: For he is our YAHUAH; and we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. To day if ye will hear his voice,
verses.am: For he {is} our God; and we {are} the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. To day if ye will hear his voice,

verses.en: Harden not your heart, as in the provocation, and as in the day of temptation in the wilderness:
verses.am: Harden not your heart, as in the provocation, {and} as {in} the day of temptation in the wilderness: {provocation: Heb. contention}

verses.en: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my work.
verses.am: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my work.

verses.en: Forty years long was I grieved with this generation, and said, It is a people that do err in their heart, and they have not known my ways:
verses.am: Forty years long was I grieved with {this} generation, and said, It {is} a people that do err in their heart, and they have not known my ways:

verses.en: Unto whom I sware in my wrath that they should not enter into my rest.
verses.am: Unto whom I sware in my wrath that they should not enter into my rest. {that...: Heb. if they enter into my rest}

verses.en: O sing unto YAHUAH a new song: sing unto YAHUAH, all the earth.
verses.am: O sing unto the LORD a new song: sing unto the LORD, all the earth.

verses.en: Sing unto YAHUAH, bless his name; shew forth his salvation from day to day.
verses.am: Sing unto the LORD, bless his name; shew forth his salvation from day to day.

verses.en: Declare his glory among the heathen, his wonders among all people.
verses.am: Declare his glory among the heathen, his wonders among all people.

verses.en: For YAHUAH is great, and greatly to be praised: he is to be feared above all elohim.
verses.am: For the LORD {is} great, and greatly to be praised: he {is} to be feared above all gods.

verses.en: For all the elohim of the nations are idols: but YAHUAH made the heavens.
verses.am: For all the gods of the nations {are} idols: but the LORD made the heavens.

verses.en: Honour and majesty are before him: strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.
verses.am: Honour and majesty {are} before him: strength and beauty {are} in his sanctuary.

verses.en: Give unto YAHUAH, O ye kindreds of the people, give unto YAHUAH glory and strength.
verses.am: Give unto the LORD, O ye kindreds of the people, give unto the LORD glory and strength.

verses.en: Give unto YAHUAH the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come into his courts.
verses.am: Give unto the LORD the glory {due unto} his name: bring an offering, and come into his courts. {due...: Heb. of his name}

verses.en: O worship YAHUAH in the beauty of holiness: fear before him, all the earth.
verses.am: O worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness: fear before him, all the earth. {in the...: or, in the glorious sanctuary}

verses.en: Say among the heathen that YAHUAH reigneth: the world also shall be established that it shall not be moved: he shall judge the people righteously.
verses.am: Say among the heathen {that} the LORD reigneth: the world also shall be established that it shall not be moved: he shall judge the people righteously.

verses.en: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof.
verses.am: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof. {the fulness...: or, all it containeth}

verses.en: Let the field be joyful, and all that is therein: then shall all the trees of the wood rejoice
verses.am: Let the field be joyful, and all that {is} therein: then shall all the trees of the wood rejoice

verses.en: Before YAHUAH: for he cometh, for he cometh to judge the earth: he shall judge the world with righteousness, and the people with his truth.
verses.am: Before the LORD: for he cometh, for he cometh to judge the earth: he shall judge the world with righteousness, and the people with his truth.

verses.en: YAHUAH reigneth; let the earth rejoice; let the multitude of isles be glad thereof.
verses.am: The LORD reigneth; let the earth rejoice; let the multitude of isles be glad {thereof}. {multitude...: Heb. many, or, great isles}

verses.en: Clouds and darkness are round about him: righteousness and judgment are the habitation of his throne.
verses.am: Clouds and darkness {are} round about him: righteousness and judgment {are} the habitation of his throne. {habitation: or, establishment}

verses.en: A fire goeth before him, and burneth up his enemies round about.
verses.am: A fire goeth before him, and burneth up his enemies round about.

verses.en: His lightnings enlightened the world: the earth saw, and trembled.
verses.am: His lightnings enlightened the world: the earth saw, and trembled.

verses.en: The hills melted like wax at the presence of YAHUAH, at the presence of YAHUAH of the whole earth.
verses.am: The hills melted like wax at the presence of the LORD, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.

verses.en: The heavens declare his righteousness, and all the people see his glory.
verses.am: The heavens declare his righteousness, and all the people see his glory.

verses.en: Confounded be all they that serve graven images, that boast themselves of idols: worship him, all ye elohim.
verses.am: Confounded be all they that serve graven images, that boast themselves of idols: worship him, all {ye} gods.

verses.en: Zion heard, and was glad; and the daughters of Yehudah rejoiced because of thy judgments, O YAHUAH.
verses.am: Zion heard, and was glad; and the daughters of Judah rejoiced because of thy judgments, O LORD.

verses.en: For thou, YAHUAH, art high above all the earth: thou art exalted far above all elohim.
verses.am: For thou, LORD, {art} high above all the earth: thou art exalted far above all gods.

verses.en: Ye that love YAHUAH, hate evil: he preserveth the souls of his saints; he delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked.
verses.am: Ye that love the LORD, hate evil: he preserveth the souls of his saints; he delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked.

verses.en: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.
verses.am: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.

verses.en: Rejoice in YAHUAH, ye righteous; and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
verses.am: Rejoice in the LORD, ye righteous; and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness. {at...: or, to the memorial}
