verses.en: [A Psalm.] O sing unto YAHUAH a new song; for he hath done marvellous things: his right hand, and his holy arm, hath gotten him the victory.
verses.am: [A Psalm.] O sing unto the LORD a new song; for he hath done marvellous things: his right hand, and his holy arm, hath gotten him the victory.

verses.en: YAHUAH hath made known his salvation: his righteousness hath he openly shewed in the sight of the heathen.
verses.am: The LORD hath made known his salvation: his righteousness hath he openly shewed in the sight of the heathen. {openly...: or, revealed}

verses.en: He hath remembered his mercy and his truth toward the house of Yisra'el: all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our YAHUAH.
verses.am: He hath remembered his mercy and his truth toward the house of Israel: all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

verses.en: Make a joyful noise unto YAHUAH, all the earth: make a loud noise, and rejoice, and sing praise.
verses.am: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all the earth: make a loud noise, and rejoice, and sing praise.

verses.en: Sing unto YAHUAH with the harp; with the harp, and the voice of a psalm.
verses.am: Sing unto the LORD with the harp; with the harp, and the voice of a psalm.

verses.en: With trumpets and sound of cornet make a joyful noise before YAHUAH, the King.
verses.am: With trumpets and sound of cornet make a joyful noise before the LORD, the King.

verses.en: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.
verses.am: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein. {the fulness...: or, all it containeth}

verses.en: Let the floods clap their hands: let the hills be joyful together
verses.am: Let the floods clap {their} hands: let the hills be joyful together

verses.en: Before YAHUAH; for he cometh to judge the earth: with righteousness shall he judge the world, and the people with equity.
verses.am: Before the LORD; for he cometh to judge the earth: with righteousness shall he judge the world, and the people with equity.

verses.en: YAHUAH reigneth; let the people tremble: he sitteth between the cherubims; let the earth be moved.
verses.am: The LORD reigneth; let the people tremble: he sitteth {between} the cherubims; let the earth be moved. {be moved: Heb. stagger}

verses.en: YAHUAH is great in Zion; and he is high above all the people.
verses.am: The LORD {is} great in Zion; and he {is} high above all the people.

verses.en: Let them praise thy great and terrible name; for it is holy.
verses.am: Let them praise thy great and terrible name; {for} it {is} holy.

verses.en: The king's strength also loveth judgment; thou dost establish equity, thou executest judgment and righteousness in Ya'aqob.
verses.am: The king's strength also loveth judgment; thou dost establish equity, thou executest judgment and righteousness in Jacob.

verses.en: Exalt ye YAHUAH our YAHUAH, and worship at his footstool; for he is holy.
verses.am: Exalt ye the LORD our God, and worship at his footstool; {for} he {is} holy. {he is...: or, it is holy}

verses.en: Mosheh and Aaron among his priests, and Shemu'el among them that call upon his name; they called upon YAHUAH, and he answered them.
verses.am: Moses and Aaron among his priests, and Samuel among them that call upon his name; they called upon the LORD, and he answered them.

verses.en: He spake unto them in the cloudy pillar: they kept his testimonies, and the ordinance that he gave them.
verses.am: He spake unto them in the cloudy pillar: they kept his testimonies, and the ordinance {that} he gave them.

verses.en: Thou answeredst them, O YAHUAH our YAHUAH: thou wast a YAHUAH that forgavest them, though thou tookest vengeance of their inventions.
verses.am: Thou answeredst them, O LORD our God: thou wast a God that forgavest them, though thou tookest vengeance of their inventions.

verses.en: Exalt YAHUAH our YAHUAH, and worship at his holy hill; for YAHUAH our YAHUAH is holy.
verses.am: Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at his holy hill; for the LORD our God {is} holy.

verses.en: [A Psalm of praise.] Make a joyful noise unto YAHUAH, all ye lands.
verses.am: [A Psalm of praise.] Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all ye lands. {praise: or, thanksgiving} {all...: Heb. all the earth}

verses.en: Serve YAHUAH with gladness: come before his presence with singing.
verses.am: Serve the LORD with gladness: come before his presence with singing.

verses.en: Know ye that YAHUAH he is YAHUAH: it is he that hath made us, and not we ourselves; we are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
verses.am: Know ye that the LORD he {is} God: {it is} he {that} hath made us, and not we ourselves; {we are} his people, and the sheep of his pasture. {and not...: or, and his we are}

verses.en: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.
verses.am: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, {and} into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, {and} bless his name.

verses.en: For YAHUAH is good; his mercy is everlasting; and his truth endureth to all generations.
verses.am: For the LORD {is} good; his mercy {is} everlasting; and his truth {endureth} to all generations. {to all...: Heb. to generation and generation}

verses.en: [A Psalm of Dawid.] I will sing of mercy and judgment: unto thee, O YAHUAH, will I sing.
verses.am: [A Psalm of David.] I will sing of mercy and judgment: unto thee, O LORD, will I sing.

verses.en: I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way. O when wilt thou come unto me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.
verses.am: I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way. O when wilt thou come unto me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.

verses.en: I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside; it shall not cleave to me.
verses.am: I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside; {it} shall not cleave to me. {wicked...: Heb. thing of Belial}

verses.en: A froward heart shall depart from me: I will not know a wicked person.
verses.am: A froward heart shall depart from me: I will not know a wicked {person}.

verses.en: Whoso privily slandereth his neighbour, him will I cut off: him that hath an high look and a proud heart will not I suffer.
verses.am: Whoso privily slandereth his neighbour, him will I cut off: him that hath an high look and a proud heart will not I suffer.

verses.en: Mine eyes shall be upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me: he that walketh in a perfect way, he shall serve me.
verses.am: Mine eyes {shall be} upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me: he that walketh in a perfect way, he shall serve me. {in a...: or, perfect in the way}

verses.en: He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house: he that telleth lies shall not tarry in my sight.
verses.am: He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house: he that telleth lies shall not tarry in my sight. {shall not tarry: Heb. shall not be established}

verses.en: I will early destroy all the wicked of the land; that I may cut off all wicked doers from the city of YAHUAH.
verses.am: I will early destroy all the wicked of the land; that I may cut off all wicked doers from the city of the LORD.

verses.en: [A Prayer of the afflicted, when he is overwhelmed, and poureth out his complaint before YAHUAH.] Hear my prayer, O YAHUAH, and let my cry come unto thee.
verses.am: [A Prayer of the afflicted, when he is overwhelmed, and poureth out his complaint before the LORD.] Hear my prayer, O LORD, and let my cry come unto thee. {of: or, for}

verses.en: Hide not thy face from me in the day when I am in trouble; incline thine ear unto me: in the day when I call answer me speedily.
verses.am: Hide not thy face from me in the day {when} I am in trouble; incline thine ear unto me: in the day {when} I call answer me speedily.

verses.en: For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned as an hearth.
verses.am: For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned as an hearth. {like...: or, (as some read) into smoke}

verses.en: My heart is smitten, and withered like grass; so that I forget to eat my bread.
verses.am: My heart is smitten, and withered like grass; so that I forget to eat my bread.

verses.en: By reason of the voice of my groaning my bones cleave to my skin.
verses.am: By reason of the voice of my groaning my bones cleave to my skin. {skin: or, flesh}

verses.en: I am like a pelican of the wilderness: I am like an owl of the desert.
verses.am: I am like a pelican of the wilderness: I am like an owl of the desert.

verses.en: I watch, and am as a sparrow alone upon the house top.
verses.am: I watch, and am as a sparrow alone upon the house top.

verses.en: Mine enemies reproach me all the day; and they that are mad against me are sworn against me.
verses.am: Mine enemies reproach me all the day; {and} they that are mad against me are sworn against me.

verses.en: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping,
verses.am: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping,

verses.en: Because of thine indignation and thy wrath: for thou hast lifted me up, and cast me down.
verses.am: Because of thine indignation and thy wrath: for thou hast lifted me up, and cast me down.

verses.en: My days are like a shadow that declineth; and I am withered like grass.
verses.am: My days {are} like a shadow that declineth; and I am withered like grass.

verses.en: But thou, O YAHUAH, shalt endure for ever; and thy remembrance unto all generations.
verses.am: But thou, O LORD, shalt endure for ever; and thy remembrance unto all generations.

verses.en: Thou shalt arise, and have mercy upon Zion: for the time to favour her, yea, the set time, is come.
verses.am: Thou shalt arise, {and} have mercy upon Zion: for the time to favour her, yea, the set time, is come.

verses.en: For thy servants take pleasure in her stones, and favour the dust thereof.
verses.am: For thy servants take pleasure in her stones, and favour the dust thereof.

verses.en: So the heathen shall fear the name of YAHUAH, and all the kings of the earth thy glory.
verses.am: So the heathen shall fear the name of the LORD, and all the kings of the earth thy glory.

verses.en: When YAHUAH shall build up Zion, he shall appear in his glory.
verses.am: When the LORD shall build up Zion, he shall appear in his glory.

verses.en: He will regard the prayer of the destitute, and not despise their prayer.
verses.am: He will regard the prayer of the destitute, and not despise their prayer.

verses.en: This shall be written for the generation to come: and the people which shall be created shall praise YAHUAH.
verses.am: This shall be written for the generation to come: and the people which shall be created shall praise the LORD.

verses.en: For he hath looked down from the height of his sanctuary; from heaven did YAHUAH behold the earth;
verses.am: For he hath looked down from the height of his sanctuary; from heaven did the LORD behold the earth;

verses.en: To hear the groaning of the prisoner; to loose those that are appointed to death;
verses.am: To hear the groaning of the prisoner; to loose those that are appointed to death; {those...: Heb. the children of death}

verses.en: To declare the name of YAHUAH in Zion, and his praise in Yerushalayim;
verses.am: To declare the name of the LORD in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;

verses.en: When the people are gathered together, and the kingdoms, to serve YAHUAH.
verses.am: When the people are gathered together, and the kingdoms, to serve the LORD.

verses.en: He weakened my strength in the way; he shortened my days.
verses.am: He weakened my strength in the way; he shortened my days. {weakened: Heb. afflicted}

verses.en: I said, O my YAHUAH, take me not away in the midst of my days: thy years are throughout all generations.
verses.am: I said, O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days: thy years {are} throughout all generations.

verses.en: Of old hast thou laid the foundation of the earth: and the heavens are the work of thy hands.
verses.am: Of old hast thou laid the foundation of the earth: and the heavens {are} the work of thy hands.

verses.en: They shall perish, but thou shalt endure: yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; as a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed:
verses.am: They shall perish, but thou shalt endure: yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; as a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed: {endure: Heb. stand}

verses.en: But thou art the same, and thy years shall have no end.
verses.am: But thou {art} the same, and thy years shall have no end.

verses.en: The children of thy servants shall continue, and their seed shall be established before thee.
verses.am: The children of thy servants shall continue, and their seed shall be established before thee.

verses.en: [A Psalm of Dawid.] Bless YAHUAH, O my soul: and all that is within me, bless his holy name.
verses.am: [{A Psalm} of David.] Bless the LORD, O my soul: and all that is within me, {bless} his holy name.

verses.en: Bless YAHUAH, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:
verses.am: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:

verses.en: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases;
verses.am: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases;

verses.en: Who redeemeth thy life from destruction; who crowneth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies;
verses.am: Who redeemeth thy life from destruction; who crowneth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies;

verses.en: Who satisfieth thy mouth with good things; so that thy youth is renewed like the eagle's.
verses.am: Who satisfieth thy mouth with good {things; so that} thy youth is renewed like the eagle's.

verses.en: YAHUAH executeth righteousness and judgment for all that are oppressed.
verses.am: The LORD executeth righteousness and judgment for all that are oppressed.

verses.en: He made known his ways unto Mosheh, his acts unto the children of Yisra'el.
verses.am: He made known his ways unto Moses, his acts unto the children of Israel.

verses.en: YAHUAH is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy.
verses.am: The LORD {is} merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy. {plentious...: Heb. great in mercy}

verses.en: He will not always chide: neither will he keep his anger for ever.
verses.am: He will not always chide: neither will he keep {his anger} for ever.

verses.en: He hath not dealt with us after our sins; nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.
verses.am: He hath not dealt with us after our sins; nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.

verses.en: For as the heaven is high above the earth, so great is his mercy toward them that fear him.
verses.am: For as the heaven is high above the earth, {so} great is his mercy toward them that fear him. {as...: Heb. according to the height of the heaven}

verses.en: As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.
verses.am: As far as the east is from the west, {so} far hath he removed our transgressions from us.

verses.en: Like as a father pitieth his children, so YAHUAH pitieth them that fear him.
verses.am: Like as a father pitieth {his} children, {so} the LORD pitieth them that fear him.

verses.en: For he knoweth our frame; he remembereth that we are dust.
verses.am: For he knoweth our frame; he remembereth that we {are} dust.

verses.en: As for man, his days are as grass: as a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.
verses.am: {As for} man, his days {are} as grass: as a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.

verses.en: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; and the place thereof shall know it no more.
verses.am: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; and the place thereof shall know it no more. {it is...: Heb. it is not}

verses.en: But the mercy of YAHUAH is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him, and his righteousness unto children's children;
verses.am: But the mercy of the LORD {is} from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him, and his righteousness unto children's children;

verses.en: To such as keep his covenant, and to those that remember his commandments to do them.
verses.am: To such as keep his covenant, and to those that remember his commandments to do them.

verses.en: YAHUAH hath prepared his throne in the heavens; and his kingdom ruleth over all.
verses.am: The LORD hath prepared his throne in the heavens; and his kingdom ruleth over all.

verses.en: Bless YAHUAH, ye his angels, that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word.
verses.am: Bless the LORD, ye his angels, that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word. {that excel...: Heb. mighty in strength}

verses.en: Bless ye YAHUAH, all ye his hosts; ye ministers of his, that do his pleasure.
verses.am: Bless ye the LORD, all {ye} his hosts; {ye} ministers of his, that do his pleasure.

verses.en: Bless YAHUAH, all his works in all places of his dominion: bless YAHUAH, O my soul.
verses.am: Bless the LORD, all his works in all places of his dominion: bless the LORD, O my soul.

verses.en: Bless YAHUAH, O my soul. O YAHUAH my YAHUAH, thou art very great; thou art clothed with honour and majesty.
verses.am: Bless the LORD, O my soul. O LORD my God, thou art very great; thou art clothed with honour and majesty.

verses.en: Who coverest thyself with light as with a garment: who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain:
verses.am: Who coverest {thyself} with light as {with} a garment: who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain:

verses.en: Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters: who maketh the clouds his chariot: who walketh upon the wings of the wind:
verses.am: Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters: who maketh the clouds his chariot: who walketh upon the wings of the wind:

verses.en: Who maketh his angels spirits; his ministers a flaming fire:
verses.am: Who maketh his angels spirits; his ministers a flaming fire:

verses.en: Who laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be removed for ever.
verses.am: {Who} laid the foundations of the earth, {that} it should not be removed for ever. {Who...: Heb. He hath founded the earth upon her bases}

verses.en: Thou coveredst it with the deep as with a garment: the waters stood above the mountains.
verses.am: Thou coveredst it with the deep as {with} a garment: the waters stood above the mountains.

verses.en: At thy rebuke they fled; at the voice of thy thunder they hasted away.
verses.am: At thy rebuke they fled; at the voice of thy thunder they hasted away.

verses.en: They go up by the mountains; they go down by the valleys unto the place which thou hast founded for them.
verses.am: They go up by the mountains; they go down by the valleys unto the place which thou hast founded for them. {They go up...: or, The mountains ascend, the valleys descend}

verses.en: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over; that they turn not again to cover the earth.
verses.am: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over; that they turn not again to cover the earth.

verses.en: He sendeth the springs into the valleys, which run among the hills.
verses.am: He sendeth the springs into the valleys, {which} run among the hills. {He: Heb. Who} {run: Heb. walk}

verses.en: They give drink to every beast of the field: the wild asses quench their thirst.
verses.am: They give drink to every beast of the field: the wild asses quench their thirst. {quench: Heb. break}

verses.en: By them shall the fowls of the heaven have their habitation, which sing among the branches.
verses.am: By them shall the fowls of the heaven have their habitation, {which} sing among the branches. {sing: Heb. give a voice}

verses.en: He watereth the hills from his chambers: the earth is satisfied with the fruit of thy works.
verses.am: He watereth the hills from his chambers: the earth is satisfied with the fruit of thy works.

verses.en: He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle, and herb for the service of man: that he may bring forth food out of the earth;
verses.am: He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle, and herb for the service of man: that he may bring forth food out of the earth;

verses.en: And wine that maketh glad the heart of man, and oil to make his face to shine, and bread which strengtheneth man's heart.
verses.am: And wine {that} maketh glad the heart of man, {and} oil to make {his} face to shine, and bread {which} strengtheneth man's heart. {oil...: Heb. to make his face shine with oil, or, more than oil}

verses.en: The trees of YAHUAH are full of sap; the cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted;
verses.am: The trees of the LORD are full {of sap}; the cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted;

verses.en: Where the birds make their nests: as for the stork, the fir trees are her house.
verses.am: Where the birds make their nests: {as for} the stork, the fir trees {are} her house.

verses.en: The high hills are a refuge for the wild goats; and the rocks for the conies.
verses.am: The high hills {are} a refuge for the wild goats; {and} the rocks for the conies.

verses.en: He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.
verses.am: He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.

verses.en: Thou makest darkness, and it is night: wherein all the beasts of the forest do creep forth.
verses.am: Thou makest darkness, and it is night: wherein all the beasts of the forest do creep {forth}. {beasts...: Heb. beasts thereof do trample on the forest}

verses.en: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their meat from YAHUAH.
verses.am: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their meat from God.

verses.en: The sun ariseth, they gather themselves together, and lay them down in their dens.
verses.am: The sun ariseth, they gather themselves together, and lay them down in their dens.

verses.en: Man goeth forth unto his work and to his labour until the evening.
verses.am: Man goeth forth unto his work and to his labour until the evening.

verses.en: O YAHUAH, how manifold are thy works! in wisdom hast thou made them all: the earth is full of thy riches.
verses.am: O LORD, how manifold are thy works! in wisdom hast thou made them all: the earth is full of thy riches.

verses.en: So is this great and wide sea, wherein are things creeping innumerable, both small and great beasts.
verses.am: {So is} this great and wide sea, wherein {are} things creeping innumerable, both small and great beasts.

verses.en: There go the ships: there is that leviathan, whom thou hast made to play therein.
verses.am: There go the ships: {there is} that leviathan, {whom} thou hast made to play therein. {made: Heb. formed}

verses.en: These wait all upon thee; that thou mayest give them their meat in due season.
verses.am: These wait all upon thee; that thou mayest give {them} their meat in due season.

verses.en: That thou givest them they gather: thou openest thine hand, they are filled with good.
verses.am: {That} thou givest them they gather: thou openest thine hand, they are filled with good.

verses.en: Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled: thou takest away their breath, they die, and return to their dust.
verses.am: Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled: thou takest away their breath, they die, and return to their dust.

verses.en: Thou sendest forth thy spirit, they are created: and thou renewest the face of the earth.
verses.am: Thou sendest forth thy spirit, they are created: and thou renewest the face of the earth.

verses.en: The glory of YAHUAH shall endure for ever: YAHUAH shall rejoice in his works.
verses.am: The glory of the LORD shall endure for ever: the LORD shall rejoice in his works. {endure: Heb. be}

verses.en: He looketh on the earth, and it trembleth: he toucheth the hills, and they smoke.
verses.am: He looketh on the earth, and it trembleth: he toucheth the hills, and they smoke.

verses.en: I will sing unto YAHUAH as long as I live: I will sing praise to my YAHUAH while I have my being.
verses.am: I will sing unto the LORD as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.

verses.en: My meditation of him shall be sweet: I will be glad in YAHUAH.
verses.am: My meditation of him shall be sweet: I will be glad in the LORD.

verses.en: Let the sinners be consumed out of the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless thou YAHUAH, O my soul. Praise ye YAHUAH.
verses.am: Let the sinners be consumed out of the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless thou the LORD, O my soul. Praise ye the LORD.

verses.en: O give thanks unto YAHUAH; call upon his name: make known his deeds among the people.
verses.am: O give thanks unto the LORD; call upon his name: make known his deeds among the people.

verses.en: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him: talk ye of all his wondrous works.
verses.am: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him: talk ye of all his wondrous works.

verses.en: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek YAHUAH.
verses.am: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the LORD.

verses.en: Seek YAHUAH, and his strength: seek his face evermore.
verses.am: Seek the LORD, and his strength: seek his face evermore.

verses.en: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;
verses.am: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;

verses.en: O ye seed of Abraham his servant, ye children of Ya'aqob his chosen.
verses.am: O ye seed of Abraham his servant, ye children of Jacob his chosen.

verses.en: He is YAHUAH our YAHUAH: his judgments are in all the earth.
verses.am: He {is} the LORD our God: his judgments {are} in all the earth.

verses.en: He hath remembered his covenant for ever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations.
verses.am: He hath remembered his covenant for ever, the word {which} he commanded to a thousand generations.

verses.en: Which covenant he made with Abraham, and his oath unto Yitschaq;
verses.am: Which {covenant} he made with Abraham, and his oath unto Isaac;

verses.en: And confirmed the same unto Ya'aqob for a law, and to Yisra'el for an everlasting covenant:
verses.am: And confirmed the same unto Jacob for a law, {and} to Israel {for} an everlasting covenant:

verses.en: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance:
verses.am: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance: {lot: Heb. cord}

verses.en: When they were but a few men in number; yea, very few, and strangers in it.
verses.am: When they were {but} a few men in number; yea, very few, and strangers in it.

verses.en: When they went from one nation to another, from one kingdom to another people;
verses.am: When they went from one nation to another, from {one} kingdom to another people;

verses.en: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes;
verses.am: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes;

verses.en: Saying, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.
verses.am: {Saying}, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.

verses.en: Moreover he called for a famine upon the land: he brake the whole staff of bread.
verses.am: Moreover he called for a famine upon the land: he brake the whole staff of bread.

verses.en: He sent a man before them, even Yoseph, who was sold for a servant:
verses.am: He sent a man before them, {even} Joseph, {who} was sold for a servant:

verses.en: Whose feet they hurt with fetters: he was laid in iron:
verses.am: Whose feet they hurt with fetters: he was laid in iron: {he...: Heb. his soul came into iron}

verses.en: Until the time that his word came: the word of YAHUAH tried him.
verses.am: Until the time that his word came: the word of the LORD tried him.

verses.en: The king sent and loosed him; even the ruler of the people, and let him go free.
verses.am: The king sent and loosed him; {even} the ruler of the people, and let him go free.

verses.en: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all his substance:
verses.am: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all his substance: {substance: Heb. possession}

verses.en: To bind his princes at his pleasure; and teach his senators wisdom.
verses.am: To bind his princes at his pleasure; and teach his senators wisdom.

verses.en: Yisra'el also came into Mitsrayim; and Ya'aqob sojourned in the land of Ham.
verses.am: Israel also came into Egypt; and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.

verses.en: And he increased his people greatly; and made them stronger than their enemies.
verses.am: And he increased his people greatly; and made them stronger than their enemies.

verses.en: He turned their heart to hate his people, to deal subtilly with his servants.
verses.am: He turned their heart to hate his people, to deal subtilly with his servants.

verses.en: He sent Mosheh his servant; and Aaron whom he had chosen.
verses.am: He sent Moses his servant; {and} Aaron whom he had chosen.

verses.en: They shewed his signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.
verses.am: They shewed his signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham. {his...: Heb. words of his signs}

verses.en: He sent darkness, and made it dark; and they rebelled not against his word.
verses.am: He sent darkness, and made it dark; and they rebelled not against his word.

verses.en: He turned their waters into blood, and slew their fish.
verses.am: He turned their waters into blood, and slew their fish.

verses.en: Their land brought forth frogs in abundance, in the chambers of their kings.
verses.am: Their land brought forth frogs in abundance, in the chambers of their kings.

verses.en: He spake, and there came divers sorts of flies, and lice in all their coasts.
verses.am: He spake, and there came divers sorts of flies, {and} lice in all their coasts.

verses.en: He gave them hail for rain, and flaming fire in their land.
verses.am: He gave them hail for rain, {and} flaming fire in their land. {them...: Heb. their rain hail}

verses.en: He smote their vines also and their fig trees; and brake the trees of their coasts.
verses.am: He smote their vines also and their fig trees; and brake the trees of their coasts.

verses.en: He spake, and the locusts came, and caterpillers, and that without number,
verses.am: He spake, and the locusts came, and caterpillers, and that without number,

verses.en: And did eat up all the herbs in their land, and devoured the fruit of their ground.
verses.am: And did eat up all the herbs in their land, and devoured the fruit of their ground.

verses.en: He smote also all the firstborn in their land, the chief of all their strength.
verses.am: He smote also all the firstborn in their land, the chief of all their strength.

verses.en: He brought them forth also with silver and gold: and there was not one feeble person among their tribes.
verses.am: He brought them forth also with silver and gold: and {there was} not one feeble {person} among their tribes.

verses.en: Mitsrayim was glad when they departed: for the fear of them fell upon them.
verses.am: Egypt was glad when they departed: for the fear of them fell upon them.

verses.en: He spread a cloud for a covering; and fire to give light in the night.
verses.am: He spread a cloud for a covering; and fire to give light in the night.

verses.en: The people asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.
verses.am: {The people} asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.

verses.en: He opened the rock, and the waters gushed out; they ran in the dry places like a river.
verses.am: He opened the rock, and the waters gushed out; they ran in the dry places {like} a river.

verses.en: For he remembered his holy promise, and Abraham his servant.
verses.am: For he remembered his holy promise, {and} Abraham his servant.

verses.en: And he brought forth his people with joy, and his chosen with gladness:
verses.am: And he brought forth his people with joy, {and} his chosen with gladness: {gladness: Heb. singing}

verses.en: And gave them the lands of the heathen: and they inherited the labour of the people;
verses.am: And gave them the lands of the heathen: and they inherited the labour of the people;

verses.en: That they might observe his statutes, and keep his laws. Praise ye YAHUAH.
verses.am: That they might observe his statutes, and keep his laws. Praise ye the LORD. {Praise...: Heb. Hallelujah}

verses.en: Praise ye YAHUAH. O give thanks unto YAHUAH; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.am: Praise ye the LORD. O give thanks unto the LORD; for {he is} good: for his mercy {endureth} for ever. {Praise...: Heb. Hallelujah}

verses.en: Who can utter the mighty acts of YAHUAH? who can shew forth all his praise?
verses.am: Who can utter the mighty acts of the LORD? {who} can shew forth all his praise?

verses.en: Blessed are they that keep judgment, and he that doeth righteousness at all times.
verses.am: Blessed {are} they that keep judgment, {and} he that doeth righteousness at all times.

verses.en: Remember me, O YAHUAH, with the favour that thou bearest unto thy people: O visit me with thy salvation;
verses.am: Remember me, O LORD, with the favour {that thou bearest unto} thy people: O visit me with thy salvation;

verses.en: That I may see the good of thy chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of thy nation, that I may glory with thine inheritance.
verses.am: That I may see the good of thy chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of thy nation, that I may glory with thine inheritance.

verses.en: We have sinned with our fathers, we have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.
verses.am: We have sinned with our fathers, we have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.

verses.en: Our fathers understood not thy wonders in Mitsrayim; they remembered not the multitude of thy mercies; but provoked him at the sea, even at the Red sea.
verses.am: Our fathers understood not thy wonders in Egypt; they remembered not the multitude of thy mercies; but provoked {him} at the sea, {even} at the Red sea.

verses.en: Nevertheless he saved them for his name's sake, that he might make his mighty power to be known.
verses.am: Nevertheless he saved them for his name's sake, that he might make his mighty power to be known.

verses.en: He rebuked the Red sea also, and it was dried up: so he led them through the depths, as through the wilderness.
verses.am: He rebuked the Red sea also, and it was dried up: so he led them through the depths, as through the wilderness.

verses.en: And he saved them from the hand of him that hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
verses.am: And he saved them from the hand of him that hated {them}, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

verses.en: And the waters covered their enemies: there was not one of them left.
verses.am: And the waters covered their enemies: there was not one of them left.

verses.en: Then believed they his words; they sang his praise.
verses.am: Then believed they his words; they sang his praise.

verses.en: They soon forgat his works; they waited not for his counsel:
verses.am: They soon forgat his works; they waited not for his counsel: {They soon...: Heb. They made haste, they forgat}

verses.en: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, and tempted YAHUAH in the desert.
verses.am: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, and tempted God in the desert. {lusted...: Heb. lusted a lust}

verses.en: And he gave them their request; but sent leanness into their soul.
verses.am: And he gave them their request; but sent leanness into their soul.

verses.en: They envied Mosheh also in the camp, and Aaron the saint of YAHUAH.
verses.am: They envied Moses also in the camp, {and} Aaron the saint of the LORD.

verses.en: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.
verses.am: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.

verses.en: And a fire was kindled in their company; the flame burned up the wicked.
verses.am: And a fire was kindled in their company; the flame burned up the wicked.

verses.en: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshipped the molten image.
verses.am: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshipped the molten image.

verses.en: Thus they changed their glory into the similitude of an ox that eateth grass.
verses.am: Thus they changed their glory into the similitude of an ox that eateth grass.

verses.en: They forgat YAHUAH their saviour, which had done great things in Mitsrayim;
verses.am: They forgat God their saviour, which had done great things in Egypt;

verses.en: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, and terrible things by the Red sea.
verses.am: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, {and} terrible things by the Red sea.

verses.en: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had not Mosheh his chosen stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, lest he should destroy them.
verses.am: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, lest he should destroy {them}.

verses.en: Yea, they despised the pleasant land, they believed not his word:
verses.am: Yea, they despised the pleasant land, they believed not his word: {the pleasant...: Heb. a land of desire}

verses.en: But murmured in their tents, and hearkened not unto the voice of YAHUAH.
verses.am: But murmured in their tents, {and} hearkened not unto the voice of the LORD.

verses.en: Therefore he lifted up his hand against them, to overthrow them in the wilderness:
verses.am: Therefore he lifted up his hand against them, to overthrow them in the wilderness: {to overthrow: Heb. to make them fall}

verses.en: To overthrow their seed also among the nations, and to scatter them in the lands.
verses.am: To overthrow their seed also among the nations, and to scatter them in the lands. {to overthrow: Heb. to make them fall}

verses.en: They joined themselves also unto Baalpeor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.
verses.am: They joined themselves also unto Baalpeor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.

verses.en: Thus they provoked him to anger with their inventions: and the plague brake in upon them.
verses.am: Thus they provoked {him} to anger with their inventions: and the plague brake in upon them.

verses.en: Then stood up Phinehas, and executed judgment: and so the plague was stayed.
verses.am: Then stood up Phinehas, and executed judgment: and {so} the plague was stayed.

verses.en: And that was counted unto him for righteousness unto all generations for evermore.
verses.am: And that was counted unto him for righteousness unto all generations for evermore.

verses.en: They angered him also at the waters of strife, so that it went ill with Mosheh for their sakes:
verses.am: They angered {him} also at the waters of strife, so that it went ill with Moses for their sakes:

verses.en: Because they provoked his spirit, so that he spake unadvisedly with his lips.
verses.am: Because they provoked his spirit, so that he spake unadvisedly with his lips.

verses.en: They did not destroy the nations, concerning whom YAHUAH commanded them:
verses.am: They did not destroy the nations, concerning whom the LORD commanded them:

verses.en: But were mingled among the heathen, and learned their works.
verses.am: But were mingled among the heathen, and learned their works.

verses.en: And they served their idols: which were a snare unto them.
verses.am: And they served their idols: which were a snare unto them.

verses.en: Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto devils,
verses.am: Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto devils,

verses.en: And shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan: and the land was polluted with blood.
verses.am: And shed innocent blood, {even} the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan: and the land was polluted with blood.

verses.en: Thus were they defiled with their own works, and went a whoring with their own inventions.
verses.am: Thus were they defiled with their own works, and went a whoring with their own inventions.

verses.en: Therefore was the wrath of YAHUAH kindled against his people, insomuch that he abhorred his own inheritance.
verses.am: Therefore was the wrath of the LORD kindled against his people, insomuch that he abhorred his own inheritance.

verses.en: And he gave them into the hand of the heathen; and they that hated them ruled over them.
verses.am: And he gave them into the hand of the heathen; and they that hated them ruled over them.

verses.en: Their enemies also oppressed them, and they were brought into subjection under their hand.
verses.am: Their enemies also oppressed them, and they were brought into subjection under their hand.

verses.en: Many times did he deliver them; but they provoked him with their counsel, and were brought low for their iniquity.
verses.am: Many times did he deliver them; but they provoked {him} with their counsel, and were brought low for their iniquity. {brought...: or, impoverished, or, weakened}

verses.en: Nevertheless he regarded their affliction, when he heard their cry:
verses.am: Nevertheless he regarded their affliction, when he heard their cry:

verses.en: And he remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his mercies.
verses.am: And he remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his mercies.

verses.en: He made them also to be pitied of all those that carried them captives.
verses.am: He made them also to be pitied of all those that carried them captives.

verses.en: Save us, O YAHUAH our YAHUAH, and gather us from among the heathen, to give thanks unto thy holy name, and to triumph in thy praise.
verses.am: Save us, O LORD our God, and gather us from among the heathen, to give thanks unto thy holy name, {and} to triumph in thy praise.

verses.en: Blessed be YAHUAH of Yisra'el from everlasting to everlasting: and let all the people say, Amen. Praise ye YAHUAH.
verses.am: Blessed {be} the LORD God of Israel from everlasting to everlasting: and let all the people say, Amen. Praise ye the LORD. {Praise...: Heb. Hallelujah}

verses.en: O give thanks unto YAHUAH, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.am: O give thanks unto the LORD, for {he is} good: for his mercy {endureth} for ever.

verses.en: Let the redeemed of YAHUAH say so, whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the enemy;
verses.am: Let the redeemed of the LORD say {so}, whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the enemy;

verses.en: And gathered them out of the lands, from the east, and from the west, from the north, and from the south.
verses.am: And gathered them out of the lands, from the east, and from the west, from the north, and from the south. {south: Heb. sea}

verses.en: They wandered in the wilderness in a solitary way; they found no city to dwell in.
verses.am: They wandered in the wilderness in a solitary way; they found no city to dwell in.

verses.en: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.
verses.am: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.

verses.en: Then they cried unto YAHUAH in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.
verses.am: Then they cried unto the LORD in their trouble, {and} he delivered them out of their distresses.

verses.en: And he led them forth by the right way, that they might go to a city of habitation.
verses.am: And he led them forth by the right way, that they might go to a city of habitation.

verses.en: Oh that men would praise YAHUAH for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.am: Oh that {men} would praise the LORD {for} his goodness, and {for} his wonderful works to the children of men!

verses.en: For he satisfieth the longing soul, and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.
verses.am: For he satisfieth the longing soul, and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.

verses.en: Such as sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron;
verses.am: Such as sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, {being} bound in affliction and iron;

verses.en: Because they rebelled against the words of YAHUAH, and contemned the counsel of the most High:
verses.am: Because they rebelled against the words of God, and contemned the counsel of the most High:

verses.en: Therefore he brought down their heart with labour; they fell down, and there was none to help.
verses.am: Therefore he brought down their heart with labour; they fell down, and {there was} none to help.

verses.en: Then they cried unto YAHUAH in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.
verses.am: Then they cried unto the LORD in their trouble, {and} he saved them out of their distresses.

verses.en: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and brake their bands in sunder.
verses.am: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and brake their bands in sunder.

verses.en: Oh that men would praise YAHUAH for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.am: Oh that {men} would praise the LORD {for} his goodness, and {for} his wonderful works to the children of men!

verses.en: For he hath broken the gates of brass, and cut the bars of iron in sunder.
verses.am: For he hath broken the gates of brass, and cut the bars of iron in sunder.

verses.en: Fools because of their transgression, and because of their iniquities, are afflicted.
verses.am: Fools because of their transgression, and because of their iniquities, are afflicted.

verses.en: Their soul abhorreth all manner of meat; and they draw near unto the gates of death.
verses.am: Their soul abhorreth all manner of meat; and they draw near unto the gates of death.

verses.en: Then they cry unto YAHUAH in their trouble, and he saveth them out of their distresses.
verses.am: Then they cry unto the LORD in their trouble, {and} he saveth them out of their distresses.

verses.en: He sent his word, and healed them, and delivered them from their destructions.
verses.am: He sent his word, and healed them, and delivered {them} from their destructions.

verses.en: Oh that men would praise YAHUAH for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.am: Oh that {men} would praise the LORD {for} his goodness, and {for} his wonderful works to the children of men!

verses.en: And let them sacrifice the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his works with rejoicing.
verses.am: And let them sacrifice the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his works with rejoicing. {rejoicing: Heb. singing}

verses.en: They that go down to the sea in ships, that do business in great waters;
verses.am: They that go down to the sea in ships, that do business in great waters;

verses.en: These see the works of YAHUAH, and his wonders in the deep.
verses.am: These see the works of the LORD, and his wonders in the deep.

verses.en: For he commandeth, and raiseth the stormy wind, which lifteth up the waves thereof.
verses.am: For he commandeth, and raiseth the stormy wind, which lifteth up the waves thereof. {raiseth: Heb. maketh to stand}

verses.en: They mount up to the heaven, they go down again to the depths: their soul is melted because of trouble.
verses.am: They mount up to the heaven, they go down again to the depths: their soul is melted because of trouble.

verses.en: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits' end.
verses.am: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits' end. {are...: Heb. all their wisdom is swallowed up}

verses.en: Then they cry unto YAHUAH in their trouble, and he bringeth them out of their distresses.
verses.am: Then they cry unto the LORD in their trouble, and he bringeth them out of their distresses.

verses.en: He maketh the storm a calm, so that the waves thereof are still.
verses.am: He maketh the storm a calm, so that the waves thereof are still.

verses.en: Then are they glad because they be quiet; so he bringeth them unto their desired haven.
verses.am: Then are they glad because they be quiet; so he bringeth them unto their desired haven.

verses.en: Oh that men would praise YAHUAH for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.am: Oh that {men} would praise the LORD {for} his goodness, and {for} his wonderful works to the children of men!

verses.en: Let them exalt him also in the congregation of the people, and praise him in the assembly of the elders.
verses.am: Let them exalt him also in the congregation of the people, and praise him in the assembly of the elders.

verses.en: He turneth rivers into a wilderness, and the watersprings into dry ground;
verses.am: He turneth rivers into a wilderness, and the watersprings into dry ground;

verses.en: A fruitful land into barrenness, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein.
verses.am: A fruitful land into barrenness, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein. {barrenness: Heb. saltiness}

verses.en: He turneth the wilderness into a standing water, and dry ground into watersprings.
verses.am: He turneth the wilderness into a standing water, and dry ground into watersprings.

verses.en: And there he maketh the hungry to dwell, that they may prepare a city for habitation;
verses.am: And there he maketh the hungry to dwell, that they may prepare a city for habitation;

verses.en: And sow the fields, and plant vineyards, which may yield fruits of increase.
verses.am: And sow the fields, and plant vineyards, which may yield fruits of increase.

verses.en: He blesseth them also, so that they are multiplied greatly; and suffereth not their cattle to decrease.
verses.am: He blesseth them also, so that they are multiplied greatly; and suffereth not their cattle to decrease.

verses.en: Again, they are minished and brought low through oppression, affliction, and sorrow.
verses.am: Again, they are minished and brought low through oppression, affliction, and sorrow.

verses.en: He poureth contempt upon princes, and causeth them to wander in the wilderness, where there is no way.
verses.am: He poureth contempt upon princes, and causeth them to wander in the wilderness, {where there is} no way. {wilderness: or, void place}

verses.en: Yet setteth he the poor on high from affliction, and maketh him families like a flock.
verses.am: Yet setteth he the poor on high from affliction, and maketh {him} families like a flock. {from: or, after}

verses.en: The righteous shall see it, and rejoice: and all iniquity shall stop her mouth.
verses.am: The righteous shall see {it}, and rejoice: and all iniquity shall stop her mouth.

verses.en: Whoso is wise, and will observe these things, even they shall understand the lovingkindness of YAHUAH.
verses.am: Whoso {is} wise, and will observe these {things}, even they shall understand the lovingkindness of the LORD.

verses.en: [A Song or Psalm of Dawid.] O YAHUAH, my heart is fixed; I will sing and give praise, even with my glory.
verses.am: [A Song {or} Psalm of David.] O God, my heart is fixed; I will sing and give praise, even with my glory.

verses.en: Awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.
verses.am: Awake, psaltery and harp: I {myself} will awake early.

verses.en: I will praise thee, O YAHUAH, among the people: and I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.
verses.am: I will praise thee, O LORD, among the people: and I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.

verses.en: For thy mercy is great above the heavens: and thy truth reacheth unto the clouds.
verses.am: For thy mercy {is} great above the heavens: and thy truth {reacheth} unto the clouds. {clouds: or, skies}

verses.en: Be thou exalted, O YAHUAH, above the heavens: and thy glory above all the earth;
verses.am: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: and thy glory above all the earth;

verses.en: That thy beloved may be delivered: save with thy right hand, and answer me.
verses.am: That thy beloved may be delivered: save {with} thy right hand, and answer me.

verses.en: YAHUAH hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
verses.am: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

verses.en: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Yehudah is my lawgiver;
verses.am: Gilead {is} mine; Manasseh {is} mine; Ephraim also {is} the strength of mine head; Judah {is} my lawgiver;

verses.en: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe; over Philistia will I triumph.
verses.am: Moab {is} my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe; over Philistia will I triumph.

verses.en: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?
verses.am: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?

verses.en: Wilt not thou, O YAHUAH, who hast cast us off? and wilt not thou, O YAHUAH, go forth with our hosts?
verses.am: {Wilt} not {thou}, O God, {who} hast cast us off? and wilt not thou, O God, go forth with our hosts?

verses.en: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.
verses.am: Give us help from trouble: for vain {is} the help of man.

verses.en: Through YAHUAH we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.
verses.am: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he {it is that} shall tread down our enemies.

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of Dawid.] Hold not thy peace, O YAHUAH of my praise;
verses.am: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.] Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;

verses.en: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue.
verses.am: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue. {of the deceitful: Heb. of deceit} {are opened: Heb. have opened themselves}

verses.en: They compassed me about also with words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.
verses.am: They compassed me about also with words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.

verses.en: For my love they are my adversaries: but I give myself unto prayer.
verses.am: For my love they are my adversaries: but I {give myself unto} prayer.

verses.en: And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
verses.am: And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.

verses.en: Set thou a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand.
verses.am: Set thou a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand. {Satan: or, an adversary}

verses.en: When he shall be judged, let him be condemned: and let his prayer become sin.
verses.am: When he shall be judged, let him be condemned: and let his prayer become sin. {be condemned: Heb. go out guilty, or, wicked}

verses.en: Let his days be few; and let another take his office.
verses.am: Let his days be few; {and} let another take his office. {office: or, charge}

verses.en: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.
verses.am: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.

verses.en: Let his children be continually vagabonds, and beg: let them seek their bread also out of their desolate places.
verses.am: Let his children be continually vagabonds, and beg: let them seek {their bread} also out of their desolate places.

verses.en: Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; and let the strangers spoil his labour.
verses.am: Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; and let the strangers spoil his labour.

verses.en: Let there be none to extend mercy unto him: neither let there be any to favour his fatherless children.
verses.am: Let there be none to extend mercy unto him: neither let there be any to favour his fatherless children.

verses.en: Let his posterity be cut off; and in the generation following let their name be blotted out.
verses.am: Let his posterity be cut off; {and} in the generation following let their name be blotted out.

verses.en: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with YAHUAH; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.
verses.am: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with the LORD; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.

verses.en: Let them be before YAHUAH continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.
verses.am: Let them be before the LORD continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.

verses.en: Because that he remembered not to shew mercy, but persecuted the poor and needy man, that he might even slay the broken in heart.
verses.am: Because that he remembered not to shew mercy, but persecuted the poor and needy man, that he might even slay the broken in heart.

verses.en: As he loved cursing, so let it come unto him: as he delighted not in blessing, so let it be far from him.
verses.am: As he loved cursing, so let it come unto him: as he delighted not in blessing, so let it be far from him.

verses.en: As he clothed himself with cursing like as with his garment, so let it come into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones.
verses.am: As he clothed himself with cursing like as with his garment, so let it come into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones. {into his bowels: Heb. within him}

verses.en: Let it be unto him as the garment which covereth him, and for a girdle wherewith he is girded continually.
verses.am: Let it be unto him as the garment {which} covereth him, and for a girdle wherewith he is girded continually.

verses.en: Let this be the reward of mine adversaries from YAHUAH, and of them that speak evil against my soul.
verses.am: {Let} this {be} the reward of mine adversaries from the LORD, and of them that speak evil against my soul.

verses.en: But do thou for me, O YAHUAH, for thy name's sake: because thy mercy is good, deliver thou me.
verses.am: But do thou for me, O GOD the Lord, for thy name's sake: because thy mercy {is} good, deliver thou me.

verses.en: For I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.
verses.am: For I {am} poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.

verses.en: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.
verses.am: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.

verses.en: My knees are weak through fasting; and my flesh faileth of fatness.
verses.am: My knees are weak through fasting; and my flesh faileth of fatness.

verses.en: I became also a reproach unto them: when they looked upon me they shaked their heads.
verses.am: I became also a reproach unto them: {when} they looked upon me they shaked their heads.

verses.en: Help me, O YAHUAH my YAHUAH: O save me according to thy mercy:
verses.am: Help me, O LORD my God: O save me according to thy mercy:

verses.en: That they may know that this is thy hand; that thou, YAHUAH, hast done it.
verses.am: That they may know that this {is} thy hand; {that} thou, LORD, hast done it.

verses.en: Let them curse, but bless thou: when they arise, let them be ashamed; but let thy servant rejoice.
verses.am: Let them curse, but bless thou: when they arise, let them be ashamed; but let thy servant rejoice.

verses.en: Let mine adversaries be clothed with shame, and let them cover themselves with their own confusion, as with a mantle.
verses.am: Let mine adversaries be clothed with shame, and let them cover themselves with their own confusion, as with a mantle.

verses.en: I will greatly praise YAHUAH with my mouth; yea, I will praise him among the multitude.
verses.am: I will greatly praise the LORD with my mouth; yea, I will praise him among the multitude.

verses.en: For he shall stand at the right hand of the poor, to save him from those that condemn his soul.
verses.am: For he shall stand at the right hand of the poor, to save {him} from those that condemn his soul. {those...: Heb. the judges of}

verses.en: [A Psalm of Dawid.] YAHUAH said unto my Master, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.
verses.am: [A Psalm of David.] The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.

verses.en: YAHUAH shall send the rod of thy strength out of Zion: rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.
verses.am: The LORD shall send the rod of thy strength out of Zion: rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.

verses.en: Thy people shall be willing in the day of thy power, in the beauties of holiness from the womb of the morning: thou hast the dew of thy youth.
verses.am: Thy people {shall be} willing in the day of thy power, in the beauties of holiness from the womb of the morning: thou hast the dew of thy youth. {from...: or, more than the womb of the morning: thou shalt have, etc}

verses.en: YAHUAH hath sworn, and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.
verses.am: The LORD hath sworn, and will not repent, Thou {art} a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.

verses.en: YAHUAH at thy right hand shall strike through kings in the day of his wrath.
verses.am: The Lord at thy right hand shall strike through kings in the day of his wrath.

verses.en: He shall judge among the heathen, he shall fill the places with the dead bodies; he shall wound the heads over many countries.
verses.am: He shall judge among the heathen, he shall fill {the places} with the dead bodies; he shall wound the heads over many countries. {many: or, great}

verses.en: He shall drink of the brook in the way: therefore shall he lift up the head.
verses.am: He shall drink of the brook in the way: therefore shall he lift up the head.

verses.en: Praise ye YAHUAH. I will praise YAHUAH with my whole heart, in the assembly of the upright, and in the congregation.
verses.am: Praise ye the LORD. I will praise the LORD with {my} whole heart, in the assembly of the upright, and {in} the congregation. {Praise ye...: Heb. Hallelujah}

verses.en: The works of YAHUAH are great, sought out of all them that have pleasure therein.
verses.am: The works of the LORD {are} great, sought out of all them that have pleasure therein.

verses.en: His work is honourable and glorious: and his righteousness endureth for ever.
verses.am: His work {is} honourable and glorious: and his righteousness endureth for ever.

verses.en: He hath made his wonderful works to be remembered: YAHUAH is gracious and full of compassion.
verses.am: He hath made his wonderful works to be remembered: the LORD {is} gracious and full of compassion.

verses.en: He hath given meat unto them that fear him: he will ever be mindful of his covenant.
verses.am: He hath given meat unto them that fear him: he will ever be mindful of his covenant. {meat: Heb. prey}

verses.en: He hath shewed his people the power of his works, that he may give them the heritage of the heathen.
verses.am: He hath shewed his people the power of his works, that he may give them the heritage of the heathen.

verses.en: The works of his hands are verity and judgment; all his commandments are sure.
verses.am: The works of his hands {are} verity and judgment; all his commandments {are} sure.

verses.en: They stand fast for ever and ever, and are done in truth and uprightness.
verses.am: They stand fast for ever and ever, {and are} done in truth and uprightness. {stand...: Heb. are established}

verses.en: He sent redemption unto his people: he hath commanded his covenant for ever: holy and reverend is his name.
verses.am: He sent redemption unto his people: he hath commanded his covenant for ever: holy and reverend {is} his name.

verses.en: The fear of YAHUAH is the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all they that do his commandments: his praise endureth for ever.
verses.am: The fear of the LORD {is} the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all they that do {his commandments}: his praise endureth for ever. {a good...: or, good success} {his commandments: Heb. them}

verses.en: Praise ye YAHUAH. Blessed is the man that feareth YAHUAH, that delighteth greatly in his commandments.
verses.am: Praise ye the LORD. Blessed {is} the man {that} feareth the LORD, {that} delighteth greatly in his commandments. {Praise...: Heb. Hallelujah}

verses.en: His seed shall be mighty upon earth: the generation of the upright shall be blessed.
verses.am: His seed shall be mighty upon earth: the generation of the upright shall be blessed.

verses.en: Wealth and riches shall be in his house: and his righteousness endureth for ever.
verses.am: Wealth and riches {shall be} in his house: and his righteousness endureth for ever.

verses.en: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness: he is gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.
verses.am: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness: {he is} gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.

verses.en: A good man sheweth favour, and lendeth: he will guide his affairs with discretion.
verses.am: A good man sheweth favour, and lendeth: he will guide his affairs with discretion. {discretion: Heb. judgment}

verses.en: Surely he shall not be moved for ever: the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance.
verses.am: Surely he shall not be moved for ever: the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance.

verses.en: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in YAHUAH.
verses.am: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in the LORD.

verses.en: His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, until he see his desire upon his enemies.
verses.am: His heart {is} established, he shall not be afraid, until he see {his desire} upon his enemies.

verses.en: He hath dispersed, he hath given to the poor; his righteousness endureth for ever; his horn shall be exalted with honour.
verses.am: He hath dispersed, he hath given to the poor; his righteousness endureth for ever; his horn shall be exalted with honour.

verses.en: The wicked shall see it, and be grieved; he shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: the desire of the wicked shall perish.
verses.am: The wicked shall see {it}, and be grieved; he shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: the desire of the wicked shall perish.

verses.en: Praise ye YAHUAH. Praise, O ye servants of YAHUAH, praise the name of YAHUAH.
verses.am: Praise ye the LORD. Praise, O ye servants of the LORD, praise the name of the LORD. {Praise ye...: Heb. Hallelujah}

verses.en: Blessed be the name of YAHUAH from this time forth and for evermore.
verses.am: Blessed be the name of the LORD from this time forth and for evermore.

verses.en: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same YAHUAH's name is to be praised.
verses.am: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same the LORD'S name {is} to be praised.

verses.en: YAHUAH is high above all nations, and his glory above the heavens.
verses.am: The LORD {is} high above all nations, {and} his glory above the heavens.

verses.en: Who is like unto YAHUAH our YAHUAH, who dwelleth on high,
verses.am: Who {is} like unto the LORD our God, who dwelleth on high, {dwelleth...: Heb. exalteth himself to dwell}

verses.en: Who humbleth himself to behold the things that are in heaven, and in the earth!
verses.am: Who humbleth {himself} to behold {the things that are} in heaven, and in the earth!

verses.en: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifteth the needy out of the dunghill;
verses.am: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, {and} lifteth the needy out of the dunghill;

verses.en: That he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.
verses.am: That he may set {him} with princes, {even} with the princes of his people.

verses.en: He maketh the barren woman to keep house, and to be a joyful mother of children. Praise ye YAHUAH.
verses.am: He maketh the barren woman to keep house, {and to be} a joyful mother of children. Praise ye the LORD. {to keep...: Heb. to dwell in an house}

verses.en: When Yisra'el went out of Mitsrayim, the house of Ya'aqob from a people of strange language;
verses.am: When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of strange language;

verses.en: Yehudah was his sanctuary, and Yisra'el his dominion.
verses.am: Judah was his sanctuary, {and} Israel his dominion.

verses.en: The sea saw it, and fled: Jordan was driven back.
verses.am: The sea saw {it}, and fled: Jordan was driven back.

verses.en: The mountains skipped like rams, and the little hills like lambs.
verses.am: The mountains skipped like rams, {and} the little hills like lambs.

verses.en: What ailed thee, O thou sea, that thou fleddest? thou Jordan, that thou wast driven back?
verses.am: What {ailed} thee, O thou sea, that thou fleddest? thou Jordan, {that} thou wast driven back?

verses.en: Ye mountains, that ye skipped like rams; and ye little hills, like lambs?
verses.am: Ye mountains, {that} ye skipped like rams; {and} ye little hills, like lambs?

verses.en: Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of YAHUAH, at the presence of YAHUAH of Ya'aqob;
verses.am: Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob;

verses.en: Which turned the rock into a standing water, the flint into a fountain of waters.
verses.am: Which turned the rock {into} a standing water, the flint into a fountain of waters.

verses.en: Not unto us, O YAHUAH, not unto us, but unto thy name give glory, for thy mercy, and for thy truth's sake.
verses.am: Not unto us, O LORD, not unto us, but unto thy name give glory, for thy mercy, {and} for thy truth's sake.

verses.en: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is now their YAHUAH?
verses.am: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where {is} now their God?

verses.en: But our YAHUAH is in the heavens: he hath done whatsoever he hath pleased.
verses.am: But our God {is} in the heavens: he hath done whatsoever he hath pleased.

verses.en: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.
verses.am: Their idols {are} silver and gold, the work of men's hands.

verses.en: They have mouths, but they speak not: eyes have they, but they see not:
verses.am: They have mouths, but they speak not: eyes have they, but they see not:

verses.en: They have ears, but they hear not: noses have they, but they smell not:
verses.am: They have ears, but they hear not: noses have they, but they smell not:

verses.en: They have hands, but they handle not: feet have they, but they walk not: neither speak they through their throat.
verses.am: They have hands, but they handle not: feet have they, but they walk not: neither speak they through their throat.

verses.en: They that make them are like unto them; so is every one that trusteth in them.
verses.am: They that make them are like unto them; {so is} every one that trusteth in them.

verses.en: O Yisra'el, trust thou in YAHUAH: he is their help and their shield.

verses.am: They had almost consumed me upon earth; but I forsook not thy precepts.

verses.en: Quicken me after thy lovingkindness; so shall I keep the testimony of thy mouth.
verses.am: Quicken me after thy lovingkindness; so shall I keep the testimony of thy mouth.

verses.en: LAMED. For ever, O YAHUAH, thy word is settled in heaven.
verses.am: LAMED. For ever, O LORD, thy word is settled in heaven.

verses.en: Thy faithfulness is unto all generations: thou hast established the earth, and it abideth.
verses.am: Thy faithfulness {is} unto all generations: thou hast established the earth, and it abideth. {unto...: Heb. to generation and generation} {abideth: Heb. standeth}

verses.en: They continue this day according to thine ordinances: for all are thy servants.
verses.am: They continue this day according to thine ordinances: for all {are} thy servants.

verses.en: Unless thy law had been my delights, I should then have perished in mine affliction.
verses.am: Unless thy law {had been} my delights, I should then have perished in mine affliction.

verses.en: I will never forget thy precepts: for with them thou hast quickened me.
verses.am: I will never forget thy precepts: for with them thou hast quickened me.

verses.en: I am thine, save me; for I have sought thy precepts.
verses.am: I {am} thine, save me; for I have sought thy precepts.

verses.en: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me: but I will consider thy testimonies.
verses.am: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me: {but} I will consider thy testimonies.

verses.en: I have seen an end of all perfection: but thy commandment is exceeding broad.
verses.am: I have seen an end of all perfection: {but} thy commandment {is} exceeding broad.

verses.en: MEM. O how love I thy law! it is my meditation all the day.
verses.am: MEM. O how love I thy law! it {is} my meditation all the day.

verses.en: Thou through thy commandments hast made me wiser than mine enemies: for they are ever with me.
verses.am: Thou through thy commandments hast made me wiser than mine enemies: for they {are} ever with me. {they...: Heb. it is ever with me}

verses.en: I have more understanding than all my teachers: for thy testimonies are my meditation.
verses.am: I have more understanding than all my teachers: for thy testimonies {are} my meditation.

verses.en: I understand more than the ancients, because I keep thy precepts.
verses.am: I understand more than the ancients, because I keep thy precepts.

verses.en: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, that I might keep thy word.
verses.am: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, that I might keep thy word.

verses.en: I have not departed from thy judgments: for thou hast taught me.
verses.am: I have not departed from thy judgments: for thou hast taught me.

verses.en: How sweet are thy words unto my taste! yea, sweeter than honey to my mouth!
verses.am: How sweet are thy words unto my taste! {yea, sweeter} than honey to my mouth! {taste: Heb. palate}

verses.en: Through thy precepts I get understanding: therefore I hate every false way.
verses.am: Through thy precepts I get understanding: therefore I hate every false way.

verses.en: NUN. Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
verses.am: NUN. Thy word {is} a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path. {lamp: or, candle}

verses.en: I have sworn, and I will perform it, that I will keep thy righteous judgments.
verses.am: I have sworn, and I will perform {it}, that I will keep thy righteous judgments.

verses.en: I am afflicted very much: quicken me, O YAHUAH, according unto thy word.
verses.am: I am afflicted very much: quicken me, O LORD, according unto thy word.

verses.en: Accept, I beseech thee, the freewill offerings of my mouth, O YAHUAH, and teach me thy judgments.
verses.am: Accept, I beseech thee, the freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD, and teach me thy judgments.

verses.en: My soul is continually in my hand: yet do I not forget thy law.
verses.am: My soul {is} continually in my hand: yet do I not forget thy law.

verses.en: The wicked have laid a snare for me: yet I erred not from thy precepts.
verses.am: The wicked have laid a snare for me: yet I erred not from thy precepts.

verses.en: Thy testimonies have I taken as an heritage for ever: for they are the rejoicing of my heart.
verses.am: Thy testimonies have I taken as an heritage for ever: for they {are} the rejoicing of my heart.

verses.en: I have inclined mine heart to perform thy statutes alway, even unto the end.
verses.am: I have inclined mine heart to perform thy statutes alway, {even unto} the end. {to perform: Heb. to do}

verses.en: SAMECH. I hate vain thoughts: but thy law do I love.
verses.am: SAMECH. I hate {vain} thoughts: but thy law do I love.

verses.en: Thou art my hiding place and my shield: I hope in thy word.
verses.am: Thou {art} my hiding place and my shield: I hope in thy word.

verses.en: Depart from me, ye evildoers: for I will keep the commandments of my YAHUAH.
verses.am: Depart from me, ye evildoers: for I will keep the commandments of my God.

verses.en: Uphold me according unto thy word, that I may live: and let me not be ashamed of my hope.
verses.am: Uphold me according unto thy word, that I may live: and let me not be ashamed of my hope.

verses.en: Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe: and I will have respect unto thy statutes continually.
verses.am: Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe: and I will have respect unto thy statutes continually.

verses.en: Thou hast trodden down all them that err from thy statutes: for their deceit is falsehood.
verses.am: Thou hast trodden down all them that err from thy statutes: for their deceit {is} falsehood.

verses.en: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth like dross: therefore I love thy testimonies.
verses.am: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth {like} dross: therefore I love thy testimonies. {puttest...: Heb. causest to cease}

verses.en: My flesh trembleth for fear of thee; and I am afraid of thy judgments.
verses.am: My flesh trembleth for fear of thee; and I am afraid of thy judgments.

verses.en: AIN. I have done judgment and justice: leave me not to mine oppressors.
verses.am: AIN. I have done judgment and justice: leave me not to mine oppressors.

verses.en: Be surety for thy servant for good: let not the proud oppress me.
verses.am: Be surety for thy servant for good: let not the proud oppress me.

verses.en: Mine eyes fail for thy salvation, and for the word of thy righteousness.
verses.am: Mine eyes fail for thy salvation, and for the word of thy righteousness.

verses.en: Deal with thy servant according unto thy mercy, and teach me thy statutes.
verses.am: Deal with thy servant according unto thy mercy, and teach me thy statutes.

verses.en: I am thy servant; give me understanding, that I may know thy testimonies.
verses.am: I {am} thy servant; give me understanding, that I may know thy testimonies.

verses.en: It is time for thee, YAHUAH, to work: for they have made void thy law.
verses.am: {It is} time for {thee}, LORD, to work: {for} they have made void thy law.

verses.en: Therefore I love thy commandments above gold; yea, above fine gold.
verses.am: Therefore I love thy commandments above gold; yea, above fine gold.

verses.en: Therefore I esteem all thy precepts concerning all things to be right; and I hate every false way.
verses.am: Therefore I esteem all {thy} precepts {concerning} all {things to be} right; {and} I hate every false way.

verses.en: PE. Thy testimonies are wonderful: therefore doth my soul keep them.
verses.am: PE. Thy testimonies {are} wonderful: therefore doth my soul keep them.

verses.en: The entrance of thy words giveth light; it giveth understanding unto the simple.
verses.am: The entrance of thy words giveth light; it giveth understanding unto the simple.

verses.en: I opened my mouth, and panted: for I longed for thy commandments.
verses.am: I opened my mouth, and panted: for I longed for thy commandments.

verses.en: Look thou upon me, and be merciful unto me, as thou usest to do unto those that love thy name.
