verses.am: Look thou upon me, and be merciful unto me, as thou usest to do unto those that love thy name. {as thou...: Heb. according to the custom toward those, etc}

verses.en: Order my steps in thy word: and let not any iniquity have dominion over me.
verses.am: Order my steps in thy word: and let not any iniquity have dominion over me.

verses.en: Deliver me from the oppression of man: so will I keep thy precepts.
verses.am: Deliver me from the oppression of man: so will I keep thy precepts.

verses.en: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; and teach me thy statutes.
verses.am: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; and teach me thy statutes.

verses.en: Rivers of waters run down mine eyes, because they keep not thy law.
verses.am: Rivers of waters run down mine eyes, because they keep not thy law.

verses.en: TZADDI. Righteous art thou, O YAHUAH, and upright are thy judgments.
verses.am: TZADDI. Righteous {art} thou, O LORD, and upright {are} thy judgments.

verses.en: Thy testimonies that thou hast commanded are righteous and very faithful.
verses.am: Thy testimonies {that} thou hast commanded {are} righteous and very faithful. {righteous: Heb. righteousness} {faithful: Heb. faithfulness}

verses.en: My zeal hath consumed me, because mine enemies have forgotten thy words.
verses.am: My zeal hath consumed me, because mine enemies have forgotten thy words. {consumed...: Heb. cut me off}

verses.en: Thy word is very pure: therefore thy servant loveth it.
verses.am: Thy word {is} very pure: therefore thy servant loveth it. {pure: Heb. tried, or, refined}

verses.en: I am small and despised: yet do not I forget thy precepts.
verses.am: I {am} small and despised: {yet} do not I forget thy precepts.

verses.en: Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and thy law is the truth.
verses.am: Thy righteousness {is} an everlasting righteousness, and thy law {is} the truth.

verses.en: Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me: yet thy commandments are my delights.
verses.am: Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me: {yet} thy commandments {are} my delights. {taken...: Heb. found me}

verses.en: The righteousness of thy testimonies is everlasting: give me understanding, and I shall live.
verses.am: The righteousness of thy testimonies {is} everlasting: give me understanding, and I shall live.

verses.en: KOPH. I cried with my whole heart; hear me, O YAHUAH: I will keep thy statutes.
verses.am: KOPH. I cried with {my} whole heart; hear me, O LORD: I will keep thy statutes.

verses.en: I cried unto thee; save me, and I shall keep thy testimonies.
verses.am: I cried unto thee; save me, and I shall keep thy testimonies. {and I...: or, that I may keep}

verses.en: I prevented the dawning of the morning, and cried: I hoped in thy word.
verses.am: I prevented the dawning of the morning, and cried: I hoped in thy word.

verses.en: Mine eyes prevent the night watches, that I might meditate in thy word.
verses.am: Mine eyes prevent the {night} watches, that I might meditate in thy word.

verses.en: Hear my voice according unto thy lovingkindness: O YAHUAH, quicken me according to thy judgment.
verses.am: Hear my voice according unto thy lovingkindness: O LORD, quicken me according to thy judgment.

verses.en: They draw nigh that follow after mischief: they are far from thy law.
verses.am: They draw nigh that follow after mischief: they are far from thy law.

verses.en: Thou art near, O YAHUAH; and all thy commandments are truth.
verses.am: Thou {art} near, O LORD; and all thy commandments {are} truth.

verses.en: Concerning thy testimonies, I have known of old that thou hast founded them for ever.
verses.am: Concerning thy testimonies, I have known of old that thou hast founded them for ever.

verses.en: RESH. Consider mine affliction, and deliver me: for I do not forget thy law.
verses.am: RESH. Consider mine affliction, and deliver me: for I do not forget thy law.

verses.en: Plead my cause, and deliver me: quicken me according to thy word.
verses.am: Plead my cause, and deliver me: quicken me according to thy word.

verses.en: Salvation is far from the wicked: for they seek not thy statutes.
verses.am: Salvation {is} far from the wicked: for they seek not thy statutes.

verses.en: Great are thy tender mercies, O YAHUAH: quicken me according to thy judgments.
verses.am: Great {are} thy tender mercies, O LORD: quicken me according to thy judgments. {Great: or, Many}

verses.en: Many are my persecutors and mine enemies; yet do I not decline from thy testimonies.
verses.am: Many {are} my persecutors and mine enemies; {yet} do I not decline from thy testimonies.

verses.en: I beheld the transgressors, and was grieved; because they kept not thy word.
verses.am: I beheld the transgressors, and was grieved; because they kept not thy word.

verses.en: Consider how I love thy precepts: quicken me, O YAHUAH, according to thy lovingkindness.
verses.am: Consider how I love thy precepts: quicken me, O LORD, according to thy lovingkindness.

verses.en: Thy word is true from the beginning: and every one of thy righteous judgments endureth for ever.
verses.am: Thy word {is} true {from} the beginning: and every one of thy righteous judgments {endureth} for ever. {Thy word...: Heb. The beginning of thy word is true}

verses.en: SCHIN. Princes have persecuted me without a cause: but my heart standeth in awe of thy word.
verses.am: SCHIN. Princes have persecuted me without a cause: but my heart standeth in awe of thy word.

verses.en: I rejoice at thy word, as one that findeth great spoil.
verses.am: I rejoice at thy word, as one that findeth great spoil.

verses.en: I hate and abhor lying: but thy law do I love.
verses.am: I hate and abhor lying: {but} thy law do I love.

verses.en: Seven times a day do I praise thee because of thy righteous judgments.
verses.am: Seven times a day do I praise thee because of thy righteous judgments.

verses.en: Great peace have they which love thy law: and nothing shall offend them.
verses.am: Great peace have they which love thy law: and nothing shall offend them. {nothing...: Heb. they shall have no stumblingblock}

verses.en: YAHUAH, I have hoped for thy salvation, and done thy commandments.
verses.am: LORD, I have hoped for thy salvation, and done thy commandments.

verses.en: My soul hath kept thy testimonies; and I love them exceedingly.
verses.am: My soul hath kept thy testimonies; and I love them exceedingly.

verses.en: I have kept thy precepts and thy testimonies: for all my ways are before thee.
verses.am: I have kept thy precepts and thy testimonies: for all my ways {are} before thee.

verses.en: TAU. Let my cry come near before thee, O YAHUAH: give me understanding according to thy word.
verses.am: TAU. Let my cry come near before thee, O LORD: give me understanding according to thy word.

verses.en: Let my supplication come before thee: deliver me according to thy word.
verses.am: Let my supplication come before thee: deliver me according to thy word.

verses.en: My lips shall utter praise, when thou hast taught me thy statutes.
verses.am: My lips shall utter praise, when thou hast taught me thy statutes.

verses.en: My tongue shall speak of thy word: for all thy commandments are righteousness.
verses.am: My tongue shall speak of thy word: for all thy commandments {are} righteousness.

verses.en: Let thine hand help me; for I have chosen thy precepts.
verses.am: Let thine hand help me; for I have chosen thy precepts.

verses.en: I have longed for thy salvation, O YAHUAH; and thy law is my delight.
verses.am: I have longed for thy salvation, O LORD; and thy law {is} my delight.

verses.en: Let my soul live, and it shall praise thee; and let thy judgments help me.
verses.am: Let my soul live, and it shall praise thee; and let thy judgments help me.

verses.en: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek thy servant; for I do not forget thy commandments.
verses.am: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek thy servant; for I do not forget thy commandments.

verses.en: [A Song of degrees.] In my distress I cried unto YAHUAH, and he heard me.
verses.am: [A Song of degrees.] In my distress I cried unto the LORD, and he heard me.

verses.en: Deliver my soul, O YAHUAH, from lying lips, and from a deceitful tongue.
verses.am: Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips, {and} from a deceitful tongue.

verses.en: What shall be given unto thee? or what shall be done unto thee, thou false tongue?
verses.am: What shall be given unto thee? or what shall be done unto thee, thou false tongue? {What shall be given...: or, What shall the deceitful tongue give unto thee? or, what shall it profit thee?} {done: Heb. added}

verses.en: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.
verses.am: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper. {Sharp...: or, It is as the sharp arrows of the mighty man, with coals of juniper}

verses.en: Woe is me, that I sojourn in Mesech, that I dwell in the tents of Kedar!
verses.am: Woe is me, that I sojourn in Mesech, {that} I dwell in the tents of Kedar!

verses.en: My soul hath long dwelt with him that hateth peace.
verses.am: My soul hath long dwelt with him that hateth peace.

verses.en: I am for peace: but when I speak, they are for war.
verses.am: I {am for} peace: but when I speak, they {are} for war. {for peace: or, a man of peace}

verses.en: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.
verses.am: ዓይኖቼን ወደ ተራሮች አነሣለሁ፤ እርዳታዬ ከወዴት ይመጣል?

verses.en: My help cometh from YAHUAH, which made heaven and earth.
verses.am: እርዳታዬ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ነው፥ ሰማይንና ምድርን ከፈጠረ።

verses.en: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not slumber.
verses.am: እግሮችህ እንዳይሰናከሉ አይተውህም፤ የሚጠብቅህም አያንቀላፋም።

verses.en: Behold, he that keepeth Yisra'el shall neither slumber nor sleep.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እስራኤልን የሚጠብቅ አያንቀላፋም አይተኛምም።

verses.en: YAHUAH is thy keeper: YAHUAH is thy shade upon thy right hand.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የሚጠብቅህ ነው፤ እግዚአብሔር በቀኝህ እጅ ጥላህ ነው።

verses.en: The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night.
verses.am: በቀን ፀሐይ አይመታህም፥ በሌሊትም ጨረቃ።

verses.en: YAHUAH shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ከክፉ ሁሉ ይጠብቅሃል፤ ነፍስህን ይጠብቃል።

verses.en: YAHUAH shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር መውጣትህንና መግባትህን ከዛሬ ጀምሮ እስከ ዘላለም ይጠብቃል።

verses.en: [A Song of degrees of Dawid.] I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of YAHUAH.
verses.am: [A Song of degrees of David.] I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of the LORD.

verses.en: Our feet shall stand within thy gates, O Yerushalayim.
verses.am: Our feet shall stand within thy gates, O Jerusalem.

verses.en: Yerushalayim is builded as a city that is compact together:
verses.am: Jerusalem is builded as a city that is compact together:

verses.en: Whither the tribes go up, the tribes of YAHUAH, unto the testimony of Yisra'el, to give thanks unto the name of YAHUAH.
verses.am: Whither the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD, unto the testimony of Israel, to give thanks unto the name of the LORD.

verses.en: For there are set thrones of judgment, the thrones of the house of Dawid.
verses.am: For there are set thrones of judgment, the thrones of the house of David. {are...: Heb. do sit}

verses.en: Pray for the peace of Yerushalayim: they shall prosper that love thee.
verses.am: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: they shall prosper that love thee.

verses.en: Peace be within thy walls, and prosperity within thy palaces.
verses.am: Peace be within thy walls, {and} prosperity within thy palaces.

verses.en: For my brethren and companions' sakes, I will now say, Peace be within thee.
verses.am: For my brethren and companions' sakes, I will now say, Peace {be} within thee.

verses.en: Because of the house of YAHUAH our YAHUAH I will seek thy good.
verses.am: Because of the house of the LORD our God I will seek thy good.

verses.en: [A Song of degrees.] Unto thee lift I up mine eyes, O thou that dwellest in the heavens.
verses.am: [A Song of degrees.] Unto thee lift I up mine eyes, O thou that dwellest in the heavens.

verses.en: Behold, as the eyes of servants look unto the hand of their masters, and as the eyes of a maiden unto the hand of her mistress; so our eyes wait upon YAHUAH our YAHUAH, until that he have mercy upon us.
verses.am: Behold, as the eyes of servants {look} unto the hand of their masters, {and} as the eyes of a maiden unto the hand of her mistress; so our eyes {wait} upon the LORD our God, until that he have mercy upon us.

verses.en: Have mercy upon us, O YAHUAH, have mercy upon us: for we are exceedingly filled with contempt.
verses.am: Have mercy upon us, O LORD, have mercy upon us: for we are exceedingly filled with contempt.

verses.en: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scorning of those that are at ease, and with the contempt of the proud.
verses.am: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scorning of those that are at ease, {and} with the contempt of the proud.

verses.en: [A Song of degrees of Dawid.] If it had not been YAHUAH who was on our side, now may Yisra'el say;
verses.am: [A Song of degrees of David.] If {it had not been} the LORD who was on our side, now may Israel say;

verses.en: If it had not been YAHUAH who was on our side, when men rose up against us:
verses.am: If {it had not been} the LORD who was on our side, when men rose up against us:

verses.en: Then they had swallowed us up quick, when their wrath was kindled against us:
verses.am: Then they had swallowed us up quick, when their wrath was kindled against us:

verses.en: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over our soul:
verses.am: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over our soul:

verses.en: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.
verses.am: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.

verses.en: Blessed be YAHUAH, who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.
verses.am: Blessed {be} the LORD, who hath not given us {as} a prey to their teeth.

verses.en: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we are escaped.
verses.am: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we are escaped.

verses.en: Our help is in the name of YAHUAH, who made heaven and earth.
verses.am: Our help {is} in the name of the LORD, who made heaven and earth.

verses.en: [A Song of degrees.] They that trust in YAHUAH shall be as mount Zion, which cannot be removed, but abideth for ever.
verses.am: [A Song of degrees.] They that trust in the LORD {shall be} as mount Zion, {which} cannot be removed, {but} abideth for ever.

verses.en: As the mountains are round about Yerushalayim, so YAHUAH is round about his people from henceforth even for ever.
verses.am: As the mountains {are} round about Jerusalem, so the LORD {is} round about his people from henceforth even for ever.

verses.en: For the rod of the wicked shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; lest the righteous put forth their hands unto iniquity.
verses.am: For the rod of the wicked shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; lest the righteous put forth their hands unto iniquity. {the wicked: Heb. wickedness}

verses.en: Do good, O YAHUAH, unto those that be good, and to them that are upright in their hearts.
verses.am: Do good, O LORD, unto {those that be} good, and {to them that are} upright in their hearts.

verses.en: As for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, YAHUAH shall lead them forth with the workers of iniquity: but peace shall be upon Yisra'el.
verses.am: As for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, the LORD shall lead them forth with the workers of iniquity: {but} peace {shall be} upon Israel.

verses.en: [A Song of degrees.] When YAHUAH turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream.
verses.am: [A Song of degrees.] When the LORD turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream. {turned...: Heb. returned the returning}

verses.en: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing: then said they among the heathen, YAHUAH hath done great things for them.
verses.am: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing: then said they among the heathen, The LORD hath done great things for them. {hath...: Heb. hath magnified to do with them}

verses.en: YAHUAH hath done great things for us; whereof we are glad.
verses.am: The LORD hath done great things for us; {whereof} we are glad.

verses.en: Turn again our captivity, O YAHUAH, as the streams in the south.
verses.am: Turn again our captivity, O LORD, as the streams in the south.

verses.en: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.
verses.am: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy. {joy: or, singing}

verses.en: He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing precious seed, shall doubtless come again with rejoicing, bringing his sheaves with him.
verses.am: He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing precious seed, shall doubtless come again with rejoicing, bringing his sheaves {with him}. {precious...: or, seed basket}

verses.en: [A Song of degrees for Shelomoh.] Except YAHUAH build the house, they labour in vain that build it: except YAHUAH keep the city, the watchman waketh but in vain.
verses.am: [A Song of degrees for Solomon.] Except the LORD build the house, they labour in vain that build it: except the LORD keep the city, the watchman waketh {but} in vain. {for...: or, of Solomon} {that...: Heb. that are builders of it in it}

verses.en: It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows: for so he giveth his beloved sleep.
verses.am: {It is} vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows: {for} so he giveth his beloved sleep.

verses.en: Lo, children are an heritage of YAHUAH: and the fruit of the womb is his reward.
verses.am: Lo, children {are} an heritage of the LORD: {and} the fruit of the womb {is his} reward.

verses.en: As arrows are in the hand of a mighty man; so are children of the youth.
verses.am: As arrows {are} in the hand of a mighty man; so {are} children of the youth.

verses.en: Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them: they shall not be ashamed, but they shall speak with the enemies in the gate.
verses.am: Happy {is} the man that hath his quiver full of them: they shall not be ashamed, but they shall speak with the enemies in the gate. {his...: Heb. filled his quiver with them} {speak...: or, subdue, or, destroy}

verses.en: [A Song of degrees.] Blessed is every one that feareth YAHUAH; that walketh in his ways.
verses.am: [A Song of degrees.] Blessed {is} every one that feareth the LORD; that walketh in his ways.

verses.en: For thou shalt eat the labour of thine hands: happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well with thee.
verses.am: For thou shalt eat the labour of thine hands: happy {shalt} thou {be}, and {it shall be} well with thee.

verses.en: Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine by the sides of thine house: thy children like olive plants round about thy table.
verses.am: Thy wife {shall be} as a fruitful vine by the sides of thine house: thy children like olive plants round about thy table.

verses.en: Behold, that thus shall the man be blessed that feareth YAHUAH.
verses.am: Behold, that thus shall the man be blessed that feareth the LORD.

verses.en: YAHUAH shall bless thee out of Zion: and thou shalt see the good of Yerushalayim all the days of thy life.
verses.am: The LORD shall bless thee out of Zion: and thou shalt see the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.

verses.en: Yea, thou shalt see thy children's children, and peace upon Yisra'el.
verses.am: Yea, thou shalt see thy children's children, {and} peace upon Israel.

verses.en: [A Song of degrees.] Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth, may Yisra'el now say:
verses.am: [A Song of degrees.] Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth, may Israel now say: {Many...: or, Much}

verses.en: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth: yet they have not prevailed against me.
verses.am: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth: yet they have not prevailed against me. {Many...: or, Much}

verses.en: The plowers plowed upon my back: they made long their furrows.
verses.am: The plowers plowed upon my back: they made long their furrows.

verses.en: YAHUAH is righteous: he hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.
verses.am: The LORD {is} righteous: he hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.

verses.en: Let them all be confounded and turned back that hate Zion.
verses.am: Let them all be confounded and turned back that hate Zion.

verses.en: Let them be as the grass upon the housetops, which withereth afore it groweth up:
verses.am: Let them be as the grass {upon} the housetops, which withereth afore it groweth up:

verses.en: Wherewith the mower filleth not his hand; nor he that bindeth sheaves his bosom.
verses.am: Wherewith the mower filleth not his hand; nor he that bindeth sheaves his bosom.

verses.en: Neither do they which go by say, The blessing of YAHUAH be upon you: we bless you in the name of YAHUAH.
verses.am: Neither do they which go by say, The blessing of the LORD {be} upon you: we bless you in the name of the LORD.

verses.en: [A Song of degrees.] Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O YAHUAH.
verses.am: [A Song of degrees.] Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O LORD.

verses.en: YAHUAH, hear my voice: let thine ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications.
verses.am: Lord, hear my voice: let thine ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications.

verses.en: If thou, YAHUAH, shouldest mark iniquities, O YAHUAH, who shall stand?
verses.am: If thou, LORD, shouldest mark iniquities, O Lord, who shall stand?

verses.en: But there is forgiveness with thee, that thou mayest be feared.
verses.am: But {there is} forgiveness with thee, that thou mayest be feared.

verses.en: I wait for YAHUAH, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.
verses.am: I wait for the LORD, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.

verses.en: My soul waiteth for YAHUAH more than they that watch for the morning: I say, more than they that watch for the morning.
verses.am: My soul {waiteth} for the Lord more than they that watch for the morning: {I say, more than} they that watch for the morning. {I say...: or, which watch unto}

verses.en: Let Yisra'el hope in YAHUAH: for with YAHUAH there is mercy, and with him is plenteous redemption.
verses.am: Let Israel hope in the LORD: for with the LORD {there is} mercy, and with him {is} plenteous redemption.

verses.en: And he shall redeem Yisra'el from all his iniquities.
verses.am: And he shall redeem Israel from all his iniquities.

verses.en: [A Song of degrees of Dawid.] YAHUAH, my heart is not haughty, nor mine eyes lofty: neither do I exercise myself in great matters, or in things too high for me.
verses.am: [A Song of degrees of David.] LORD, my heart is not haughty, nor mine eyes lofty: neither do I exercise myself in great matters, or in things too high for me. {exercise...: Heb. walk} {high: Heb. wonderful}

verses.en: Surely I have behaved and quieted myself, as a child that is weaned of his mother: my soul is even as a weaned child.
verses.am: Surely I have behaved and quieted myself, as a child that is weaned of his mother: my soul {is} even as a weaned child. {myself: Heb. my soul}

verses.en: Let Yisra'el hope in YAHUAH from henceforth and for ever.
verses.am: Let Israel hope in the LORD from henceforth and for ever. {henceforth: Heb. now}

verses.en: A Song of degrees. YAHUAH, remember Dawid, and all his afflictions:
verses.am: A Song of degrees. LORD, remember David, {and} all his afflictions:

verses.en: How he sware unto YAHUAH, and vowed unto the mighty YAHUAH of Ya'aqob;
verses.am: How he sware unto the LORD, {and} vowed unto the mighty {God} of Jacob;

verses.en: Surely I will not come into the tabernacle of my house, nor go up into my bed;
verses.am: Surely I will not come into the tabernacle of my house, nor go up into my bed;

verses.en: I will not give sleep to mine eyes, or slumber to mine eyelids,
verses.am: I will not give sleep to mine eyes, {or} slumber to mine eyelids,

verses.en: Until I find out a place for YAHUAH, an habitation for the mighty YAHUAH of Ya'aqob.
verses.am: Until I find out a place for the LORD, an habitation for the mighty {God} of Jacob. {an habitation: Heb. habitations}

verses.en: Lo, we heard of it at Ephratah: we found it in the fields of the wood.
verses.am: Lo, we heard of it at Ephratah: we found it in the fields of the wood.

verses.en: We will go into his tabernacles: we will worship at his footstool.
verses.am: We will go into his tabernacles: we will worship at his footstool.

verses.en: Arise, O YAHUAH, into thy rest; thou, and the ark of thy strength.
verses.am: Arise, O LORD, into thy rest; thou, and the ark of thy strength.

verses.en: Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness; and let thy saints shout for joy.
verses.am: Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness; and let thy saints shout for joy.

verses.en: For thy servant Dawid's sake turn not away the face of thine anointed.
verses.am: For thy servant David's sake turn not away the face of thine anointed.

verses.en: YAHUAH hath sworn in truth unto Dawid; he will not turn from it; Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.
verses.am: The LORD hath sworn {in} truth unto David; he will not turn from it; Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne. {body: Heb. belly}

verses.en: If thy children will keep my covenant and my testimony that I shall teach them, their children shall also sit upon thy throne for evermore.
verses.am: If thy children will keep my covenant and my testimony that I shall teach them, their children shall also sit upon thy throne for evermore.

verses.en: For YAHUAH hath chosen Zion; he hath desired it for his habitation.
verses.am: For the LORD hath chosen Zion; he hath desired {it} for his habitation.

verses.en: This is my rest for ever: here will I dwell; for I have desired it.
verses.am: This {is} my rest for ever: here will I dwell; for I have desired it.

verses.en: I will abundantly bless her provision: I will satisfy her poor with bread.
verses.am: I will abundantly bless her provision: I will satisfy her poor with bread. {abundantly: or, surely}

verses.en: I will also clothe her priests with salvation: and her saints shall shout aloud for joy.
verses.am: I will also clothe her priests with salvation: and her saints shall shout aloud for joy.

verses.en: There will I make the horn of Dawid to bud: I have ordained a lamp for mine anointed.
verses.am: There will I make the horn of David to bud: I have ordained a lamp for mine anointed. {lamp: or, candle}

verses.en: His enemies will I clothe with shame: but upon himself shall his crown flourish.
verses.am: His enemies will I clothe with shame: but upon himself shall his crown flourish.

verses.en: [A Song of degrees of Dawid.] Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!
verses.am: [A Song of degrees of David.] Behold, how good and how pleasant {it is} for brethren to dwell together in unity! {together...: Heb. even together}

verses.en: It is like the precious ointment upon the head, that ran down upon the beard, even Aaron's beard: that went down to the skirts of his garments;
verses.am: {It is} like the precious ointment upon the head, that ran down upon the beard, {even} Aaron's beard: that went down to the skirts of his garments;

verses.en: As the dew of Hermon, and as the dew that descended upon the mountains of Zion: for there YAHUAH commanded the blessing, even life for evermore.
verses.am: As the dew of Hermon, {and as the dew} that descended upon the mountains of Zion: for there the LORD commanded the blessing, {even} life for evermore.

verses.en: [A Song of degrees.] Behold, bless ye YAHUAH, all ye servants of YAHUAH, which by night stand in the house of YAHUAH.
verses.am: [A Song of degrees.] Behold, bless ye the LORD, all {ye} servants of the LORD, which by night stand in the house of the LORD.

verses.en: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary, and bless YAHUAH.
verses.am: Lift up your hands {in} the sanctuary, and bless the LORD. {the sanctuary: or, holiness}

verses.en: YAHUAH that made heaven and earth bless thee out of Zion.
verses.am: The LORD that made heaven and earth bless thee out of Zion.

verses.en: Praise ye YAHUAH. Praise ye the name of YAHUAH; praise him, O ye servants of YAHUAH.
verses.am: Praise ye the LORD. Praise ye the name of the LORD; praise {him}, O ye servants of the LORD.

verses.en: Ye that stand in the house of YAHUAH, in the courts of the house of our YAHUAH,
verses.am: Ye that stand in the house of the LORD, in the courts of the house of our God,

verses.en: Praise YAHUAH; for YAHUAH is good: sing praises unto his name; for it is pleasant.
verses.am: Praise the LORD; for the LORD {is} good: sing praises unto his name; for {it is} pleasant.

verses.en: For YAHUAH hath chosen Ya'aqob unto himself, and Yisra'el for his peculiar treasure.
verses.am: For the LORD hath chosen Jacob unto himself, {and} Israel for his peculiar treasure.

verses.en: For I know that YAHUAH is great, and that our YAHUAH is above all elohim.
verses.am: For I know that the LORD {is} great, and {that} our Lord {is} above all gods.

verses.en: Whatsoever YAHUAH pleased, that did he in heaven, and in earth, in the seas, and all deep places.
verses.am: Whatsoever the LORD pleased, {that} did he in heaven, and in earth, in the seas, and all deep places.

verses.en: He causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings for the rain; he bringeth the wind out of his treasuries.
verses.am: He causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings for the rain; he bringeth the wind out of his treasuries.

verses.en: Who smote the firstborn of Mitsrayim, both of man and beast.
verses.am: Who smote the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and beast. {both...: Heb. from man unto beast}

verses.en: Who sent tokens and wonders into the midst of thee, O Mitsrayim, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants.
verses.am: {Who} sent tokens and wonders into the midst of thee, O Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants.

verses.en: Who smote great nations, and slew mighty kings;
verses.am: Who smote great nations, and slew mighty kings;

verses.en: Sihon king of the Amorites, and Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan:
verses.am: Sihon king of the Amorites, and Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan:

verses.en: And gave their land for an heritage, an heritage unto Yisra'el his people.
verses.am: And gave their land {for} an heritage, an heritage unto Israel his people.

verses.en: Thy name, O YAHUAH, endureth for ever; and thy memorial, O YAHUAH, throughout all generations.
verses.am: Thy name, O LORD, {endureth} for ever; {and} thy memorial, O LORD, throughout all generations. {throughout...: Heb. to generation and generation}

verses.en: For YAHUAH will judge his people, and he will repent himself concerning his servants.
verses.am: For the LORD will judge his people, and he will repent himself concerning his servants.

verses.en: The idols of the heathen are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.
verses.am: The idols of the heathen {are} silver and gold, the work of men's hands.

verses.en: They have mouths, but they speak not; eyes have they, but they see not;
verses.am: They have mouths, but they speak not; eyes have they, but they see not;

verses.en: They have ears, but they hear not; neither is there any breath in their mouths.
verses.am: They have ears, but they hear not; neither is there {any} breath in their mouths.

verses.en: They that make them are like unto them: so is every one that trusteth in them.
verses.am: They that make them are like unto them: {so is} every one that trusteth in them.

verses.en: Bless YAHUAH, O house of Yisra'el: bless YAHUAH, O house of Aaron:
verses.am: Bless the LORD, O house of Israel: bless the LORD, O house of Aaron:

verses.en: Bless YAHUAH, O house of Levi: ye that fear YAHUAH, bless YAHUAH.
verses.am: Bless the LORD, O house of Levi: ye that fear the LORD, bless the LORD.

verses.en: Blessed be YAHUAH out of Zion, which dwelleth at Yerushalayim. Praise ye YAHUAH.
verses.am: Blessed be the LORD out of Zion, which dwelleth at Jerusalem. Praise ye the LORD.

verses.en: O give thanks unto YAHUAH; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.am: O give thanks unto the LORD; for {he is} good: for his mercy {endureth} for ever.

verses.en: O give thanks unto YAHUAH of elohim: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.am: O give thanks unto the God of gods: for his mercy {endureth} for ever.

verses.en: O give thanks to YAHUAH of lords: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.am: O give thanks to the Lord of lords: for his mercy {endureth} for ever.

verses.en: To him who alone doeth great wonders: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.am: To him who alone doeth great wonders: for his mercy {endureth} for ever.

verses.en: To him that by wisdom made the heavens: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.am: To him that by wisdom made the heavens: for his mercy {endureth} for ever.

verses.en: To him that stretched out the earth above the waters: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.am: To him that stretched out the earth above the waters: for his mercy {endureth} for ever.

verses.en: To him that made great lights: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.am: To him that made great lights: for his mercy {endureth} for ever:

verses.en: The sun to rule by day: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.am: The sun to rule by day: for his mercy {endureth} for ever: {to rule...: Heb. for the rulings by day}

verses.en: The moon and stars to rule by night: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.am: The moon and stars to rule by night: for his mercy {endureth} for ever.

verses.en: To him that smote Mitsrayim in their firstborn: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.am: To him that smote Egypt in their firstborn: for his mercy {endureth} for ever:

verses.en: And brought out Yisra'el from among them: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.am: And brought out Israel from among them: for his mercy {endureth} for ever:

verses.en: With a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.am: With a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm: for his mercy {endureth} for ever.

verses.en: To him which divided the Red sea into parts: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.am: To him which divided the Red sea into parts: for his mercy {endureth} for ever:

verses.en: And made Yisra'el to pass through the midst of it: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.am: And made Israel to pass through the midst of it: for his mercy {endureth} for ever:

verses.en: But overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red sea: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.am: But overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red sea: for his mercy {endureth} for ever. {overthrew: Heb. shaked off}

verses.en: To him which led his people through the wilderness: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.am: To him which led his people through the wilderness: for his mercy {endureth} for ever.

verses.en: To him which smote great kings: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.am: To him which smote great kings: for his mercy {endureth} for ever:

verses.en: And slew famous kings: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.am: And slew famous kings: for his mercy {endureth} for ever:

verses.en: Sihon king of the Amorites: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.am: Sihon king of the Amorites: for his mercy {endureth} for ever:

verses.en: And Og the king of Bashan: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.am: And Og the king of Bashan: for his mercy {endureth} for ever:

verses.en: And gave their land for an heritage: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.am: And gave their land for an heritage: for his mercy {endureth} for ever:

verses.en: Even an heritage unto Yisra'el his servant: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.am: {Even} an heritage unto Israel his servant: for his mercy {endureth} for ever.

verses.en: Who remembered us in our low estate: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.am: Who remembered us in our low estate: for his mercy {endureth} for ever:

verses.en: And hath redeemed us from our enemies: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.am: And hath redeemed us from our enemies: for his mercy {endureth} for ever.

verses.en: Who giveth food to all flesh: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.am: Who giveth food to all flesh: for his mercy {endureth} for ever.

verses.en: O give thanks unto YAHUAH of heaven: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.am: O give thanks unto the God of heaven: for his mercy {endureth} for ever.

verses.en: By the rivers of Babel, there we sat down, yea, we wept, when we remembered Zion.
verses.am: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down, yea, we wept, when we remembered Zion.

verses.en: We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof.
verses.am: We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof.

verses.en: For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song; and they that wasted us required of us mirth, saying, Sing us one of the songs of Zion.
verses.am: For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song; and they that wasted us {required of us} mirth, {saying}, Sing us {one} of the songs of Zion. {a song: Heb. the words of a song} {wasted...: Heb. laid us on heaps}

verses.en: How shall we sing YAHUAH's song in a strange land?
verses.am: How shall we sing the LORD'S song in a strange land? {strange...: Heb. land of a stranger?}

verses.en: If I forget thee, O Yerushalayim, let my right hand forget her cunning.
verses.am: If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget {her cunning}.

verses.en: If I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth; if I prefer not Yerushalayim above my chief joy.
verses.am: If I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth; if I prefer not Jerusalem above my chief joy. {my chief...: Heb. the head of my joy}

verses.en: Remember, O YAHUAH, the children of Edom in the day of Yerushalayim; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.
verses.am: Remember, O LORD, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase {it}, rase {it, even} to the foundation thereof. {Rase it: Heb. Make bare}

verses.en: O daughter of Babel, who art to be destroyed; happy shall he be, that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us.
verses.am: O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed; happy {shall he be}, that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us. {destroyed: Heb. wasted} {rewardeth...: Heb. recompenseth unto thee thy deed which thou didst to us}

verses.en: Happy shall he be, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones against the stones.
verses.am: Happy {shall he be}, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones against the stones. {the stones: Heb. the rock}

verses.en: [A Psalm of Dawid.] I will praise thee with my whole heart: before the elohim will I sing praise unto thee.
verses.am: [{A Psalm} of David.] I will praise thee with my whole heart: before the gods will I sing praise unto thee.

verses.en: I will worship toward thy holy temple, and praise thy name for thy lovingkindness and for thy truth: for thou hast magnified thy word above all thy name.
verses.am: I will worship toward thy holy temple, and praise thy name for thy lovingkindness and for thy truth: for thou hast magnified thy word above all thy name.

verses.en: In the day when I cried thou answeredst me, and strengthenedst me with strength in my soul.
verses.am: In the day when I cried thou answeredst me, {and} strengthenedst me {with} strength in my soul.

verses.en: All the kings of the earth shall praise thee, O YAHUAH, when they hear the words of thy mouth.
verses.am: All the kings of the earth shall praise thee, O LORD, when they hear the words of thy mouth.

verses.en: Yea, they shall sing in the ways of YAHUAH: for great is the glory of YAHUAH.
verses.am: Yea, they shall sing in the ways of the LORD: for great {is} the glory of the LORD.

verses.en: Though YAHUAH be high, yet hath he respect unto the lowly: but the proud he knoweth afar off.
verses.am: Though the LORD {be} high, yet hath he respect unto the lowly: but the proud he knoweth afar off.

verses.en: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, thou wilt revive me: thou shalt stretch forth thine hand against the wrath of mine enemies, and thy right hand shall save me.
verses.am: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, thou wilt revive me: thou shalt stretch forth thine hand against the wrath of mine enemies, and thy right hand shall save me.

verses.en: YAHUAH will perfect that which concerneth me: thy mercy, O YAHUAH, endureth for ever: forsake not the works of thine own hands.
verses.am: The LORD will perfect {that which} concerneth me: thy mercy, O LORD, {endureth} for ever: forsake not the works of thine own hands.

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of Dawid.] O YAHUAH, thou hast searched me, and known me.
verses.am: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.] O LORD, thou hast searched me, and known {me}.

verses.en: Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising, thou understandest my thought afar off.
verses.am: Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising, thou understandest my thought afar off.

verses.en: Thou compassest my path and my lying down, and art acquainted with all my ways.
verses.am: Thou compassest my path and my lying down, and art acquainted {with} all my ways. {compassest: or, winnowest}

verses.en: For there is not a word in my tongue, but, lo, O YAHUAH, thou knowest it altogether.
verses.am: For {there is} not a word in my tongue, {but}, lo, O LORD, thou knowest it altogether.

verses.en: Thou hast beset me behind and before, and laid thine hand upon me.
verses.am: Thou hast beset me behind and before, and laid thine hand upon me.

verses.en: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me; it is high, I cannot attain unto it.
verses.am: {Such} knowledge {is} too wonderful for me; it is high, I cannot {attain} unto it.

verses.en: Whither shall I go from thy spirit? or whither shall I flee from thy presence?
verses.am: Whither shall I go from thy spirit? or whither shall I flee from thy presence?

verses.en: If I ascend up into heaven, thou art there: if I make my bed in hell, behold, thou art there.
verses.am: If I ascend up into heaven, thou {art} there: if I make my bed in hell, behold, thou {art there}.

verses.en: If I take the wings of the morning, and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;
verses.am: {If} I take the wings of the morning, {and} dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;

verses.en: Even there shall thy hand lead me, and thy right hand shall hold me.
verses.am: Even there shall thy hand lead me, and thy right hand shall hold me.

verses.en: If I say, Surely the darkness shall cover me; even the night shall be light about me.
verses.am: If I say, Surely the darkness shall cover me; even the night shall be light about me.

verses.en: Yea, the darkness hideth not from thee; but the night shineth as the day: the darkness and the light are both alike to thee.
verses.am: Yea, the darkness hideth not from thee; but the night shineth as the day: the darkness and the light {are} both alike {to thee}. {hideth...: Heb. darkeneth not} {the darkness and...: Heb. as is the darkness, so is the light}

verses.en: For thou hast possessed my reins: thou hast covered me in my mother's womb.
verses.am: For thou hast possessed my reins: thou hast covered me in my mother's womb.

verses.en: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.
verses.am: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully {and} wonderfully made: marvellous {are} thy works; and {that} my soul knoweth right well. {right...: Heb. greatly}

verses.en: My substance was not hid from thee, when I was made in secret, and curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.
verses.am: My substance was not hid from thee, when I was made in secret, {and} curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth. {substance: or, strength, or, body}

verses.en: Thine eyes did see my substance, yet being unperfect; and in thy book all my members were written, which in continuance were fashioned, when as yet there was none of them.
verses.am: Thine eyes did see my substance, yet being unperfect; and in thy book all {my members} were written, {which} in continuance were fashioned, when {as yet there was} none of them. {all...: Heb. all of them} {which...: or, what days they should be fashioned}

verses.en: How precious also are thy thoughts unto me, O YAHUAH! how great is the sum of them!
verses.am: How precious also are thy thoughts unto me, O God! how great is the sum of them!

verses.en: If I should count them, they are more in number than the sand: when I awake, I am still with thee.
verses.am: {If} I should count them, they are more in number than the sand: when I awake, I am still with thee.

verses.en: Surely thou wilt slay the wicked, O YAHUAH: depart from me therefore, ye bloody men.
verses.am: Surely thou wilt slay the wicked, O God: depart from me therefore, ye bloody men.

verses.en: For they speak against thee wickedly, and thine enemies take thy name in vain.
verses.am: For they speak against thee wickedly, {and} thine enemies take {thy name} in vain.

verses.en: Do not I hate them, O YAHUAH, that hate thee? and am not I grieved with those that rise up against thee?
verses.am: Do not I hate them, O LORD, that hate thee? and am not I grieved with those that rise up against thee?

verses.en: I hate them with perfect hatred: I count them mine enemies.
verses.am: I hate them with perfect hatred: I count them mine enemies.

verses.en: Search me, O YAHUAH, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts:
verses.am: Search me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts:

verses.en: And see if there be any wicked way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.
verses.am: And see if {there be any} wicked way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting. {wicked...: Heb. way of pain, or, grief}

verses.en: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of Dawid.] Deliver me, O YAHUAH, from the evil man: preserve me from the violent man;
verses.am: [To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.] Deliver me, O LORD, from the evil man: preserve me from the violent man; {violent...: Heb. man of violences}

verses.en: Which imagine mischiefs in their heart; continually are they gathered together for war.
verses.am: Which imagine mischiefs in {their} heart; continually are they gathered together {for} war.

verses.en: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; adders' poison is under their lips. Selah.
verses.am: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; adders' poison {is} under their lips. Selah.

verses.en: Keep me, O YAHUAH, from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from the violent man; who have purposed to overthrow my goings.
verses.am: Keep me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from the violent man; who have purposed to overthrow my goings.

verses.en: The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords; they have spread a net by the wayside; they have set gins for me. Selah.
verses.am: The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords; they have spread a net by the wayside; they have set gins for me. Selah.

verses.en: I said unto YAHUAH, Thou art my YAHUAH: hear the voice of my supplications, O YAHUAH.
verses.am: I said unto the LORD, Thou {art} my God: hear the voice of my supplications, O LORD.

verses.en: O YAHUAH, the strength of my salvation, thou hast covered my head in the day of battle.
verses.am: O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, thou hast covered my head in the day of battle.

verses.en: Grant not, O YAHUAH, the desires of the wicked: further not his wicked device; lest they exalt themselves. Selah.
verses.am: Grant not, O LORD, the desires of the wicked: further not his wicked device; {lest} they exalt themselves. Selah. {lest...: or, let them not be exalted}

verses.en: As for the head of those that compass me about, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
verses.am: {As for} the head of those that compass me about, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.

verses.en: Let burning coals fall upon them: let them be cast into the fire; into deep pits, that they rise not up again.
verses.am: Let burning coals fall upon them: let them be cast into the fire; into deep pits, that they rise not up again.

verses.en: Let not an evil speaker be established in the earth: evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him.
verses.am: Let not an evil speaker be established in the earth: evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow {him}. {an...: or, an evil speaker (Heb. a man of tongue), a wicked man of violence, be established in the earth: let him be hunted to his overthrow}

verses.en: I know that YAHUAH will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and the right of the poor.
verses.am: I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted, {and} the right of the poor.

verses.en: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto thy name: the upright shall dwell in thy presence.
verses.am: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto thy name: the upright shall dwell in thy presence.

verses.en: [A Psalm of Dawid.] YAHUAH, I cry unto thee: make haste unto me; give ear unto my voice, when I cry unto thee.
verses.am: [A Psalm of David.] LORD, I cry unto thee: make haste unto me; give ear unto my voice, when I cry unto thee.

verses.en: Let my prayer be set forth before thee as incense; and the lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice.
verses.am: Let my prayer be set forth before thee {as} incense; {and} the lifting up of my hands {as} the evening sacrifice. {set...: Heb. directed}

verses.en: Set a watch, O YAHUAH, before my mouth; keep the door of my lips.
verses.am: Set a watch, O LORD, before my mouth; keep the door of my lips.

verses.en: Incline not my heart to any evil thing, to practise wicked works with men that work iniquity: and let me not eat of their dainties.
verses.am: Incline not my heart to {any} evil thing, to practise wicked works with men that work iniquity: and let me not eat of their dainties.

verses.en: Let the righteous smite me; it shall be a kindness: and let him reprove me; it shall be an excellent oil, which shall not break my head: for yet my prayer also shall be in their calamities.
verses.am: Let the righteous smite me; {it shall be} a kindness: and let him reprove me; {it shall be} an excellent oil, {which} shall not break my head: for yet my prayer also {shall be} in their calamities. {me; it shall be a...: or, me kindly, and reprove me; let not their precious oil break, etc}

verses.en: When their judges are overthrown in stony places, they shall hear my words; for they are sweet.
verses.am: When their judges are overthrown in stony places, they shall hear my words; for they are sweet.

verses.en: Our bones are scattered at the grave's mouth, as when one cutteth and cleaveth wood upon the earth.
verses.am: Our bones are scattered at the grave's mouth, as when one cutteth and cleaveth {wood} upon the earth.

verses.en: But mine eyes are unto thee, O YAHUAH: in thee is my trust; leave not my soul destitute.
verses.am: But mine eyes {are} unto thee, O GOD the Lord: in thee is my trust; leave not my soul destitute. {leave...: Heb. make not my soul bare}

verses.en: Keep me from the snares which they have laid for me, and the gins of the workers of iniquity.
verses.am: Keep me from the snares {which} they have laid for me, and the gins of the workers of iniquity.

verses.en: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, whilst that I withal escape.
verses.am: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, whilst that I withal escape. {escape: Heb. pass over}

verses.en: [Maschil of Dawid; A Prayer when he was in the cave.] I cried unto YAHUAH with my voice; with my voice unto YAHUAH did I make my supplication.
verses.am: [Maschil of David; A Prayer when he was in the cave.] I cried unto the LORD with my voice; with my voice unto the LORD did I make my supplication. {Maschil...: or, A Psalm of David, giving instruction}

verses.en: I poured out my complaint before him; I shewed before him my trouble.
verses.am: I poured out my complaint before him; I shewed before him my trouble.

verses.en: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, then thou knewest my path. In the way wherein I walked have they privily laid a snare for me.
verses.am: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, then thou knewest my path. In the way wherein I walked have they privily laid a snare for me.

verses.en: I looked on my right hand, and beheld, but there was no man that would know me: refuge failed me; no man cared for my soul.
verses.am: I looked on {my} right hand, and beheld, but {there was} no man that would know me: refuge failed me; no man cared for my soul. {I looked...: or, Look on the right hand, and see} {failed...: Heb. perished from me} {cared...: Heb. sought after}

verses.en: I cried unto thee, O YAHUAH: I said, Thou art my refuge and my portion in the land of the living.
verses.am: I cried unto thee, O LORD: I said, Thou {art} my refuge {and} my portion in the land of the living.

verses.en: Attend unto my cry; for I am brought very low: deliver me from my persecutors; for they are stronger than I.
verses.am: Attend unto my cry; for I am brought very low: deliver me from my persecutors; for they are stronger than I.

verses.en: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may praise thy name: the righteous shall compass me about; for thou shalt deal bountifully with me.
verses.am: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may praise thy name: the righteous shall compass me about; for thou shalt deal bountifully with me.

verses.en: [A Psalm of Dawid.] Hear my prayer, O YAHUAH, give ear to my supplications: in thy faithfulness answer me, and in thy righteousness.
verses.am: [A Psalm of David.] Hear my prayer, O LORD, give ear to my supplications: in thy faithfulness answer me, {and} in thy righteousness.

verses.en: And enter not into judgment with thy servant: for in thy sight shall no man living be justified.
verses.am: And enter not into judgment with thy servant: for in thy sight shall no man living be justified.

verses.en: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul; he hath smitten my life down to the ground; he hath made me to dwell in darkness, as those that have been long dead.
verses.am: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul; he hath smitten my life down to the ground; he hath made me to dwell in darkness, as those that have been long dead.

verses.en: Therefore is my spirit overwhelmed within me; my heart within me is desolate.
verses.am: Therefore is my spirit overwhelmed within me; my heart within me is desolate.

verses.en: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all thy works; I muse on the work of thy hands.
verses.am: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all thy works; I muse on the work of thy hands.

verses.en: I stretch forth my hands unto thee: my soul thirsteth after thee, as a thirsty land. Selah.
verses.am: I stretch forth my hands unto thee: my soul {thirsteth} after thee, as a thirsty land. Selah.

verses.en: Hear me speedily, O YAHUAH: my spirit faileth: hide not thy face from me, lest I be like unto them that go down into the pit.
verses.am: Hear me speedily, O LORD: my spirit faileth: hide not thy face from me, lest I be like unto them that go down into the pit. {lest...: or, for I am become like, etc}

verses.en: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; for in thee do I trust: cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; for I lift up my soul unto thee.
verses.am: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; for in thee do I trust: cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; for I lift up my soul unto thee.

verses.en: Deliver me, O YAHUAH, from mine enemies: I flee unto thee to hide me.
verses.am: Deliver me, O LORD, from mine enemies: I flee unto thee to hide me. {flee...: Heb. hide me with thee}

verses.en: Teach me to do thy will; for thou art my YAHUAH: thy spirit is good; lead me into the land of uprightness.
verses.am: Teach me to do thy will; for thou {art} my God: thy spirit {is} good; lead me into the land of uprightness.

verses.en: Quicken me, O YAHUAH, for thy name's sake: for thy righteousness' sake bring my soul out of trouble.
verses.am: Quicken me, O LORD, for thy name's sake: for thy righteousness' sake bring my soul out of trouble.

verses.en: And of thy mercy cut off mine enemies, and destroy all them that afflict my soul: for I am thy servant.
verses.am: And of thy mercy cut off mine enemies, and destroy all them that afflict my soul: for I {am} thy servant.

verses.en: [A Psalm of Dawid.] Blessed be YAHUAH my strength, which teacheth my hands to war, and my fingers to fight:
verses.am: [{A Psalm} of David.] Blessed {be} the LORD my strength, which teacheth my hands to war, {and} my fingers to fight: {strength: Heb. rock} {to war...: Heb. to the war, etc}

verses.en: My goodness, and my fortress; my high tower, and my deliverer; my shield, and he in whom I trust; who subdueth my people under me.
verses.am: My goodness, and my fortress; my high tower, and my deliverer; my shield, and {he} in whom I trust; who subdueth my people under me. {My goodness: or, My mercy}

verses.en: YAHUAH, what is man, that thou takest knowledge of him! or the son of man, that thou makest account of him!
verses.am: LORD, what {is} man, that thou takest knowledge of him! {or} the son of man, that thou makest account of him!

verses.en: Man is like to vanity: his days are as a shadow that passeth away.
verses.am: Man is like to vanity: his days {are} as a shadow that passeth away.

verses.en: Bow thy heavens, O YAHUAH, and come down: touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.
verses.am: Bow thy heavens, O LORD, and come down: touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.

verses.en: Cast forth lightning, and scatter them: shoot out thine arrows, and destroy them.
verses.am: Cast forth lightning, and scatter them: shoot out thine arrows, and destroy them.

verses.en: Send thine hand from above; rid me, and deliver me out of great waters, from the hand of strange children;
verses.am: Send thine hand from above; rid me, and deliver me out of great waters, from the hand of strange children; {hand from: Heb. hands from}

verses.en: Whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
verses.am: Whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand {is} a right hand of falsehood.

verses.en: I will sing a new song unto thee, O YAHUAH: upon a psaltery and an instrument of ten strings will I sing praises unto thee.
verses.am: I will sing a new song unto thee, O God: upon a psaltery {and} an instrument of ten strings will I sing praises unto thee.

verses.en: It is he that giveth salvation unto kings: who delivereth Dawid his servant from the hurtful sword.
verses.am: {It is he} that giveth salvation unto kings: who delivereth David his servant from the hurtful sword. {salvation: or, victory}

verses.en: Rid me, and deliver me from the hand of strange children, whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood:
verses.am: Rid me, and deliver me from the hand of strange children, whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand {is} a right hand of falsehood:

verses.en: That our sons may be as plants grown up in their youth; that our daughters may be as corner stones, polished after the similitude of a palace:
verses.am: That our sons {may be} as plants grown up in their youth; {that} our daughters {may be} as corner stones, polished {after} the similitude of a palace: {polished: Heb. cut}

verses.en: That our garners may be full, affording all manner of store: that our sheep may bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our streets:
verses.am: {That} our garners {may be} full, affording all manner of store: {that} our sheep may bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our streets: {all...: Heb. from kind to kind}

verses.en: That our oxen may be strong to labour; that there be no breaking in, nor going out; that there be no complaining in our streets.
verses.am: {That} our oxen {may be} strong to labour; {that there be} no breaking in, nor going out; that {there be} no complaining in our streets. {strong...: Heb. able to bear burdens, or, loaden with flesh}

verses.en: Happy is that people, that is in such a case: yea, happy is that people, whose YAHUAH is YAHUAH.
verses.am: Happy {is that} people, that is in such a case: {yea}, happy {is that} people, whose God {is} the LORD.

verses.en: [Dawid's Psalm of praise.] I will extol thee, my YAHUAH, O king; and I will bless thy name for ever and ever.
verses.am: [David's {Psalm} of praise.] I will extol thee, my God, O king; and I will bless thy name for ever and ever.

verses.en: Every day will I bless thee; and I will praise thy name for ever and ever.
verses.am: Every day will I bless thee; and I will praise thy name for ever and ever.

verses.en: Great is YAHUAH, and greatly to be praised; and his greatness is unsearchable.
verses.am: Great {is} the LORD, and greatly to be praised; and his greatness {is} unsearchable. {and his...: Heb. and of his greatness there is no search}

verses.en: One generation shall praise thy works to another, and shall declare thy mighty acts.
verses.am: One generation shall praise thy works to another, and shall declare thy mighty acts.

verses.en: I will speak of the glorious honour of thy majesty, and of thy wondrous works.
verses.am: I will speak of the glorious honour of thy majesty, and of thy wondrous works. {works: Heb. things, or, words}

verses.en: And men shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts: and I will declare thy greatness.
verses.am: And {men} shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts: and I will declare thy greatness. {declare: Heb. declare it}

verses.en: They shall abundantly utter the memory of thy great goodness, and shall sing of thy righteousness.
verses.am: They shall abundantly utter the memory of thy great goodness, and shall sing of thy righteousness.

verses.en: YAHUAH is gracious, and full of compassion; slow to anger, and of great mercy.
verses.am: The LORD {is} gracious, and full of compassion; slow to anger, and of great mercy. {of great...: Heb. great in mercy}

verses.en: YAHUAH is good to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.
verses.am: The LORD {is} good to all: and his tender mercies {are} over all his works.

verses.en: All thy works shall praise thee, O YAHUAH; and thy saints shall bless thee.
verses.am: All thy works shall praise thee, O LORD; and thy saints shall bless thee.

verses.en: They shall speak of the glory of thy kingdom, and talk of thy power;
verses.am: They shall speak of the glory of thy kingdom, and talk of thy power;

verses.en: To make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, and the glorious majesty of his kingdom.
verses.am: To make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, and the glorious majesty of his kingdom.

verses.en: Thy kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and thy dominion endureth throughout all generations.
verses.am: Thy kingdom {is} an everlasting kingdom, and thy dominion {endureth} throughout all generations. {an...: Heb. a kingdom of all ages}

verses.en: YAHUAH upholdeth all that fall, and raiseth up all those that be bowed down.
verses.am: The LORD upholdeth all that fall, and raiseth up all {those that be} bowed down.

verses.en: The eyes of all wait upon thee; and thou givest them their meat in due season.
verses.am: The eyes of all wait upon thee; and thou givest them their meat in due season. {wait...: or, look unto}

verses.en: Thou openest thine hand, and satisfiest the desire of every living thing.
verses.am: Thou openest thine hand, and satisfiest the desire of every living thing.

verses.en: YAHUAH is righteous in all his ways, and holy in all his works.
verses.am: The LORD {is} righteous in all his ways, and holy in all his works. {holy: or, merciful, or, bountiful}

verses.en: YAHUAH is nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.
verses.am: The LORD {is} nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.

verses.en: He will fulfil the desire of them that fear him: he also will hear their cry, and will save them.
verses.am: He will fulfil the desire of them that fear him: he also will hear their cry, and will save them.

verses.en: YAHUAH preserveth all them that love him: but all the wicked will he destroy.
verses.am: The LORD preserveth all them that love him: but all the wicked will he destroy.

verses.en: My mouth shall speak the praise of YAHUAH: and let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.
verses.am: My mouth shall speak the praise of the LORD: and let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.

verses.en: Praise ye YAHUAH. Praise YAHUAH, O my soul.
verses.am: Praise ye the LORD. Praise the LORD, O my soul. {Praise ye...: Heb. Hallelujah}

verses.en: While I live will I praise YAHUAH: I will sing praises unto my YAHUAH while I have any being.
verses.am: While I live will I praise the LORD: I will sing praises unto my God while I have any being.

verses.en: Put not your trust in princes, nor in the son of man, in whom there is no help.
verses.am: Put not your trust in princes, {nor} in the son of man, in whom {there is} no help. {help: or, salvation}

verses.en: His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his earth; in that very day his thoughts perish.
verses.am: His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his earth; in that very day his thoughts perish.

verses.en: Happy is he that hath YAHUAH of Ya'aqob for his help, whose hope is in YAHUAH his YAHUAH:
verses.am: Happy {is he} that {hath} the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope {is} in the LORD his God:

verses.en: Which made heaven, and earth, the sea, and all that therein is: which keepeth truth for ever:
verses.am: Which made heaven, and earth, the sea, and all that therein {is}: which keepeth truth for ever:

verses.en: Which executeth judgment for the oppressed: which giveth food to the hungry. YAHUAH looseth the prisoners:
verses.am: Which executeth judgment for the oppressed: which giveth food to the hungry. The LORD looseth the prisoners:

verses.en: YAHUAH openeth the eyes of the blind: YAHUAH raiseth them that are bowed down: YAHUAH loveth the righteous:
verses.am: The LORD openeth {the eyes of} the blind: the LORD raiseth them that are bowed down: the LORD loveth the righteous:

verses.en: YAHUAH preserveth the strangers; he relieveth the fatherless and widow: but the way of the wicked he turneth upside down.
verses.am: The LORD preserveth the strangers; he relieveth the fatherless and widow: but the way of the wicked he turneth upside down.

verses.en: YAHUAH shall reign for ever, even thy YAHUAH, O Zion, unto all generations. Praise ye YAHUAH.
verses.am: The LORD shall reign for ever, {even} thy God, O Zion, unto all generations. Praise ye the LORD.

verses.en: Praise ye YAHUAH: for it is good to sing praises unto our YAHUAH; for it is pleasant; and praise is comely.
verses.am: Praise ye the LORD: for {it is} good to sing praises unto our God; for {it is} pleasant; {and} praise is comely.

verses.en: YAHUAH doth build up Yerushalayim: he gathereth together the outcasts of Yisra'el.
verses.am: The LORD doth build up Jerusalem: he gathereth together the outcasts of Israel.

verses.en: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.
verses.am: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds. {wounds: Heb. griefs}

verses.en: He telleth the number of the stars; he calleth them all by their names.
verses.am: He telleth the number of the stars; he calleth them all by {their} names.

verses.en: Great is our YAHUAH, and of great power: his understanding is infinite.
verses.am: Great {is} our Lord, and of great power: his understanding {is} infinite. {his...: Heb. of his understanding there is no number}

verses.en: YAHUAH lifteth up the meek: he casteth the wicked down to the ground.
verses.am: The LORD lifteth up the meek: he casteth the wicked down to the ground.

verses.en: Sing unto YAHUAH with thanksgiving; sing praise upon the harp unto our YAHUAH:
verses.am: Sing unto the LORD with thanksgiving; sing praise upon the harp unto our God:

verses.en: Who covereth the heaven with clouds, who prepareth rain for the earth, who maketh grass to grow upon the mountains.
verses.am: Who covereth the heaven with clouds, who prepareth rain for the earth, who maketh grass to grow upon the mountains.

verses.en: He giveth to the beast his food, and to the young ravens which cry.
verses.am: He giveth to the beast his food, {and} to the young ravens which cry.

verses.en: He delighteth not in the strength of the horse: he taketh not pleasure in the legs of a man.
verses.am: He delighteth not in the strength of the horse: he taketh not pleasure in the legs of a man.

verses.en: YAHUAH taketh pleasure in them that fear him, in those that hope in his mercy.
verses.am: The LORD taketh pleasure in them that fear him, in those that hope in his mercy.

verses.en: Praise YAHUAH, O Yerushalayim; praise thy YAHUAH, O Zion.
verses.am: Praise the LORD, O Jerusalem; praise thy God, O Zion.

verses.en: For he hath strengthened the bars of thy gates; he hath blessed thy children within thee.
verses.am: For he hath strengthened the bars of thy gates; he hath blessed thy children within thee.

verses.en: He maketh peace in thy borders, and filleth thee with the finest of the wheat.
verses.am: He maketh peace {in} thy borders, {and} filleth thee with the finest of the wheat. {He...: Heb. Who maketh thy border peace} {finest...: Heb. fat of wheat}

verses.en: He sendeth forth his commandment upon earth: his word runneth very swiftly.
verses.am: He sendeth forth his commandment {upon} earth: his word runneth very swiftly.

verses.en: He giveth snow like wool: he scattereth the hoarfrost like ashes.
verses.am: He giveth snow like wool: he scattereth the hoarfrost like ashes.

verses.en: He casteth forth his ice like morsels: who can stand before his cold?
verses.am: He casteth forth his ice like morsels: who can stand before his cold?

verses.en: He sendeth out his word, and melteth them: he causeth his wind to blow, and the waters flow.
verses.am: He sendeth out his word, and melteth them: he causeth his wind to blow, {and} the waters flow.

verses.en: He sheweth his word unto Ya'aqob, his statutes and his judgments unto Yisra'el.
verses.am: He sheweth his word unto Jacob, his statutes and his judgments unto Israel. {his word: Heb. his words}

verses.en: He hath not dealt so with any nation: and as for his judgments, they have not known them. Praise ye YAHUAH.
verses.am: He hath not dealt so with any nation: and {as for his} judgments, they have not known them. Praise ye the LORD.

verses.en: Praise ye YAHUAH. Praise ye YAHUAH from the heavens: praise him in the heights.
verses.am: Praise ye the LORD. Praise ye the LORD from the heavens: praise him in the heights. {Praise ye the LORD. Praise: Heb. Hallelujah, etc}

verses.en: Praise ye him, all his angels: praise ye him, all his hosts.
verses.am: Praise ye him, all his angels: praise ye him, all his hosts.

verses.en: Praise ye him, sun and moon: praise him, all ye stars of light.
verses.am: Praise ye him, sun and moon: praise him, all ye stars of light.

verses.en: Praise him, ye heavens of heavens, and ye waters that be above the heavens.
verses.am: Praise him, ye heavens of heavens, and ye waters that {be} above the heavens.

verses.en: Let them praise the name of YAHUAH: for he commanded, and they were created.
verses.am: Let them praise the name of the LORD: for he commanded, and they were created.

verses.en: He hath also stablished them for ever and ever: he hath made a decree which shall not pass.
verses.am: He hath also stablished them for ever and ever: he hath made a decree which shall not pass.

verses.en: Praise YAHUAH from the earth, ye dragons, and all deeps:
verses.am: Praise the LORD from the earth, ye dragons, and all deeps:

verses.en: Fire, and hail; snow, and vapour; stormy wind fulfilling his word:
verses.am: Fire, and hail; snow, and vapour; stormy wind fulfilling his word:

verses.en: Mountains, and all hills; fruitful trees, and all cedars:
verses.am: Mountains, and all hills; fruitful trees, and all cedars:

verses.en: Beasts, and all cattle; creeping things, and flying fowl:
verses.am: Beasts, and all cattle; creeping things, and flying fowl: {flying...: Heb. birds of wing}

verses.en: Kings of the earth, and all people; princes, and all judges of the earth:
verses.am: Kings of the earth, and all people; princes, and all judges of the earth:

verses.en: Both young men, and maidens; old men, and children:
verses.am: Both young men, and maidens; old men, and children:

verses.en: Let them praise the name of YAHUAH: for his name alone is excellent; his glory is above the earth and heaven.
verses.am: Let them praise the name of the LORD: for his name alone is excellent; his glory {is} above the earth and heaven. {excellent: Heb. exalted}

verses.en: He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; even of the children of Yisra'el, a people near unto him. Praise ye YAHUAH.
verses.am: He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; {even} of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Praise ye the LORD.

verses.en: Praise ye YAHUAH. Sing unto YAHUAH a new song, and his praise in the congregation of saints.
verses.am: Praise ye the LORD. Sing unto the LORD a new song, {and} his praise in the congregation of saints. {Praise...: Heb. Hallelujah}

verses.en: Let Yisra'el rejoice in him that made him: let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
verses.am: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him: let the children of Zion be joyful in their King. {in him...: Heb. in his Makers}

verses.en: Let them praise his name in the dance: let them sing praises unto him with the timbrel and harp.
verses.am: Let them praise his name in the dance: let them sing praises unto him with the timbrel and harp. {in...: or, with the pipe}

verses.en: For YAHUAH taketh pleasure in his people: he will beautify the meek with salvation.
verses.am: For the LORD taketh pleasure in his people: he will beautify the meek with salvation.

verses.en: Let the saints be joyful in glory: let them sing aloud upon their beds.
verses.am: Let the saints be joyful in glory: let them sing aloud upon their beds.

verses.en: Let the high praises of YAHUAH be in their mouth, and a twoedged sword in their hand;
verses.am: {Let} the high {praises} of God {be} in their mouth, and a twoedged sword in their hand; {mouth: Heb. throat}

verses.en: To execute vengeance upon the heathen, and punishments upon the people;
verses.am: To execute vengeance upon the heathen, {and} punishments upon the people;

verses.en: To bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;
verses.am: To bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;

verses.en: To execute upon them the judgment written: this honour have all his saints. Praise ye YAHUAH.
verses.am: To execute upon them the judgment written: this honour have all his saints. Praise ye the LORD.

verses.en: Praise ye YAHUAH. Praise YAHUAH in his sanctuary: praise him in the firmament of his power.
verses.am: Praise ye the LORD. Praise God in his sanctuary: praise him in the firmament of his power. {Praise ye...: Heb. Hallelujah}

verses.en: Praise him for his mighty acts: praise him according to his excellent greatness.
verses.am: Praise him for his mighty acts: praise him according to his excellent greatness.

verses.en: Praise him with the sound of the trumpet: praise him with the psaltery and harp.
verses.am: Praise him with the sound of the trumpet: praise him with the psaltery and harp. {trumpet: or, cornet}

verses.en: Praise him with the timbrel and dance: praise him with stringed instruments and organs.
verses.am: Praise him with the timbrel and dance: praise him with stringed instruments and organs. {dance: or, pipe}

verses.en: Praise him upon the loud cymbals: praise him upon the high sounding cymbals.
verses.am: Praise him upon the loud cymbals: praise him upon the high sounding cymbals.

verses.en: Let every thing that hath breath praise YAHUAH. Praise ye YAHUAH.
verses.am: Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD.

verses.en: I was small among my brothers, and youngest in my father’s house. I tended my father’s sheep.
verses.am: I was small among my brothers, and youngest in my father’s house. I tended my father’s sheep.

verses.en: My hands formed a musical instrument, and my fingers tuned a lute.
verses.am: My hands formed a musical instrument, and my fingers tuned a lute.

verses.en: Who shall tell my Master? YAHUAH himself, he himself hears.
verses.am: Who shall tell my Lord? The Lord himself, he himself hears.

verses.en: He sent forth his angel and took me from my father’s sheep, and he anointed me with his anointing oil.
verses.am: He sent forth his angel and took me from my father’s sheep, and he anointed me with his anointing oil.

verses.en: My brothers were handsome and tall; but YAHUAH did not take pleasure in them.
verses.am: My brothers were handsome and tall; but the Lord did not take pleasure in them.

verses.en: I went out to meet the Philistine, and he cursed me by his idols.
verses.am: I went out to meet the Philistine, and he cursed me by his idols.

verses.en: But I drew his own sword and beheaded him, and removed reproach from the children of Yisra'el.
verses.am: But I drew his own sword and beheaded him, and removed reproach from the children of Israel.
